description:
Summary

Do you enjoy connecting with new people, opening doors and turning opportunities into business? Do you get excited about exploring international markets, testing new ideas and shaping how a company grows? Are you ready to take ownership beyond traditional outbound sales?

As an International Sales Development Representative at Building Radar, you will play a key role in driving our international expansion. You'll be the first point of contact for potential customers, build high-quality sales pipeline and help shape our go-to-market strategy across new markets.

Drive International Outbound Sales: Identify high-potential companies across international markets, find key decision-makers and engage them through personalized outreach via phone, email and LinkedIn.

Build & Qualify Pipeline: Understand prospects' challenges, business goals and buying signals. Turn meaningful conversations into qualified opportunities and high-quality meetings for our Account Executives.

Your profile

First SDR / GTM Experience: You already have hands-on experience in sales development, business development or a comparable go-to-market role, ideally in B2B SaaS. Experience with international prospecting, cross-border outbound or developing new markets is a strong plus.

Strong Communication Skills: You know how to engage prospects, ask the right questions and communicate value clearly. Fluent English is essential; German or another European language is a plus.

Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take initiative, identify opportunities and enjoy turning ideas into action. You're comfortable taking ownership of your work and learning from results.

Strategic Curiosity: You're interested in understanding different markets, customer needs and buying behaviors. You enjoy using data and insights to improve your approach.

Outbound Confidence: You're comfortable reaching out to new prospects, handling objections and building relationships. You understand the fundamentals of structured outbound sales and know how to create opportunities from first conversations.

Growth Mindset & Ownership: You're eager to develop your skills, open to feedback and motivated to take on increasing responsibility as our international business grows.

Why us?

Our Sales-Team: 

At Building Radar, our Sales Team is at the forefront of connecting innovative technology with the people who can benefit from it. You'll engage with industry leaders, uncover their challenges and help them discover new ways to drive revenue through smarter sales processes.

As an International SDR, you won't just follow an existing playbook. You'll help improve it. You'll work closely with our Account Executives and Sales Team to explore international opportunities, exchange market insights and develop outbound approaches that deliver results. You'll have the opportunity to sharpen your sales skills while gaining hands-on experience in international go-to-market strategy, market development and sales technology.

Why Building Radar?

Shape the Revolution: Work with cutting-edge technology to drive the digital transformation of the construction industry and leave a lasting impact.

Worldwide Vibes: Join a highly motivated team of professionals from over 11 nations – we believe global diversity fuels creativity and innovation.

Hybrid Work Model: Enjoy the perfect balance of team spirit in our office and the flexibility of working from home.

title: IT-Leitung (m/w/d) für unsere Klinikkunden
description:
Du übernimmst die IT-Leitung bei einem unserer Klinikkunden und gestaltest sie langfristig. Vom ersten Tag an, mit voller Verantwortung.

Actura übernimmt operative Führungsfunktionen in Krankenhäusern und Reha-Kliniken. Unser Anspruch: Umsetzung statt Beratung. Dafür suchen wir erfahrene IT-Führungskräfte, die bei unseren Kunden die IT-Leitung übernehmen und dauerhaft Teil der Klinik werden.

Der Einstieg erfolgt oft in einer besonderen Lage: eine unbesetzte IT-Leitung, die Neuaufstellung nach einem Cyberangriff, die Vorbereitung auf NIS2- und KRITIS-Prüfungen, ein KIS-Wechsel oder die Integration nach einem Trägerwechsel. Du schaffst Klarheit, führst das Team und baust eine IT auf, die dauerhaft trägt.

Dein Job: Führen, wo es zählt.

- Du übernimmst als IT-Leitung die Verantwortung für IT-Betrieb, Team, Budget und Dienstleister beim Kunden

- Du verschaffst Dir in den ersten Wochen ein klares Lagebild und entwickelst mit der Geschäftsführung eine IT-Strategie mit belastbarem Maßnahmenplan

- Du führst und entwickelst das interne IT-Team, steuerst externe Partner und ordnest Verträge und Leistungen neu, wo es nötig ist

- Du verantwortest Informationssicherheit und Compliance: ISMS, NIS2, KRITIS und B3S, Meldewesen, Datenschutz und Prüfungen

- Du treibst die großen Themen: KIS-Wechsel, Rechenzentrums- und Cloudmigration, Telematikinfrastruktur, Digitalisierung und KHZG

- Du berichtest an Geschäftsführung und Gremien und arbeitest eng mit Betriebsrat, Datenschutz und den klinischen Bereichen zusammen

- Du baust Strukturen, Prozesse und Dokumentation so auf, dass die IT dauerhaft stabil und prüfungssicher läuft

Dein Profil: Erfahrung, Haltung, Führung.

- Du hast mehrjährige Führungserfahrung als IT-Leiter oder in vergleichbarer Verantwortung, idealerweise im Krankenhaus oder Gesundheitswesen

- Du bringst breites IT-Fachwissen mit: Infrastruktur, Netzwerk und Security genauso wie klinische Applikationen (KIS, PACS, Medizintechnik-Anbindung)

- Du kennst die regulatorischen Anforderungen an Kliniken (NIS2, BSIG und KRITIS, B3S, DSGVO) und hast Audits und Prüfungen verantwortet

- Du hast Budget- und Vertragsverantwortung getragen und verhandelst souverän mit Lieferanten

- Du findest Dich schnell in neue Organisationen ein, entscheidest klar und gewinnst das Vertrauen von Geschäftsführung, Ärzten und Pflege

- Du kommunizierst verständlich, setzt Dich mit Augenmaß durch und behältst auch in Krisen die Ruhe

- Du willst langfristig gestalten und bringst Dich vor Ort voll in die Klinik ein

Gute Gründe für Actura.

Umsetzung statt Beratung. 
Du trägst Verantwortung und setzt selbst um. Keine Folienschlachten, sondern Ergebnisse im Haus.

Von Kliniken für Kliniken. 
Ein Netzwerk aus Praktikern für Prozess, Personal, Controlling und IT, das den Krankenhausalltag kennt.

Perspektive. 
Eine langfristige Aufgabe beim Kunden, kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum, Actura mit aufzubauen.

Lust auf IT-Leitung mit Wirkung?

Dann bring Deine Erfahrung dort ein, wo sie gebraucht wird und dauerhaft wirkt. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Strategie & Konzeption

- Du analysierst die Performance von Creatives und Landingpages gemeinsam mit dem Performance-Team und leitest daraus Learnings, Iterationen und neue Konzepte ab.

- Du baust eine Wissensbasis auf: Was funktioniert bei welcher Zielgruppe, welche Hooks tragen, welche Formate skalieren.

title: Kosmetiker / Skin Therapist – Laser-Haarentfernung (NiSV) (m/w/d)
description:
Aever Clinics | München | Vollzeit oder Teilzeit

Du liebst Kosmetik, moderne Behandlungstechnologien und den persönlichen Kontakt mit Kund? Du möchtest hochwertige ästhetische Behandlungen durchführen, Menschen zu einem besseren Hautgefühl verhelfen und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams bei Aever Clinics in München!

Über Aever Clinics

Aever Clinics gehört zu einer wachsenden europäischen Klinikgruppe im Bereich Beauty, Hautgesundheit und ästhetische Behandlungen. Wir verbinden moderne Technologien, hochwertige Behandlungen und eine persönliche Betreuung, um unseren Kund erstklassige Ergebnisse zu ermöglichen.

Für unseren Standort in München suchen wir eine engagierte und kundenorientierte Kosmetikerin oder einen engagierten Kosmetiker, die oder der unser Team verstärkt und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.

Deine Aufgaben

Beratung und Kundenbetreuung

· Du führst professionelle Beratungsgespräche sowie Haut- und Körperanalysen durch.

· Du verstehst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unserer Kund und berätst sie zu geeigneten Behandlungen.

· Du erklärst Behandlungsabläufe, mögliche Ergebnisse und die richtige Nachsorge verständlich und kompetent.

· Du baust durch deine freundliche Art und deine fachliche Kompetenz langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.

Durchführung von Behandlungen

· Du führst Laser-Haarentfernungen sowie weitere Haut-, Körper- und ästhetische Behandlungen entsprechend deiner Qualifikation und unserer angebotenen Leistungen durch.

· Du arbeitest nach unseren Behandlungsstandards, Protokollen und Sicherheitsvorgaben.

· Du sorgst für eine angenehme Behandlungsatmosphäre sowie für höchste Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards.

· Du dokumentierst die Behandlungen sorgfältig und gibst deinen Kund passende Nachsorgeempfehlungen.

Qualität, Sicherheit und Geräte

· Du beachtest alle geltenden Sicherheits-, Hygiene- und Behandlungsrichtlinien.

· Du erkennst mögliche Kontraindikationen und klärst offene Fragen vor der Behandlung.

· Du setzt die Geräte fachgerecht und entsprechend deiner Schulungen ein.

· Du achtest auf die Einsatzbereitschaft der Behandlungsräume und Geräte und meldest technische Probleme zeitnah.

Kundenbindung und Teamarbeit

· Du sorgst für ein hochwertiges Kundenerlebnis vom ersten Beratungsgespräch bis zur Nachbetreuung.

· Du empfiehlst passende Behandlungspläne und Pakete auf Grundlage der individuellen Kundenbedürfnisse.

· Du trägst durch guten Service und kompetente Beratung zur Kundenzufriedenheit, Kundenbindung und zum Erfolg der Klinik bei.

· Du arbeitest eng mit dem Clinic Manager und dem gesamten Team zusammen und unterstützt einen reibungslosen Klinikalltag.

Das bringst du mit

· Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als staatlich anerkannte Kosmetiker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich Kosmetik, Hautpflege oder Ästhetik.

· Eine gültige NiSV-Fachkunde für die Anwendung nichtionisierender Strahlung zu kosmetischen Zwecken, insbesondere im Bereich optische Strahlung und Haarentfernung, ist erforderlich.

· Ein gültiger Lasersicherheitsschein ist erforderlich.

· Idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit Laser-Haarentfernung sowie weiteren apparativen oder ästhetischen Behandlungen.

· Interesse an moderner Hautpflege, innovativen Behandlungstechnologien und ästhetischen Dienstleistungen.

· Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

· Attraktives Bonussystem mit individuellem Umsatzbonus und zusätzlichem Team-Bonus.

title: Operation Specialist (M/W/D)
description:
Über SR Travel

Die SR Travel GmbH & Co. KG in Gießen ist ein internationaler Reiseveranstalter für Gruppenreisen, Lieferant für touristische Direktvertriebe sowie Incoming-Agentur für D & EU. Inspirierende Reisen mit echten Erlebnissen sind unser Spezialgebiet, und wir konzipieren sowie organisieren Groß- und Kleinserien, MICE-Projekte sowie maßgeschneiderte Gruppenreisen mit einem internationalen Netzwerk aus Hotels, DMCs, Beförderungsunternehmen und weiteren touristischen Leistungspartnern.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen sorgfältigen und zahlenaffinen Operations Specialist , der die operative Vorbereitung und Abwicklung unserer Gruppen- und Serienreisen unterstützt, reisebezogene Daten zuverlässig pflegt und zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und Systeme beiträgt.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Operative Reiseabwicklung und Saisonvorbereitung: Sie übernehmen die operative Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Gruppen- und Serienreisen im Backoffice. Vor Saisonbeginn schaffen Sie die erforderlichen Strukturen und Datengrundlagen für eine reibungslose Reiseabwicklung.

- Touren- und Systempflege: Sie legen einzelne Touren in unseren unternehmensspezifischen Systemen an und aktualisieren die relevanten reisebezogenen Daten während der laufenden Saison.

- Kontingent- und Leistungspflege: Sie prüfen und pflegen Kontingente, nehmen Hotelzuteilungen vor und legen Hotels, Nebenleistungsgeber sowie weitere touristische Leistungspartner in den eingesetzten Systemen an.

- Buchungs- und Teilnehmerdaten: Sie übertragen und pflegen Buchungsnummern, Gäste- und Teilnehmerzahlen sowie weitere für die Reiseabwicklung erforderliche Informationen. Dabei kontrollieren Sie die Daten auf Vollständigkeit und Plausibilität.

- Reiseunterlagen und Dokumentenmanagement: Sie erstellen, prüfen und versenden Teilnehmerlisten, Voucher und weitere Reiseunterlagen fristgerecht. Damit stellen Sie eine vollständige und korrekte Dokumentation entlang des gesamten Reiseverlaufs sicher.

- Listen und Datenauswertungen: Sie erstellen und pflegen operative Arbeitslisten in MS Excel beziehungsweise LibreOffice Calc . Umfangreiche Tabellen, Datenbestände, Formeln und Auswertungslogiken prüfen Sie sorgfältig auf Funktionalität und Richtigkeit.

- Operatives Tagesgeschäft: Sie bearbeiten kurzfristige Änderungen und übertragen diese zuverlässig in die relevanten Systeme, Listen und Reiseunterlagen. Offene operative Themen verfolgen Sie nach und koordinieren die notwendigen Maßnahmen mit den beteiligten Stellen.

- Klärungs- und Beschwerdefälle: Sie unterstützen bei der Bearbeitung operativer Klärungs- und Beschwerdefälle. Hierfür recherchieren und analysieren Sie Sachverhalte, identifizieren mögliche Fehlerquellen und wirken an geeigneten Lösungen mit.

- Prozess- und Tooloptimierung: Sie überprüfen bestehende Arbeitsabläufe, Datenstrukturen und eingesetzte Tools und zeigen Verbesserungspotenziale auf. Vorhandene Formeln und Auswertungslogiken in Excel beziehungsweise LibreOffice Calc passen Sie bei Bedarf an und entwickeln diese weiter.

- Import- und Datenübernahmeprozesse: Sie unterstützen bei der Anwendung, Prüfung und Weiterentwicklung von Importern. Bei Bedarf arbeiten Sie an der Optimierung bestehender oder an der Entwicklung neuer Import- und Datenübernahmeprozesse mit.

- Digitale und KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen: Sie bringen Ihr Interesse an digitalen Lösungen ein und unterstützen – soweit für das Aufgabengebiet sinnvoll – die Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung KI-gestützter Prozesse und Systeme.

- Cross-functional Collaboration: Sie arbeiten eng mit angrenzenden Fachbereichen und Abteilungen zusammen. Bei operativen, systemseitigen und prozessbezogenen Fragestellungen unterstützen Sie die beteiligten Teams und wirken an abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten mit.

Das bringen Sie mit

- Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder touristische Ausbildung, abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der kaufmännischen Sachbearbeitung; Erfahrung im Backoffice ist von Vorteil

- Erfahrung in der Tourismusbranche, insbesondere in der Abwicklung von Gruppen- oder Serienreisen, ist wünschenswert

- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Excel; Kenntnisse in LibreOffice Calc sind von Vorteil

- Sicherer Umgang mit umfangreichen Tabellen, Datenlisten, komplexen Formeln und Auswertungslogiken

- Ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität sowie ein gutes Verständnis für große Datenmengen, Zusammenhänge und Plausibilitäten

- Erfahrung mit datenbasierten Prozessen, Importen oder systemgestützter Datenpflege ist von Vorteil

- Erfahrung in Optimierungsprojekten oder bei der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Arbeitsabläufen ist wünschenswert

- Affinität zu digitalen Tools sowie Interesse an der praktischen Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung KI-gestützter Arbeitsweisen

- Sehr sorgfältige, genaue und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

Käufe wurden. Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen

The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

About the Role 

As the Manager of Applied AI Architects in Munich, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's Digital Native customers across the DACH region. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. You will remain accountable for the team's technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between regional strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching.

This role is based in Munich or Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will: 

- Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, creating an environment of technical excellence, sound judgment, continuous learning, accountability, and strong customer stewardship.

description:

About our technology 

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude 

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role 

We are seeking a Device Reliability Testing Engineer to drive reliability qualification, failure analysis, and accelerated life testing for our integrated graphene photonics products. In close collaboration with Design Enablement, Process Integration, and Product Quality, you will establish robust test methodologies to validate device reliability, and long-term stability in accordance with industry standards.

You will play a key role in transitioning our technology from prototype to production- qualified products, ensuring that graphene photonics meet the performance and robustness requirements of high-volume deployment.

To join our team, you should be excited to: 

- Design and execute wafer-level device reliability test plans for graphene- based photonic devices (DC bias, RF endurance, thermal cycling, long-term stability)

- Identify and investigate the physical mechanisms of graphene-related failure modes.

- Characterize and monitor key performance metrics, including extinction ratio, insertion loss, bandwidth retention, energy efficiency, dark current stability, responsivity degradation over device lifetime

- Drive structured root cause investigations using FMEA/8D methodologies and feed findings back to Design and Process teams

- Work together with product and quality teams to reach compliance with industry standards (JEDEC, OIF, IEC, IEEE) and generate qualification and reliability documentation

Your Qualifications 

- Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or Photonics Engineering

- Hands-on experience in semiconductor device physics, optoelectronics, or reliability engineering 

- Hands-on experience in photonic device characterization and reliability testing

- Experience with high-speed RF testing (>40 GHz) and VNA-based S- parameter measurements.

- Experience with advanced test equipment such as VNA, real-time and sampling oscilloscopes (50+ GHz), lightwave component analyzers (LCA), optical spectrum analyzers, and probe stations.

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial (f/m/d)
description:
About Cosuno 

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling Sales, Customer Success and Marketing with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission 

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial, you make sure every seat in Sales, Customer Success and Marketing goes to someone exceptional. You report to Fritz Cramer, Co-CEO, and work closely with our VP Sales, Head of SC Sales, Head of Customer Success and Marketing Lead. That means real ownership: you shape how Cosuno hires, not just who .

What you will achieve in your first 12 months 

- You hire 25 people across Account Executives, Customer Success and Inside Sales Managers, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

- You build warm pipelines before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

- You turn every role into a clear scorecard and give hiring managers structured interviews they actually use.

- You relaunch our referral programme and turn our team into our best talent scouts.

- You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.

What the job really looks like 

- A large part of your week is active sourcing and candidate conversations. If you prefer managing agencies, this role is not for you.

- You run several commercial processes in parallel, with ambitious hiring managers who want great people fast.

- There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire.

- You push back when a profile or a decision is not right. We want you to.

What you bring 

- At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, hiring SDRs and Account Executives.

- A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling.

- Proven sourcing skills: you have filled roles through direct outreach and can show what worked.

- Structured assessment: you run scorecard-based interviews and can tell real sales talent from a good pitch.

- Strong closing skills: you win top candidates against competing offers and counteroffers.

- Strong stakeholder management: you advise hiring managers and challenge them when it matters.

- Fluent German and English, written and spoken.

Nice to have 

- Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha.

- You use AI tools and automation in sourcing and outreach.

- Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries.

What we offer 

- Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

- AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay and Lusha, and you have a budget to test new tools.

- Learning budget for your professional development.

- Time off: 25-30 vacation days per year.

- Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours.

- A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events.

- Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company.

Our hiring process (max. 3 weeks) 

- Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video.

- Career deep-dive with Fritz (Co-CEO) 30 minutes, video.

- Live case study: together with two of our hiring managers (Basti, Kornelius or Caspar), you work through a sourcing case for a fictional SDR role, 60 minutes, preferably in our Berlin office.

- References: with your consent only, we speak with 2–3 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles.

- Offer.

From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 3 weeks.

Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead

We welcome applications from everyone who brings the skills for this role, regardless of background or circumstances. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

This is a greenfield build with real design freedom: you shape the architecture, the golden paths and the self-service capabilities - not just keep existing systems running. Your platform will serve roughly 175 services from 13 product teams in our European and North American regions. Today they run on more than a dozen Kubernetes clusters with around 280 nodes and 4,000 running pods - migrating them step by step onto the new platform while everything keeps running is a core part of the mission.

- Build the next-generation cloud-native platform on AWS - you own the architecture and design decisions from day one

- Work closely with development teams to understand their needs and continuously improve the developer experience

- Solid experience with AWS and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)

- In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes, Linux and containers

- Strong software engineering skills - you write production-grade code in a language such as Go, Python or TypeScript, building platform services and APIs, not just infrastructure scripts

title: Senior Account Executive, DACH (German-speaking, Hamburg)
company: Senior Software Engineer, Gamified Security Awareness (Full-Stack)
description:
Our mission and why it matters 

We are on a mission to make humans the strongest security layer.

Human risk remains one of the biggest vulnerabilities and traditional awareness training is not enough. We take a different approach by combining AI-driven personalization, real threat detection, and behavioral science to actively protect people and organizations.

We don't just simulate risks. We build the tools that detect and stop them.

Why this role matters 

The DACH region is currently our largest growth market in EMEA, generating an incredible amount of pipeline. With a highly certified product and an exceptional service that customers genuinely love, we have laid a strong foundation. We are now looking for a highly self-motivated Senior Account Executive who excels at taking those enterprise opportunities, multi-threading to economic buyers, and guiding them successfully through complex procurement cycles. You will be joining a team that has already proven it can support companies in seeing the value of the service, making this a prime opportunity to drive significant revenue rather than a speculative territory. Crucially, as our business results grow, you will be instrumental in helping us lay the groundwork for our future local hub in the Hamburg area.

What you’ll own and drive 

You will take full ownership of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts in the DACH market, expertly guiding deals from initial pipeline through complex procurement to closed-won. Driving multi-threaded deals is second nature to you, as you reach economic buyers early and confidently hold the line on price objections. You will lead POC-led selling initiatives with real, concrete exit criteria to ensure successful outcomes, all while partnering closely with an SDR to prioritize opportunities and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene with customer-owned next steps.

What success looks like 

• In your first 3 months you'll be fully onboarded, deeply understand our qualification framework, and have a few opportunities moving past the initial stages with real, dated next steps. 

• By month 6, you'll operate independently, managing an active pipeline, progressing opportunities consistently to late stage pipeline, and building your new business ARR towards quota.

What makes you thrive here 

You have native-level or full business proficiency in German, alongside strong working proficiency in English, and several years of experience as a closing AE in B2B SaaS. Specifically, you have a proven track record of taking deals through procurement in fast-paced software or licensing sales, rather than just generating them. You bring a strong commercial backbone and comfort with multi-threading to an economic buyer before a proposal ever goes out. Above all, you have a team-first mindset with forecast honesty—you own your pipeline and embrace a collaborative, winning-together attitude.

You are a true self-starter who is phenomenal at what you currently do, taking pride in driving significant impact as a senior individual contributor.

To support our near-future vision of opening a physical hub in Germany, we are looking for candidates who are ideally already based in the wider Hamburg region.

Bonus points if you also bring experience with 3 to 6 month enterprise buying cycles and committees, or prior exposure to regulated DACH verticals like manufacturing, healthcare, or financial services. A background in cybersecurity, GRC, or compliance software is highly valued, as is a habit of leveraging technology creatively in your daily workflow.

Who you’ll work with 

You will be a key part of our EMEA Sales Team, reporting to our EMEA Head of Sales. This DACH-focused role is working in a highly supportive AE group focusing on the EMEA market. We are committed to a collaborative culture but you will also be given independence to run your opportunities. You will find a team that asks for something back on every concession, owns their forecast misses honestly, and truly lives by a team-first standard that shows up in how we actually operate, rather than just as an aspiration on a slide.

What you can expect from us 

• Compensation: Monthly fixed base salary of € 6000 - € 7000 depending on your experience (plus a 50/50 base and commission model featuring accelerated earnings for the first 12 months). You may notice varying salary ranges for roles with similar titles across Hoxhunt; this is because each range is grounded in our role leveling and reflects the seniority, scope, and impact expectations required for that specific role and team, and we operate with a low hierarchy. 

• Working ways: You will start by working remotely from the Hamburg region. However, as we are planning to build a hub in Hamburg in the near future, this will eventually transform into a hybrid role. You will enjoy a flexible work setting with opportunities to travel and connect with the broader team. 

• High performance meets high humanity: We bring an incredibly driven, high-impact energy to our work, but we leave our egos at the door. You will be surrounded by wildly talented, dedicated colleagues in an environment built on extreme kindness, support, and psychological safety. 

• Authentic trust & autonomy: We hire great people and trust them to do great work. You will find a culture free of micromanagement, giving you the autonomy to take real ownership, drive impact, and shape things early on. 

• A product you can be proud of: It is incredibly rare in cybersecurity to build a multi-award-winning product that end-users genuinely love. You will join a fast-paced, technically sophisticated team making a real, measurable impact against cybercrime, backed by strong financial stability and growth. 

• The perks that matter: Alongside this amazing community, you will enjoy extensive healthcare with other benefits tailored for our team in Germany.

To ensure your personal data is handled securely and in compliance with GDPR, we only accept applications submitted through our application form. We cannot process applications sent via other channels, such as email or LinkedIn messages.

Our Recruitment Process 

- Interview with Talent Acquisition (remote, 30 min) 

- Interview with EMEA Head of Sales (remote, 45 min) 

- Take-home assignment and panel (on-site in Helsinki, 90 min) 

- Reference checks and offer

About Hoxhunt 

Hoxhunt was founded in 2016 by four visionaries. Today we are a global team of +300 amazing Hoxhunters advancing a truly AI-native category leader in human risk management, with key hubs in the United States, the United Kingdom, Singapore, and Finland. We are proud to be an award-winning, fast-growing software company, recognized by G2 and Gartner, named to TIME Magazine's list of the World's Top EdTech Companies, and featured for our innovation in major publications like Fast Company, TechCrunch, Forbes, and Inc.

As a multi-product company, Hoxhunt goes beyond traditional security awareness. We don't just educate employees through frequent, personalized, and behavior-changing cybersecurity training - we also actively build real threat intelligence and response tools that protect organizations against malicious cyberattacks every single day.

Be among the first to know about our open positions. Drop your details in our Talent Community, and we will reach out when there is a match!

title: Director of Cloud infrastructure and security
description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective. 

About the Role: 

Vestiaire Collective runs a global marketplace on AWS and GCP — Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, a large PHP application under active modernisation, a series of microservices in different tech stacks (Goland, PHP, Node) and a fast-growing surface of AI-powered services. 

As Director of Cloud Infrastructure and Security , you will lead a small team of six senior individual contributors across Cloud Infrastructure (DevOps/SRE) and Security. This is a hands-on Director role : alongside setting the strategy and roadmap, you will work directly with the team on architecture, technical decisions, incidents and delivery. You will be accountable, alongside Product Development teams, for the reliability, cost-efficiency and security posture of everything we run in production. 

What you will do: 

Leadership across two teams 

- 
Directly lead, develop and retain a small team of six (6) experienced engineers across Cloud Infrastructure and Security. This is a player-coach role without multiple management layers, so you will remain close to the team’s technical work and day-to-day priorities. 

- 
Define a joint roadmap for both teams, aligned to business priorities and risk appetite, and make explicit calls on what we will not do. 

- 
Establish clear KPIs, SLOs and risk metrics, and report regularly to leadership on reliability, cost and security posture. 

- 
Set the operating model: what product teams self-serve behind guardrails versus what your teams own centrally. 

- 
Foster a culture where reliability and security are shared accountabilities, not tickets thrown over a wall, including establishing a Security Champions model across engineering. 

Cloud infrastructure, reliability and platform 

- 
Own our AWS and GCP footprint end to end: EKS, networking, secrets (Vault), data stores (RDS/Aurora, MSK, ElastiCache, MongoDB Atlas, OpenSearch) and the edge (Cloudflare). 

- 
Establish real reliability engineering practice: SLOs and error budgets, capacity planning, and a business continuity plan. 

- 
Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity: Automating Terraform change application, advancing our move to GitOps (ArgoCD), and enforcing guardrails at creation time with policy-as-code (Kyverno/OPA) so provisioning is safe, self-serve and reviewable. 

- 
Consolidate observability into a single source of truth for metrics, logs and traces. 

- 
Improve developer experience and delivery throughput: CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), paved roads, test environments on demand, and delivery metrics that hold up. 

- 
Own FinOps : infrastructure cost per unit of business value, cost accountability pushed back to each team, and continued run-rate reduction. Cost discipline is a first-class objective.

title: Senior Growth Analyst, User Acquisition
description:
Who we are 

JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business, from the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events and best-selling console games. We also own the world's largest streaming guide, giving us unique insights into audience behaviours and content tastes.

From a small startup, we've evolved into a team of more than 200 people, based in Berlin, around the world or working remotely. We've built a profitable business while continuing to grow.

Who we need 

We are looking for a Senior Growth Analyst with at least 3 years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing analytics. You will support growth across JustWatch TV and our streaming guide, with the main focus on JustWatch TV.

You will partner with our marketing, campaign, product and Business Intelligence teams to understand which acquisition activity brings valuable users, improve confidence in measurement and testing, and turn findings into budget and campaign decisions.

What you will be doing 

- Analyse user acquisition performance across channels, markets and audiences, and recommend where to scale, adjust or stop spending.

- 
Develop our attribution approach and interpret MMP and ad platform reporting. Work with BI and technical teams to define conversion events, validate tracking and resolve data discrepancies. You will lead analytical requirements and validation; technical teams own implementation.

- 
Analyse acquisition cohorts, activation, retention, subscription conversion and revenue alongside LTV, CAC, ROAS and payback periods. Make assumptions explicit and use findings to guide acquisition and bidding targets.

- 
Design and evaluate A/B tests, holdouts and incrementality tests with the marketing team. Distinguish attributed conversions from incremental impact and turn findings into practical recommendations.

- 
Build benchmarks, forecasts, dashboards and efficient reporting to guide planning, budgets and growth targets, working with BI to keep KPI definitions consistent and data reliable.

- 
Support selected client campaign analyses and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, prioritising work that improves decisions and performance.

What we need from you 

- 
Essential experience 

- 
At least 3 years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing analytics, ideally in an app, subscription or digital consumer business.

- 
A strong understanding of mobile analytics, including attribution, conversion events, measurement limitations and discrepancies between data sources.

- 
An understanding of paid acquisition channels such as Meta, TikTok and Google, their optimisation goals and performance metrics.

- 
Experience analysing acquisition funnels, retention cohorts and unit economics to assess user value beyond installs or initial conversions.

- 
Confident working with spreadsheets, BI tools and data from multiple sources.

- 
The ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations, challenge assumptions constructively and prioritise independently.

- 
Excellent written and spoken English.

Useful extras 

- 
Hands-on experience with mobile measurement partners such as AppsFlyer or Adjust.

- 
Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, holdouts or incrementality tests.

- 
SQL or Python.

- 
Experience with CTV app measurement, ASO or CRM and lifecycle analytics.

- 
German language skills.

What we offer you 

- 
An open-minded, international team that enjoys collaborating to reach shared goals.

- 
Meaningful work, opportunities for personal growth and the chance to make a lasting impact.

- 
A permission-less environment where you can take ownership and focus on delivering value without unnecessary complexity.

- 
Trust in your expertise and judgement, with room to improve how we work and bring new ideas.

- 
A collaborative and supportive environment that helps you achieve your personal and professional goals.

- 
A flexible hybrid working environment, with no requirement to come to the office.

Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality. 

If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

- A company culture that really works 

- Audience as a Service 

- Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog 

How to apply 

Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.

Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.

If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.

Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

title: Standortentwickler (m/w/d)
description:
„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig.

Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest.

Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis.

Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Deine Mission

Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr:

- Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen.
- Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt.
- Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung.
- Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst.
- Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark.
- Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach.
- Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich.
Was du mitbringst

- Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet.
- Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden.
- Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen.
- Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen.
- Führung – Du hast Teams aufgebaut und geführt und weißt, wie man aus Einzelpersonen eine Mannschaft macht.
- Zahlenverständnis – Budget, Deckungsbeitrag, Auslastung – du steuerst mit Kennzahlen und nicht nach Gefühl.
- Qualifikation – Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung – betriebswirtschaftlich, pädagogisch, sozial oder etwas ganz anderes. Entscheidend ist, was du bewegt hast.
- Persönlichkeit – Gründergeist, Ausdauer, Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Unsicherheit aus, bleibst dran, wenn es zäh wird, und feierst, wenn der erste Teilnehmende einen Arbeitsvertrag unterschreibt.
Was wir dir geben

- Gewinnbeteiligung – Du baust den Standort auf – und du bist am Gewinn beteiligt, den er erwirtschaftet. Die Details klären wir im Gespräch, offen und transparent.
- Freiheit – Du entscheidest vor Ort. Wir geben dir Ziele, keine Mikro-Anweisungen. Entscheidungen fallen bei uns schnell – 70 Prozent Informationslage reichen.
- Rückendeckung – Du startest nicht bei null: Zertifizierung und Qualitätsmanagement, erprobte Maßnahmenkonzepte, Verwaltung, Buchhaltung, Marketing und 15 Jahre Erfahrung im Ausschreibungsgeschäft stehen hinter dir.
- Direkter Draht – Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung der Gruppe zusammen – kurze Wege, schnelle Antworten.
- Perspektive – Wer Berlin aufbaut, leitet Berlin. Die Standortleitung ist der logische nächste Schritt.
- Sinn – Jeder Mensch, den dein Standort in Arbeit bringt, ist dein Ergebnis. Das sieht man – jeden Tag.
- Corporate Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Weil wir auch an deine Zukunft denken.
Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis

Klingt nach dir? Dann erzähl uns in deiner Bewerbung vor allem eins: Was hast du schon aufgebaut – und wie würdest du in Berlin anfangen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Diese Stelle wird zentral von der IWQ Holding GmbH ausgeschrieben. Die Anstellung erfolgt bei der für den Standort Berlin zuständigen operativen Tochtergesellschaft der EuBiA-Gruppe.

Bei uns zählt der Mensch: Bewerbungen sind unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Identität oder einer Behinderung ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Software Engineer, AI Enablement
description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic! 

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role 

We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer, AI Enablement to help Tailscale's engineering organization get the most out of AI-assisted development. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools.

Key Responsibilities 

- Partner with engineering leadership and Tailscale's technical staff to define and drive our internal AI-enablement roadmap.

- Work closely with the team building Aperture by Tailscale, our AI gateway used both internally and offered as a product.

- Build and iterate on the tools, workflows, and shared practices that help engineers get real value from coding agents — and evaluate new models and tools, making clear calls on what we adopt.

- Partner with engineering and non-engineering teams to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI — this is a support function, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built.

- Establish the guardrails, review practices, and documentation that make AI-generated code safe to ship, and act as the internal advocate who helps teams adopt good practices without mandating a single tool.

- Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on velocity and quality, and report back to leadership.

What We Are Looking For 

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use

- Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation

- Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling

- A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate.

- Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team

- Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap

Nice to Have

- Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling

- Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents

- Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python

- Background in security or code-review practices — helpful for reasoning about AI/agent-generated code, though you don't need to be a security engineer

- Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption

- Technical project management experience

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

UK Pay Range

£128,770 — £178,540 GBP 

What We Offer 

- An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.

- A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).

- Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!

- Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.

- Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.

- Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration. 

- Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 

- Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! 

- A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. 

- Paid parental leave program . We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter. 

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

tem is rebuilding the energy transaction - transparent, fair and built on trust. Behind that mission is a company growing fast, and a Performance team that's already lean and stretched. description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams 

Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model.

The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software.

🧠 Your day-to-day 

You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. title: Research Scientist, Protein Design & Engineering
description:
About us 

We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient.

If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it.

We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK.

The role 

You'll engineer proteins to carry out useful chemistry, combining enzyme discovery, directed evolution, and experimental characterisation. You'll own the experimental cycle: choosing starting points, building variant libraries, developing screens, and establishing which changes improve function and why.

This is a hands-on role working closely with our computational and ML teams. You'll test designed proteins at the bench, use experimental results to guide subsequent rounds, and develop enzymes with the activity, selectivity, and stability needed for their intended application. There’s no fixed screening pipeline to inherit — you'll help decide how we build it.

What you'll do 

- Design and run protein engineering campaigns, from initial enzyme selection and library design through screening and characterisation of improved variants.

- Build and express variant libraries using site-directed, random, and combinatorial mutagenesis.

- Develop assays and high-throughput screens that reliably measure the properties we're trying to improve.

- Express, purify, and characterise proteins, measuring kinetics, substrate scope, selectivity, and stability under relevant reaction conditions.

- Work with computational scientists to test proposed designs, interpret successes and failures, and use the results to guide the next round.

- Develop enzymatic reactions and cascades, identifying how enzyme performance, cofactors, and reaction conditions affect overall productivity.

Essential experience 

We're interested in the engineering campaigns you've run, the assays you've built, and what you learned from them. We care about:

- A track record of improving protein or enzyme function through directed evolution or rational engineering.

- Practical fluency in molecular biology, including cloning, library construction, mutagenesis, and recombinant protein expression.

- Experience developing and troubleshooting enzyme assays and screening workflows, with appropriate controls and follow-up validation.

- A solid grasp of enzyme mechanism, kinetics, and structure–function relationships, and the ability to use these to guide experiments.

- Experience independently taking projects through multiple design–build–test cycles and explaining what drove the results.

Highly preferred 

- Experience with industrial biocatalysis or engineering enzymes for demanding reaction conditions.

- Experience integrating liquid handling and laboratory automation with high-throughput screening.

- Familiarity with biosensor-based screens, growth-based selection, or FACS.

- Experience testing computationally designed proteins and feeding experimental results back into design.

- Experience with enzyme cascades, fermentation, or transferring enzymatic processes from the bench to larger scales.

Logistics 

This is a full-time, on-site role in Cambridge, MA. Compensation is highly competitive. We're also able to sponsor visas for the right candidate.

As Market Lead, you will shape how we take that model to UKI clients: what we sell, how we price it, and how we staff and deliver it. You will lead a core team of 5–6 direct reports and a wider matrix of around 50-75 people across UKI, and you will help them build the skills this shift requires. Commercial and solutioning

- Frame and test business-outcome hypotheses with executives, and define thin slices of delivery that prove value quickly.

- You stay close enough to delivery to know what is realistic, and you share accountability for outcomes on the deals you sell.

- Shift the practice's capability mix towards production AI engineering and agentic delivery, through hiring, reskilling and role-based onboarding.

title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Billère)
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision 

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

🤝 Process de recrutement

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu 

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: 

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s 

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires). 

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @ pennylane.com ou ----- . 

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement. 

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement ." 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps. 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles 

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : 
Notre data policy 

🇬🇧 Personal Data 

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten 

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 

🇪🇸 Datos personales 

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información
