- Being the first People team hire and building from scratch sounds more exciting than maintaining an established playbook.

- Working closely with the Head of People, challenging ideas, and learning through real ownership.

- Finding exceptional talent and building trusted partnerships with hiring managers.

- Solving ambiguous business and people problems with speed, curiosity, and pragmatism.

- Creating better employee experiences, growth opportunities, and ways of working.

- Taking initiative, juggling priorities, and seeing the impact of your work directly.

Responsibilities 

Talent Acquisition 

- Own end-to-end hiring across teams, including role definition, Talent Mapping, sourcing, interviews, candidate management, offers, and closing.

- Be a true advisor to hiring managers on hiring strategy, market realities, candidate quality, and trade-offs.

- Build proactive pipelines and deliver a thoughtful, responsive candidate experience.

- Improve hiring processes, ATS workflows, reporting, and recruitment analytics.

Employee Experience & Development 

- Co-build onboarding, employee experience, engagement, culture, and development initiatives with the Head of People.

- Help implement performance reviews, feedback practices, career development, and manager enablement.

- Listen to employee and manager needs, identify friction, and turn insights into practical improvements.

People Operations & Business Partnership 

- Help build scalable People processes, policies, systems, and employee lifecycle workflows from the ground up.

- Support managers with pragmatic, business-aware advice and thoughtful people decisions.

- Contribute to projects across organizational design, compensation, HR operations, and People analytics as your scope grows.

- Spot problems early, propose solutions, and own implementation rather than waiting for instructions.

What Excites Us 

- Professional proficiency in German.

- Strong end-to-end Talent Acquisition experience and evidence of independently delivering high-quality hires.

- Ambition to pivot into a broader People role; previous generalist experience is not required.

- A builder and problem-solver who acts quickly, thinks critically, and takes ownership through execution.

- Business acumen and confidence to challenge, influence, and advise hiring managers and leaders.

- Comfort with ambiguity, high expectations, multiple priorities, and hands-on work.

- Excellent communication, judgment, organization, and stakeholder management.

- Curiosity, humility, and willingness to learn new People disciplines.

Nice to Have 

- Knowledge of Swiss employment and labour law.

- Exposure to employee development, performance management, or employee engagement.

- Experience in a startup or scale-up and familiarity with ATS, HRIS, or People analytics.

Hiring Process 

Our hiring process typically takes 2–4 weeks across four stages:

- Recruiter Interview: 30-minute introductory conversation with the People team.

- Deep dive: Conversation with the Head of People about recruitment, business partnership, and growth ambitions.

- Practical case 1: Step by Step on how to fill the Head of People role.

- On-site : Final stage in our Zürich office to explore mutual fit.

Our Values 

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team.

- In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive.

- Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve.

- Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious.

- Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems.

- Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another.

title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

What you’ll do

- Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

- Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

- Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

- Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

- Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

- Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

What you'll bring

- Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

- Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

- Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

- NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

- JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

- A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

- Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

- A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

- Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have: 

- Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

- Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

- Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

- Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer 

- Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

- Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

- Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer 

- Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

- Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

- Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP 

- Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

- Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

- Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

- Team: regular team events.

Practical information

- Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

- If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

- Employment: full-time, permanent.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation and control stack of the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Our technology enables effective and reliable operation, monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices — which will one day provide clean, practically limitless power to the grid. We have spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and have just completed our pre-seed fundraise.

We are looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to join our founding team in Lausanne and help build our core technology.

This job is for you if you are a passionate engineer with deep knowledge cutting across real-time / embedded systems, software and hardware, and excited about building the systems to monitor and control real-world fusion plasmas.

Tasks

- Implement real-time control, analysis, data acquisition systems in the kHz to MHz range, as individual contributor and in a team.

- Integrate solutions across a variety of company products and services as well as on our in-house test beds.

- Provide technical leadership within a growing real-time control and software engineering team that you will help to build.

- Translate customer needs into requirements and specifications.

Requirements

- Experience taking hard-real-time acquisition and control loops from incomplete requirements through to commissioning on hardware, in domains such as automotive, robotics, embedded, electrical and/or scientific instrumentation.

- ‘Full stack’: familiarity with all aspects of real-time technologies, from physical/DAQ, real-time software frameworks and middleware, real-time OS and integration.

- Fluency in a mix of high-level and low-level languages such as C, C++, Rust, MATLAB/Simulink, Python. Obsession with code quality, testing and reliability.

- Experience with distributed real-time systems, real-time networking and field buses and/or SCADA is an advantage.

- Experience with embedded/μC/FPGA technologies and/or safety critical systems is an advantage.

Benefits

- The unique opportunity to play a foundational role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

- The opportunity to build cutting edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

- Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.

- Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance.

If you are excited about joining our team, send your CV including information about a real-time system you have taken into operation. We're looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About Us: 

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the role: 

As a Site Reliability Engineer at DeepJudge, you own the reliability of the systems that leading law firms depend on every day. We run our AI search platform in dedicated production environments, each a large-scale search and retrieval system operating at very high data volumes, alongside our ingestion pipelines and data stores, on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds. Keeping those environments fast, available, and trustworthy is a genuine engineering challenge, and it's your mission.

This is a technical, infrastructure-focused role: you'll spend your time in systems, code, and telemetry. You'll harden the platform so that classes of failure can't recur, build observability and SLOs to let us see problems before they surface, plan capacity ahead of relentless data growth, and automate away the toil of safely operating many production environments. You'll work across our deployment and infrastructure-as-code and partner closely with product engineering to feed reliability learnings back into the platform. If you like operating serious distributed systems at scale and turning firefighting into engineered reliability, this role is for you.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Owning the availability, latency and performance of our production environments: large-scale search and retrieval services, ingestion and data stores on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds

- Owning the cloud infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds, networking, identity and access, compute and storage, and managing cloud capacity, quotas and cost as the fleet grows

- Improving deployment and infrastructure through code: GitOps-based configuration and deployment and infrastructure-as-code across our public and private clouds, with safe, previewed, recoverable production changes

- Defining and instrumenting SLOs and error budgets and building the dashboards, metrics and alerting that make production observable and actionable

- Reducing operational toil through automation and internal tooling written in Python and / or Go

- Provisioning and standardizing new production environments to a defined reliability bar

You're a great fit if you: 

- Have 3+ years in SRE, production / platform engineering, or infrastructure-heavy software engineering, operating real production systems under reliability expectations

- Are strong at container-orchestration operations in production and comfortable on at least one major public cloud

- Have solid cloud infrastructure experience on a major public cloud and a working grasp of cloud capacity, quotas, and cost

- Practice observability hands-on with metrics, logs and traces, and use it to root-cause live incidents

- Work fluently with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps

- Can code in Python and / or Go for automation, tooling, and reading and patching service code.

- Bring sound production judgment and document your work clearly for other engineers

- Bonus: experience operating a large-scale search or distributed data system, database operations, dedicated / enterprise-deployed software, or AI / enterprise-search infrastructure in regulated domains

What you can look forward to: 

- Owning the reliability of systems that the world's leading law firms rely on: real scale, real impact

- Deep, hands-on work with modern infrastructure: distributed search at very large scale, container orchestration across multiple clouds, and a mature infrastructure-as-code and GitOps stack

- A rigorous, high-urgency engineering culture founded by ex-Google search engineers and ETH Zurich AI PhDs

- The chance to build the reliability discipline, SLOs, incident practice, automation, from a strong foundation, not inherit a rigid one

- A collaborative team in Zurich shaping how AI transforms professional knowledge work

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

title: Scientific Account Executive
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers — from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs.

The day-to-day:

- Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing

- Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform

- Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

- Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected

- Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts — new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns

title: Senior Cosmetic Chemist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Cosmetic Chemist for our KEUNE Beauty Solutions team. You combine excellent formulation skills with the confidence to tackle development projects independently. You will remain closely involved in hands-on laboratory work while taking responsibility for assigned projects, guiding fellow medior and junior chemists, and working directly with clients and cross-functional teams to bring high-performing products to market.

At KEUNE, we develop and manufacture not only our own professional haircare products but also products for KEUNE Beauty Solutions (KBS), our private label division. Through KBS, we partner with beauty brands worldwide, offering end-to-end solutions from formulation development and manufacturing to the delivery of finished products.

MISSION 

- Lead assigned new product development projects from brief to commercialization, taking ownership of technical execution, deliverables, timelines, and follow-up in line with the NPD process.

- Develop and optimize haircare, hairstyling, and hair color formulations through hands-on laboratory work, ensuring product performance, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.

- Act as technical reference for assigned projects: review client briefs, clarify requirements, identify risks, and translate expectations into a clear development plan.

- Participate in and lead technical discussions with clients, working alongside Project Management and Commercial teams to align expectations, feasibility, and next steps.

- Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level chemists working on shared projects, while maintaining ownership for project outcomes.

- Plan, organize, execute, document, and follow up on submissions, stability, safety, and performance testing, ensuring decisions and results are properly tracked. 

- Proactively identify potential delays or technical challenges, communicate them early, and drive practical solutions with the relevant stakeholders.

- Support scale-up, first production runs, and troubleshooting in collaboration with Production and Quality Control.

- Stay informed about market trends, emerging ingredients, and technologies, and turn insights into relevant innovation concepts and proposals for clients.

- Apply appropriate instrumental and analytical methods to evaluate formulations, substantiate performance, and support technical decisions.

YOU 

- Master's degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, or a related field.

- At least 7 years of relevant cosmetic formulation and development experience, with strong expertise in hair products.

- A proven track record of developing and successfully launching cosmetic products.

- Strong hands-on formulation skills, paired with the ability to organize and tackle multiple development activities.

- A proactive, independent, and accountable working style: you take initiative, follow through on commitments, and know when to escalate issues.

- Confidence in leading technical client conversations, challenging or clarifying briefs constructively, and managing expectations together with cross-functional colleagues.

- Ability to guide junior and mid-level chemists.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

- Curiosity about innovation, new ingredients, and opportunities to improve products and ways of working.

- Eligible to work in the Netherlands

OUR OFFER 

- A sustainably-conscious employer;

- Travel allowance 

- 27 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment);

- Relocation support 

- A good pension plan;

- A competitive salary;

- 8% holiday pay;

- And never have a "bad hair day" again thanks to staff discounts on the entire Keune collection!

- Attention to your mental well-being through unlimited access to OpenUp

- Participation in group classes at Personal Fitness Soest

KEUNE 

We are a family business with a long-term vision, where science is at the heart of everything we do. Our story begins in 1922, in Amsterdam. Today, KEUNE belongs to one of the fastest growing brands in professional hair care products. From our headquarters in Soest, KEUNE products are developed, produced and distributed worldwide to more than 85 countries. And we have no intention of slowing down! Every year we open a new site of our own. We produce in a sustainable and animal-friendly way and are B Corp-certified. But KEUNE is not just about creating beautiful products - it's about our story and our vision.  KEUNE is led by Philip Berlijn, who is focused on building a strong brand and creating a corporate culture that is all about collaboration, sustainability and showing character

title: Strategic Partnerships Lead
description:
About DataSnipper

Audit is the bedrock of the global economy. DataSnipper builds the AI that auditors and finance teams rely on to do that work with confidence: agents designed around how audits are actually performed, a platform firms trust with their most sensitive client evidence, and a team built around former auditors who know the work firsthand. We want to define how the profession works in the age of AI.

More than 600,000 professionals across 175 countries use DataSnipper, including all Big Four firms, Fortune 500 companies, and government agencies. In 2025 alone, we delivered over $1.4 billion in productivity savings for our customers. Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners, we are one of the fastest-growing companies in AI for audit, and the fastest-growing tech company in the Netherlands two years running.

Everything we build starts from one principle: AI in audit has to be something professionals can trust, verify, and defend. Joining now means helping lead the profession's shift from manual testing to agentic execution.

The Rol e

Partnerships are one of DataSnipper's most important growth levers. Across every major market, the consulting firms, technology platforms, and professional networks that organizations rely on shape which technologies their teams and clients adopt. As AI changes how audit work gets done, those partners are deciding who to build with.

As Strategic Partnerships Lead, you will lead, build, and launch DataSnipper's partnerships across Europe and the wider EMEA region, spanning our consulting alliances, key technology partners, and strategic relationships across the audit ecosystem and beyond. Our European ecosystem already includes relationships with leading consulting firms and regional networks. Your job is to scale it, and to build what comes next: new partner programs, new markets, and new commercial models.

This is an entrepreneurial, quota-carrying role with a broad remit and room to build. You will report to the Global Partnerships Leader and work closely with our EMEA Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams.

What You Will Work On

- Own and grow a portfolio of strategic partners across Europe, including consulting firms, technology platforms, and regional networks, and act as their senior counterpart at DataSnipper.

- Scale existing partnerships into multi-country programs, and launch new ones market by market, adapting to local regulatory, commercial, and cultural nuances.

- Source, assess, and close new partnerships, from referral and co-sell arrangements to resell models, prioritized against DataSnipper's growth goals.

- Work with consulting partners to help them advise their clients on bringing AI into audit and finance, with DataSnipper at the center of that work.

- Build joint go-to-market plans with each partner, covering account mapping, co-selling, events, and executive engagement, that turn relationships into pipeline and closed revenue.

- Deepen key technology partnerships across the region to unlock co-sell, marketplace, and joint solution opportunities.

- Create the enablement, playbooks, and co-marketing assets partners need to position and deliver DataSnipper with confidence.

- Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue targets, and report on performance with clear, honest data.

- Bring partner feedback from across Europe back into DataSnipper, so what you hear in the field shapes product, packaging, and pricing.

- Be a visible face of DataSnipper across the region, at partner summits, field events, and industry forums.

- Willingness to embrace global business and travel.

What You Bring

- 5 to 7 years of experience in partnerships, business development, or a senior commercial role, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, or financial technology.

- A proven track record of independently managing and growing complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships from identification through to revenue impact.

- Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to negotiate partnership structures, co-sell agreements, and commercial terms with senior counterparts.

- Experience building joint go-to-market programs and driving pipeline through partner channels across more than one European market.

- Excellent relationship-building and influencing skills, with the credibility to work as a peer with firm leadership, from alliance leads to managing directors and partners.

- Existing relationships with consulting firm leadership in Europe are a strong advantage.

How You Work

- Entrepreneurial. When you spot a gap, you build what fills it, playbook or not.

- High standards. You hold yourself, and the partners you work with, to a high bar.

- Close to the work. You dig into how audit gets done, how firms make decisions, and where AI changes the economics.

- Accountable. You measure yourself by results, and you own them when they fall short.

- Fast and rigorous. You move quickly without cutting corners, because in audit the details matter.

- Generous with your team. You share what you learn, give credit freely, and make the people and partners around you better.

Why This Role, Why Now

- Momentum: Used across the world's leading audit institutions, including all Big Four firms. A $100M Series B led by Index Ventures at a $1B valuation, building on earlier investment from Insight Partners. Ranked #1 on the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 in 2023 and 2024, named to the Forbes Fintech 50 for 2026, and one of the fastest-growing companies in AI for audit.

- Extraordinary team: Former Big Four auditors and audit leaders, AI engineers and researchers, and operators who have scaled category-defining software companies. Headquartered in Amsterdam, with teams across New York, Asia Pacific, and Latin America. You will be surrounded by people who are exceptional at what they do and generous with what they know.

- Scope: You will shape how one of DataSnipper's most important growth channels scales, with direct visibility to leadership.

- Impact: The partnerships you build will influence how the world's leading firms adopt AI across audit and assurance.

What we offer

- Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands

- Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us

- 28 vacation days

- Excellent salary

- Pension plan

- Stock participation plan

- Hybrid work (Amsterdam-based)

- International team and environment

- Daily lunch 🍽️

- Mental health support (OpenUp)

- Social events and team activities 🤩

title: Engineering Manager, Billing & Monetization
description:
About the role 

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. We are hiring an Engineering Manager in our Amsterdam office to lead Billing & Monetization : how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The Scope

- Onboarding & offboarding : sign-up, trials, tenant and workspace provisioning, and the first-run experience. Getting a new firm from contract to value, fast.

- Licensing & entitlements : seats, plans, feature access and limits across the Excel add-in and Alwin, for self-serve users and global enterprise contracts alike.

- Metering & billing : real-time usage and credit consumption for our agentic products, through to invoicing, payments and revenue reporting.

What You Will Do 

- Lead through outcomes, not tasks. Set clear goals and trust the team to find the how.

- Make the team measurably better. Raise the bar, grow engineers into bigger problems, and address performance directly.

- Own the technical direction of the full customer lifecycle platform, and stay close enough to the code to make the hard calls credibly.

- Build systems where correctness is non-negotiable: accurate metering, enforced entitlements, reliable billing, all observable, secure and auditable.

- Treat onboarding as a product. Measure activation and time-to-value, and remove friction with Product and Design.

- Continuously improve on the admin experience to delight and empower our internal users.

- Turn commercial strategy into software. Partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success to shape pricing, packaging and licensing models.

- Set the bar for AI-assisted engineering. Not just shipping faster, but taking on harder problems, and shaping how DataSnipper engineering uses AI.

- Grow the scope. Expand ownership and stand up new teams as the area grows.

What You Bring

- 3+ years leading engineering teams, on top of 5+ years as a software engineer

- An empowerment style of leadership and a track record of building high-performing teams

- Experience building billing, licensing, entitlement or onboarding systems at scale, ideally usage- or credit-based

- Strong fundamentals in software architecture, distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native development

- Experience running production systems where financial correctness matters

- Strong product aptitude: you challenge framing, make roadmap trade-offs, and care about activation and conversion as much as uptime

- Hands-on fluency with AI coding tools and agentic harnesses, and a team that is measurably better for using them

- A strategic, entrepreneurial mindset: you shape direction, not just execute it

Nice to Have 

- Usage-, metered- or credit-based billing in production, including AI token metering and cost attribution

- Billing and payment platforms (e.g. Stripe), CRM and ERP integrations

- Identity and provisioning: SSO, SCIM, multi-tenant account models

- Product-led growth: self-serve sign-up, trials, in-product upgrades

- Financial correctness: idempotency, reconciliation, auditability, revenue recognition

- Python, Azure and observability tooling

- Scale-up experience, ideally in fintech or audit tech

What We Offer 

- Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

- Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

- Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

- 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

- Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

- Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

- NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

- A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

- Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

- Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

- Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

- Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

Recruitment Process 

- Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)

- Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

title: Senior Product Manager Transport (Equipment)
description:
About us 

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role 

Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct.

Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there.

Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there.

What you'll do

title: Network Engineer
description:
About the role 

Help build the networks connecting SkyNRG’s offices and future production sites!

As we scale Sustainable Aviation Fuel production, secure and reliable connectivity between our IT and operational environments becomes increasingly critical. We are looking for a Network Engineer (IT/OT) to design, build, and operate the network architecture supporting our Amsterdam headquarters, first production facility, and future sites.

This is a hands-on role with real influence over how our network landscape develops, from routing, switching and Wi-Fi to firewalls, IT/OT segmentation, and secure remote access.

Reporting to the IT Operations & Infrastructure Manager, the role works closely with IT, security, plant engineering, and automation partners.

Your Responsibilities: 

- Design, build, and operate IT and OT network infrastructure at headquarters and production sites, from Purdue Level 3 upward and at the boundary with plant control systems

- Manage and optimize our Fortinet (IT) and Palo Alto (OT) firewall environments, including rule sets, segmentation, and the industrial DMZ

- Operate Cisco Catalyst switching and Meraki wireless at our production sites, alongside the office network at headquarters

- Implement and maintain secure remote access for employees and vendors, including zero trust access

- Deploy and operate Nozomi Networks for OT asset visibility and threat detection, and integrate network and OT logs into our SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel)

- Support incident response together with our security team and managed SOC provider, and contribute to NIS2 compliance activities

This is an opportunity to build an IT/OT network from the ground up rather than maintain a legacy landscape. You will work with a modern technology stack, have real influence over architecture decisions, and see the direct impact of your work on our operational reliability and cybersecurity maturity.

The position is based at our headquarters in Amsterdam. Expect regular travel to the production site during construction and commissioning, becoming occasional once the site is in operation.

Your profile 

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing.

You recognize yourself in the following: 

- 5+ years of experience as a Network Engineer, including hands-on responsibility for enterprise firewall environments

- Strong experience with Fortinet FortiGate or Palo Alto Networks firewalls, and the willingness to master the other

- Solid knowledge of routing, switching (preferably Cisco Catalyst), wireless, VPN technologies, and network security best practices

- Experience with, or strong knowledge of, OT and industrial network environments, including ICS and SCADA systems

- Understanding of IT/OT segmentation principles and frameworks such as IEC 62443 and the Purdue Model, including industrial DMZ design

- Experience with OT monitoring solutions, preferably Nozomi Networks or comparable platforms such as Claroty or Dragos

- Comfortable working in both office and plant environments, including regular travel to production sites

- Professional proficiency in English

Nice-to-haves: 

- Certifications such as Fortinet FCP (NSE 4+), Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, Cisco CCNP, Nozomi Networks, IEC 62443, or GICSP

- Experience within the process industry, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, or another industrial environment

- Familiarity with NIS2 and experience translating regulatory requirements into practical technical controls

- Experience with zero trust network access (such as Zscaler) and Microsoft Azure networking

- Experience integrating network and OT logs into a SIEM, preferably Microsoft Sentinel

- Automation or scripting experience with Python or Ansible, and Git-based workflows

- Experience working with EPC contractors or automation vendors during plant construction and commissioning

- Dutch language skills

About SkyNRG 

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

- An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

- Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

- A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

- A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer 

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

title: Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01
description:
Please note: For this role proficiency in both Dutch and English is required. 

Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01 

As Reliability & Maintenance Engineer DSL-01, you are responsible for building and continuously improving the facility's maintenance, reliability, and asset integrity framework. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you help ensure the plant operates safely, reliably, and efficiently.

The role starts with a strong Maintenance Engineering focus. Your priority will be to help establish the maintenance and reliability foundation of DSL-01 by answering a fundamental question: "how do we maintain our assets safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their lifecycle?" 

You will translate reliability studies, equipment criticality assessments, and integrity requirements into practical maintenance plans, inspection programmes, spare parts strategies, and asset management processes.

As the facility moves into stable operations, the focus gradually shifts towards Reliability Engineering, where you will use asset health monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent failures and improve long-term asset performance.

Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external specialists, you will help reduce technical risk and improve asset reliability from day one.

You will:

- Develop and continuously improve maintenance, inspection, and asset integrity strategies

- Translate reliability studies, FMECA analyses, and engineering data into practical maintenance plans within the CMMS/EAM system

- Act as owner of the asset register from a maintenance, reliability, and integrity perspective

- Support the implementation and continuous development of the facility's CMMS/EAM system

- Drive reliability improvements through asset health monitoring, KPI analysis, and predictive maintenance techniques

- Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective actions

- Monitor and improve reliability performance indicators such as MTBF, MTTR, availability, and inspection compliance

- Support asset improvement, modification, and long-term replacement strategies throughout the asset lifecycle

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and enjoys turning complex technical challenges into practical solutions.

You recognize yourself in the following:

Must have

- Fluent in Dutch and English

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline (i.e. electrical or mechanical)

- 5+ years of experience in Reliability Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, Asset Integrity, or Asset Management

- Experience with RCM, FMEA/FMECA, RCA, and maintenance strategy development

- Experience with CMMS/EAM systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or IFS

Preferred

- Experience in chemical, petrochemical, energy, or other process industries like food or FMCG

- Experience with CMMS/EAM implementation or optimisation

- Experience with predictive maintenance and condition monitoring

- Knowledge of ATEX, PED, and asset integrity management

About DSL-01 

DSL-01 is SkyNRG’s frontrunning renewable fuels facility in Delfzijl, Netherlands. The plant will produce Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) from residual fats and greases using the HEFA (Hydrotreated Esters and Fatty Acids) pathway, with additional renewable products like butane, propane, and naphtha as by-products.

DSL-01 is the first facility in Europe dedicated entirely to SAF and its by-products. Once operational, it will produce 100,000 tonnes of SAF and 35,000 tonnes of sustainable by-products per year, cutting greenhouse gas emissions by around 80% compared to conventional jet fuel.

Construction started in 2026, with first fuel expected in 2028. The project includes the main facility, pipelines, and temporary work areas. At DSL-01, you will be part of a team building a state-of-the-art industrial plant from the ground up, contributing to a truly sustainable energy future.

Environmental and social responsibility are at the heart of DSL-01. We follow international frameworks and Dutch regulations to manage impacts on people, nature, and local communities. Safety, sustainability, and collaboration guide everything we do.

What we offer 

As DSL-01 is still being built, many aspects of the plant, roles, and benefits are still being shaped. Our HR team is actively defining the full compensation and benefits package specifically for the Delfzijl facility. You can be assured that the final offer will be highly competitive and designed to reward your expertise, contribution, and impact as we bring this pioneering SAF plant to life.

We are committed to offering an attractive total package to ensure we attract the best talent in the market. This includes a competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and a range of benefits that support your personal and professional growth.

Is this you?

At DSL-01, you will work in a dynamic, innovative environment where technical curiosity, problem-solving, and teamwork are valued. You will engage with operators, engineers, and managers across disciplines, helping to bring a pioneering renewable fuels facility to life while making a real impact on the planet.

Are you ready to help build a plant from the ground up? Join a pioneering force in sustainable aviation and help create a cleaner, more sustainable future.

title: Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01
description:

Werk mee aan een van de eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken in Europa. Je draagt bij aan de bouw van DSL-01 in Delfzijl: een fabriek gericht op de productie van Sustainable Aviation Fuel en bijproducten.

Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren team waarin jouw expertise direct bijdraagt aan een veilige en succesvolle realisatie van het project.

Over de functie

Als Supply Chain Planner krijg je de kans om vanaf de basis mee te bouwen aan de supply chain van DSL-01. Jouw werk helpt de basis te leggen voor een betrouwbare operatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige productiefaciliteiten voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF).

Je stapt op een uniek moment in een groeiende organisatie.

Voor de start van de fabriek:

- Help je mee de supply chain-organisatie van DSL-01 op te bouwen, inclusief de processen, systemen en werkwijzen die nodig zijn voor operational readiness.

- Draag je bij aan de inrichting van ERP-systemen, supply chain-processen en de voorbereiding van een veilige, betrouwbare en efficiënte operatie.

Na de start van de fabriek:

- Speel je een belangrijke rol in de dagelijkse supply chain-operatie, van grondstoffen- en productieplanning tot afstemming met leveranciers en afnemers.

- Zorg je samen met interne en externe stakeholders voor een stabiele supply chain die een veilige en continue productie ondersteunt.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

- Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van productie-, supply- en offtakeplanningen voor de korte, middellange en lange termijn.

- Vertalen van productiebehoeften naar materiaalvereisten en afstemmen van beschikbaarheid met leveranciers, Procurement en sourcing-teams.

- Coördineren van planning tussen Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Procurement en commerciële stakeholders.

- Signaleren van risico's, verstoringen en capaciteitsbeperkingen en ontwikkelen van passende scenario's en oplossingen.

- Leveren van analyses en inzichten ter ondersteuning van het Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)-proces.

- Actief bijdragen aan de inrichting, validatie en optimalisatie van ERP-systemen en supply chain-processen.

- Ondersteunen van processen rondom traceability, certificering en mass balancing.

- Initiëren en leiden van verbeteringen op het gebied van planning, systemen en werkwijzen.

- Fungeren als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor complexe planningsvraagstukken tijdens operational readiness en de opstart van de fabriek.

Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van operationele verantwoordelijkheid en de kans om een nieuwe supply chain-organisatie mee vorm te geven.

Jouw profiel

Je bent analytisch sterk, neemt eigenaarschap en voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Je bent in staat verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer informatie beperkt of onvolledig is.

Wat breng je mee?

- HBO werk- en denkniveau.

- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Supply Planner, Production Planner, Material Planner of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een productieomgeving.

- Een sterk begrip van supply chain-processen en ERP-systemen.

- Uitstekende analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om inzichten te vertalen naar acties en besluitvorming.

- Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte houding en een sterk gevoel van eigenaarschap.

- Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement in een complexe operationele omgeving.

- Het vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen onder onzekerheid.

- Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Additionele vaardigheden/ervaring

- Ervaring binnen de proces- en maakindustrie.

- Ervaring met ERP-implementaties, systeeminrichting of user acceptance testing.

- Ervaring met het opstarten van nieuwe productielocaties of operationele organisaties.

- Kennis van traceability, certificering, mass balancing, dangerous goods of waste management.

Over DSL-01 

In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Wat wij bieden 

DSL-01 is volop in ontwikkeling. Dat geldt niet alleen voor de fabriek, maar ook voor de organisatie en de arbeidsvoorwaarden. Ons HR-team werkt aan een passend en marktconform pakket voor de locatie in Delfzijl.

Je kunt rekenen op een goed salaris, een bonusregeling en arbeidsvoorwaarden die ruimte bieden voor jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Solliciteer 

Wil jij meebouwen aan een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

Jouw profiel 

We zijn een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

- Je hebt minimaal 4 jaar ervaring met Operational Technology (OT), industriële automatisering of industriële besturingssystemen, waarvan een deel gericht is op cybersecurity of OT-beveiliging.

Over DSL-01 

In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Wat wij bieden

title: System Architect

Read on and discover how you can make an impact. 

The challenge 

The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes. - System integration: Connect installations using protocols like BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and industrial standards such as OPC UA and PROFIBUS.

- Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations.

- Continuous learning and development: Stay updated on the latest innovations in smart technologies and automation, applying these to develop improved, future-proof solutions. • Technological consulting: Identify innovations to enhance performance and reliability in intelligent buildings and industrial environments.

- Extensive knowledge of intelligent building management solutions, gas safety systems, and industrial process control.

- Expertise in communication standards and protocols such as KNX, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, and PROFIBUS.

- Experience with IT networks and cybersecurity in automation environments. 

- Strong analytical skills and problem-solving abilities. 

- Flexibility and the ability to continuously adapt to technological advancements. 

- Excellent communication skills to clearly present complex technical issues

Education and Experience:

title: Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen
description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard. Tot nu toe worden al onze warmtepompen geïnstalleerd door externe partners, maar daar komt verandering in. We gaan onze eigen installatieteams opbouwen en zoeken daarom een Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen die hierin het voortouw neemt.

Je bent een ervaren monteur die graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt, maar ook energie krijgt van het begeleiden van anderen. Je gaat samen met je team op pad, bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de installaties en helpt ons om steeds meer monteurs op te leiden.

Je komt dus niet in een bestaand team terecht. Je helpt het team zelf opbouwen. 

Wat ga je doen? 

Als Hoofdmonteur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie van onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis. Je begint met het leiden van ons eerste interne installatieteam en helpt ons om de komende jaren onze eigen installatiecapaciteit verder uit te bouwen.

Je installeert warmtepompen en leidt je team 

- Je gaat samen met een collega-monteur op pad om onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis te installeren.

- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige installatie, van de technische uitvoering en het oplossen van onverwachte problemen tot de oplevering.

- Je zorgt dat installaties veilig, efficiënt en volgens onze kwaliteitsstandaarden worden uitgevoerd.

- Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor de klant tijdens de installatie. Je legt uit wat jullie doen, beantwoordt vragen en zorgt dat de klant met een goed gevoel achterblijft.

- Je stemt waar nodig af met onze werkvoorbereiders en collega's op kantoor over planning, materialen en technische uitdagingen.

Je bouwt mee aan ons interne installatieteam 

- Je begeleidt en traint nieuwe monteurs en helpt hen om zelfstandig installaties uit te kunnen voeren.

- Je denkt mee over het aannemen van nieuwe collega's en hoe we ons installatieteam verder kunnen uitbreiden.

- Je helpt onze installatiestandaarden en werkwijzen verder te ontwikkelen.

- Je signaleert wat er in de praktijk beter of slimmer kan en neemt initiatief om dit te verbeteren.

- Je deelt feedback vanuit het veld met onze engineers, werkvoorbereiders en productontwikkelaars, zodat we onze producten en installaties continu kunnen verbeteren.

Wie zoeken wij? 

We zoeken iemand die zijn vak goed verstaat, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en het leuk vindt om anderen beter te maken. Je hoeft niet eerder een heel team te hebben opgebouwd, maar je moet wel zin hebben om die uitdaging aan te gaan.

- Je hebt ruime ervaring met het installeren van warmtepompen, cv-installaties of andere verwarmingssystemen. Ervaring met warmtepompen heeft een sterke voorkeur.

- Je hebt een goede technische basis in installatietechniek, elektrotechniek en/of werktuigbouwkunde.

- Je kunt zelfstandig installaties uitvoeren, technische tekeningen lezen en onverwachte problemen oplossen.

- Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van andere monteurs, of bent klaar om die verantwoordelijkheid op je te nemen.

- Je werkt nauwkeurig en veilig en vindt het belangrijk om goed werk af te leveren.

- Je communiceert makkelijk met klanten en collega's en kunt technische zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen.

- Je neemt initiatief, denkt in oplossingen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat.

- Je spreekt goed Nederlands en hebt rijbewijs B.

Een relevante mbo-opleiding en certificeringen zoals VCA, NEN 3140 of CO-vakmanschap zijn mooi meegenomen. Heb je nog niet alle benodigde certificaten? Dan kijken we samen wat je nog kunt behalen.

Wat bieden wij jou? 

- Een salaris van €4.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

- Een sleutelrol in ons bedrijf: je wordt de eerste Hoofdmonteur van ons interne installatieteam en helpt dit verder uit te bouwen.

- Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid: je krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we installeren, samenwerken en nieuwe monteurs opleiden.

- Goed materiaal: een volledig uitgeruste werkbus en professioneel gereedschap.

- 26 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen op basis van 40 uur, met de mogelijkheid om te kiezen voor een hogere beloning in plaats van ADV.

- Een goede pensioenregeling volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek.

- Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, zowel technisch als in het begeleiden en aansturen van een team.

- Een betrokken team met korte lijnen, weinig bureaucratie en regelmatig leuke activiteiten, van borrels en teamuitjes tot onze jaarlijkse wintersport.

Waarom DeWarmte? 

Bij DeWarmte geloven we dat verduurzaming pas echt werkt als het voor iedereen bereikbaar en aantrekkelijk is. Daarom ontwikkelen we slimme, betaalbare warmtepompen die we zelf ontwerpen en assembleren.

We zijn een groeiend bedrijf waar veel gebeurt en waar je echt invloed hebt op hoe we dingen aanpakken. We houden van mensen die initiatief nemen, samenwerken en niet wachten tot iemand anders een probleem oplost.

Als Hoofdmonteur krijg je de kans om vanaf het begin mee te bouwen aan onze eigen installatieorganisatie. Je werkt zelf aan mooie technische installaties, leidt nieuwe monteurs op en helpt bepalen hoe we dit in de toekomst op grotere schaal gaan doen.

Klaar om samen met ons iets op te bouwen? 

Solliciteer en kom kennismaken. We vertellen je graag meer over DeWarmte, onze warmtepompen en onze plannen voor het interne installatieteam.

Compensation: €4K – €6K per month

title: PLC Software Engineer - The Netherlands
AI Engineer
description:
Who are we? 

Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence. 

Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses. 

Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore. 

How we work 

- Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data. 

- Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer. 

- Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted. 

What will you do? 

The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents. 

- The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead. 

- The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real. 

- Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins. 

- Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view. 

- Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks. 

In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models. 

Who are you? 

- You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering.

title: Director, European Strategic Communications
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM 

Anduril's global communications team is responsible for shaping how the world understands modern defense technology—and why it matters. We're seeking a Director of Communications, Europe, to build and lead Anduril's external communications presence across the continent.

This is a senior individual contributor role based in Amsterdam, reporting to the VP of Global Communications, with a dotted line to Anduril's European General Manager. You will be Anduril's first dedicated communications hire in Europe, responsible for standing up a regional program from scratch, building relationships with media and institutions, and developing the narratives that will define Anduril's reputation across the world's most consequential defense markets.

This is a builder role. You'll set strategy and execute it yourself, establish agency and contractor networks as the business grows, and work shoulder-to-shoulder with business development, policy, and senior leadership to earn Anduril a place in Europe's defense conversation. The ideal candidate has deep roots across multiple European markets, understands how defense, technology, and industrial policy intersect at the national level, and knows how to build presence and credibility in environments where trust is earned slowly and reputation matters enormously.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Build Anduril's European communications program from the ground up, developing strategy, establishing infrastructure, and executing across markets with varying levels of maturity and priority.

- Drive media relations across defense, technology, business, and policy outlets in priority European markets, building the relationships and pipelines that will sustain long-term coverage.

- Develop and execute market-specific narrative strategies that connect Anduril's mission and capabilities to each country's defense priorities, industrial ambitions, and security context.

- Work closely with Anduril's European General Manager and business development teams to support market entry, customer engagement, partnerships, and key events.

- Build and manage a network of regional agencies and contractors as European operations expand.

- Partner with global communications, policy, and marketing teams to adapt core messaging for European audiences without losing coherence or accuracy.

- Engage think tanks, research institutions, and policy communities to build credibility and shape the broader discourse around defense innovation and allied cooperation.

- Own metrics and reporting frameworks to track progress and demonstrate impact across markets.

QUALIFICATIONS 

- 10+ years of experience in communications, public affairs, or media relations.

- Fluency in the European defense and political landscape across multiple countries, how decisions get made, who shapes opinion, and where the conversation is heading.

- A track record of building communications programs in new markets, not just inheriting them.

- Experience managing agencies, contractors, and regional communications networks across borders.

- Exceptional writing and strategic thinking, with the ability to develop narratives that land across cultures and audiences.

- Comfortable working autonomously in an early-stage market environment, with the judgment to make calls without a lot of process around you.

You'll excel in this role if you:

- Have built something before, a market presence, a regional program, a communications function, and know what that actually requires.

- Can hold complexity: different countries, different threat perceptions, different industrial interests, all requiring distinct approaches under a coherent strategy.

- Know Europe's defense ecosystem personally, the journalists, the institutions, the officials who shape how these conversations evolve.

- Are energized by the moment Europe is in, and want to help shape how one of the most important defense technology companies in the world shows up in it.

- Strong discovery skills: understanding what a partner needs and judging what's feasible with the product

Als senior uitvoerder kabels & leidingen werk je aan ondergrondse infra rond het spoor en op stations door heel Nederland. Je stuurt uitvoerders, vakmensen en onderaannemers aan, houdt meerdere belangen bij elkaar en zorgt dat het werk doorgaat. Ook als de planning verandert of de situatie buiten anders blijkt dan gedacht. Je krijgt daarbij te maken met onder andere telecom, data, elektriciteitsleidingen en glasvezel. Werk waarbij veiligheid, goede afstemming en de juiste beslissing op het juiste moment het verschil maken. 

Dit ga je doen 
Jij zorgt dat het buiten gebeurt. Veilig, volgens afspraak en met een team dat weet wat het moet doen . Als uitvoerder 3 kabels & leidingen stuur je medewerkers, specialisten en onderaannemers aan en houd je grip op planning, kwaliteit en kosten. 

Je werkt aan ondergrondse infra binnen onze railprojecten, zoals telecom, data, elektriciteitsleidingen en glasvezel. Je stuurt één of meerdere projecten tegelijk aan en houdt het overzicht, ook als het anders loopt dan gepland. Je gaat: 

- je team aansturen en motiveren , met duidelijke afspraken en ruimte voor vakmanschap; 

- veiligheid vooropzetten en collega's stimuleren risico’s en verbeteringen te delen; 

- plannen en bijsturen , prioriteiten stellen en knopen doorhakken als dat nodig is; 

- kwaliteit en kosten bewaken , inclusief het meer- en minderwerk; 

- schakelen met betrokken partijen , van je team en collega's tot ProRail, OV-bedrijven en netbeheerders; 

- verbeteringen aanjagen door kritisch te kijken, te luisteren en goede ideeën om te zetten in actie. 

Je hoeft niet overal zelf naast te staan. Maar als het erop aankomt, weet jij wat er buiten speelt, ben je er en neem je een besluit. 

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. 

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. 

Dit verwachten wij van jou 
Je bent een ervaren uitvoerder die overzicht houdt en duidelijk communiceert. Je weet wanneer je ruimte kunt geven en wanneer jij degene bent die een beslissing moet nemen. Voor deze rol breng je mee: 

- relevante ervaring met het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van ondergrondse infraprojecten; 

- ervaring met het aansturen van medewerkers, specialisten en onderaannemers; 

- een technische basis, bijvoorbeeld vanuit civiele techniek, elektrotechniek of werktuigbouwkunde; 

- een scherpe blik op veiligheid, kwaliteit, planning en kosten; 

- het vermogen om rustig te blijven, prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen; 

- de communicatieve kracht om verschillende partijen bij elkaar te brengen; 

- bereidheid om te werken wanneer het spoorwerk daarom vraagt, ook buiten reguliere werktijden. 

We verwachten niet dat je ieder probleem zelf oplost. Wel dat je ervoor zorgt dat problemen op tafel komen, de juiste mensen betrokken zijn en er uiteindelijk een besluit wordt genomen. 

Waarom Dura Vermeer Railinfra? 
Hier krijg je de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen én verantwoordelijkheid te nemen . Je organiseert je werk met veel zelfstandigheid en krijgt mogelijkheden om jezelf via opleidingen verder te ontwikkelen. 

En je werkt niet zomaar aan kabels en leidingen. Jouw werk is onderdeel van railprojecten waarin verschillende technische disciplines samenkomen. Dat vraagt om samenwerken, vooruitkijken en beslissingen nemen als het buiten anders loopt dan gepland. 

Veilig werken staat daarbij voorop. In hoe je het werk organiseert, je team aanstuurt en de keuzes die je buiten maakt. 

Wij hebben oog voor jou 

Dura Vermeer is een grote organisatie waarin je veel kunt leren en waarin je kansen hebt om je ambities vorm te geven. Daarbij hechten we veel waarde aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief. We hebben goede arbeidsvoorwaarden conform CAO Railinfrastructuur (RIS). Dus bieden we je onder meer: 

- Een goed salaris afhankelijk van de meegebrachte kennis, niveau en werkervaring beginnend bij € 4.620,- tot € 5.775,- bruto per 4 weken en dus 13 maal per jaar!; 

- 25 vakantiedagen + 18 ADV dagen (beide op fulltime basis) 

- Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een standaard verzekering van alle werknemersrisico’s, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap. 

- Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden en thuiswerken en moderne verlofvormen voor onder meer ouderschap, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of een sabbatical. 

- Voor verse vaders: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens je (aanvullende) geboorteverlof. 

- Een zeer goede beloning wanneer je de nachten of weekenden gaat werken 

- Veel aandacht voor jouw groei, met onze eigen Dura Vermeer academie en een vergoeding in tijd en geld voor zowel vak- als loopbaangerichte opleidingen. 

- Een mobiliteitsbudget of een leaseauto met grote keuzevrijheid. Smartphone en een laptop of tablet van de zaak. 

- Een vitaliteitsprogramma en een individueel keuzebudget voor duurzame inzetbaarheid. 

- En last but not least: fijne collega’s die in een professionele omgeving zorgen voor een ongekend goede werksfeer. 

Heb jij ook hart voor het spoor?

title: Senior Controlling Manager (FP&A)

- Several years of experience in Controlling, ideally within an international or multi-brand environment.
