- Strong expertise in margin analysis and performance steering.

- Experience with modern ERP and BI systems (e.g. NetSuite, BigQuery, Superset, Power BI, Pigment) and evidence of driving change.

- Advanced analytical skills and experience working with complex datasets, digital FP&A processes and automated reporting, ideally including AI-driven analytics tools.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership.

- Degree in Finance, Controlling, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

What we can offer you

- Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.

- Hiring Manager Interview

- Hiring Team Interview

- Leadership Interview

Location: Hamburg, Germany

In your first year, you will activate Flora Food Group's global nutrition science materials locally, ensuring they resonate with healthcare professionals and consumers in your market. This role is vital for translating complex nutrition science into clear, credible messages that support product development, marketing, and communication. You will be the trusted nutrition business partner on the ground, connecting global insights with local needs to strengthen our nutrition leadership. Care

You are a proactive self-starter who works autonomously, builds strong relationships, and confidently manages stakeholder expectations.

You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. This role offers a clear path to senior nutrition positions within Flora Food Group or opportunities to move into local cross functions. There is also potential for mobility within the global nutrition team, allowing you to broaden your impact and expertise over time.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Remote
description:
About Us 

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.

Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot , Polkadot SDK , and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team 

Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design.

About the Role 

As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols.

- Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools.

- Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.

- ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation.

- Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues.

- Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle.

- Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software.

- Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security.

What We're Looking For 

- Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts.

- Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development.

- Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports.

- Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection).

- Familiarity with cryptographic principles, blockchain security, or decentralized systems.

- Strong problem-solving skills and an offensive security mindset.

If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you!

About Working With Us 

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc , our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity . View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles.

title: Standortentwickler (m/w/d)
description:
„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig.

Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest.

Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis.

Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Deine Mission

Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr:

- Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen.
- Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt.
- Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung.
- Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst.
- Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark.
- Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach.
- Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich.
Was du mitbringst

- Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet.
- Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden.
- Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen.
- Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen.
- Führung – Du hast Teams aufgebaut und geführt und weißt, wie man aus Einzelpersonen eine Mannschaft macht.
- Zahlenverständnis – Budget, Deckungsbeitrag, Auslastung – du steuerst mit Kennzahlen und nicht nach Gefühl.
- Qualifikation – Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung – betriebswirtschaftlich, pädagogisch, sozial oder etwas ganz anderes. Entscheidend ist, was du bewegt hast.
- Persönlichkeit – Gründergeist, Ausdauer, Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Unsicherheit aus, bleibst dran, wenn es zäh wird, und feierst, wenn der erste Teilnehmende einen Arbeitsvertrag unterschreibt.
Was wir dir geben

- Gewinnbeteiligung – Du baust den Standort auf – und du bist am Gewinn beteiligt, den er erwirtschaftet. Die Details klären wir im Gespräch, offen und transparent.
- Freiheit – Du entscheidest vor Ort. Wir geben dir Ziele, keine Mikro-Anweisungen. Entscheidungen fallen bei uns schnell – 70 Prozent Informationslage reichen.
- Rückendeckung – Du startest nicht bei null: Zertifizierung und Qualitätsmanagement, erprobte Maßnahmenkonzepte, Verwaltung, Buchhaltung, Marketing und 15 Jahre Erfahrung im Ausschreibungsgeschäft stehen hinter dir.
- Direkter Draht – Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung der Gruppe zusammen – kurze Wege, schnelle Antworten.
- Perspektive – Wer Berlin aufbaut, leitet Berlin. Die Standortleitung ist der logische nächste Schritt.
- Sinn – Jeder Mensch, den dein Standort in Arbeit bringt, ist dein Ergebnis. Das sieht man – jeden Tag.
- Corporate Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Weil wir auch an deine Zukunft denken.
Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis

Klingt nach dir? Dann erzähl uns in deiner Bewerbung vor allem eins: Was hast du schon aufgebaut – und wie würdest du in Berlin anfangen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Diese Stelle wird zentral von der IWQ Holding GmbH ausgeschrieben. Die Anstellung erfolgt bei der für den Standort Berlin zuständigen operativen Tochtergesellschaft der EuBiA-Gruppe.

Bei uns zählt der Mensch: Bewerbungen sind unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Identität oder einer Behinderung ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements 

- Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

- Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

- Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

- Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

- Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

title: Growth Associate (Intern)
description:
Who we are 

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

What you will do 

Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team.

Your first job is to turn organic reach into a machine: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter.

On a typical day, your tasks may include:

- Creator network: finding and briefing creators at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver

- Launches: getting our products in front of the communities where they can travel, at the right moment

- Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks

- Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat

- New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from new communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet

- Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic

- Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs

- Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers

Who you are 

We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

- Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs

- Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social

- Creator marketing: you enjoy working with creators and have a feel for content that looks native

- Creativity: you bring fresh ideas and test them in a structured way

- Analytical: you are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL, Python or AI tools are a plus

- Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

- A big plus: you are a creator yourself, with a real following

- Academics: pursuing or recently graduated with a degree at a top-tier university, with an outstanding academic record: grades, scholarships or awards to show for it

What makes this exciting 

You own a lever the whole company feels. Every breakout you engineer shows up directly in how fast we can grow, at a fraction of what paid reach would cost. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

What the process will look like 

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

- Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you

- Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills

- Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics

- Offer, contract signing and onboarding

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
description:
Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager in our Berlin or London offices.

About the Role

Taktile is building the world's leading Agentic Decisioning Platform for Financial Services. Our customers use our product to automate millions of critical decisions with AI across customer onboarding, credit underwriting, anti money laundering, and many other use cases.

Underneath every one of these decisions sits the Taktile Platform: the permissions, environments, deployment, extensibility and connectivity foundations that allow the largest financial institutions to run Taktile securely and at scale, for both humans and AI agents. Taktile Platform also owns developer productivity: the tooling, infrastructure and workflows that help our engineering teams ship quickly and safely. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the strategy and roadmap for the platform, with a focus on its enterprise and agentic foundations. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure and security engineering to meet the demands of a rapidly growing enterprise customer base, and partner with customer-facing teams and Product Marketing to make our platform a reason customers choose Taktile.

What You’ll Do

- Own the strategy and long-term success of the Taktile Platform, the foundation that every product area and every enterprise customer builds on

- Define a compelling long-term vision for the platform and prioritize the roadmap necessary to reach it. Example areas of focus will include permissions for users and AI agents, Taktile MCP extensibility, release processes (e.g. environments), enterprise connectivity, and more

- Build a deep understanding of enterprise requirements (security, IT, compliance and procurement), the competitive landscape and opportunities for differentiation, collaborating with customer-facing teams

- Translate customer insights into well thought out product requirements

- Balance innovation with a very high bar for reliability and security

- Act as the voice of the platform: enable and advocate for platform capabilities across product, engineering and go-to-market teams, and partner with Product Marketing to bring them to market

- Track adoption and performance of platform capabilities through metrics and customer feedback, identifying opportunities for iteration

Who You Are

- 5+ yrs work experience in Product Management, including previous experience owning platform topics (e.g. identity and access management, permissions, environments, deployment models, connectivity or developer platforms) for B2B SaaS or AI products

- Strong technical depth and an appetite to keep deepening it. An engineering or other technical background is preferred. You are comfortable going deep with engineers on cloud infrastructure, authentication and authorization (e.g. OAuth, SSO, SCIM) and networking. Experience in building critical, high-availability systems is a strong plus

- Experience working with enterprise security, IT and compliance stakeholders, for example through security reviews, RFPs or complex customer deployments. Familiarity with AI agents and MCP is a must, familiarity with and with financial services is desired

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to build trust and influence decisions across functions, and to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences alike

- Track record of delivering lasting customer impact through shipping well-thought out product improvements

- Aptitude and appetite for using data to inform your decision-making

- Hands-on, curious, and willing to challenge yourself and grow your scope of responsibilities over time

Our Offer

- Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here

- Operate with a high degree of autonomy that allows you to make an impact and meaningfully impact a critical area of our product

- Experience a flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo

- Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe including the founders of Looker, Datadog, GitHub, and UiPath

- Enjoy annual offsites where the entire company co-locates to collaborate in person

- Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package as well as access to a self-development budget

- Work at our prime office locations in Berlin or London for three days per week or more

Our Stance

- We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

- We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

About Us 

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com .

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Über HvS-Consulting GmbH

(Senior) Penetration Tester / Red Teamer (m/w/d) 

Das erwartet Dich:

- Offensive Security : Du führst eigenständig Penetrationstests durch, identifizierst Schwachstellen in komplexen IT-Landschaften und analysierst Angriffswege über Netzwerk-, System- und Anwendungsebenen hinweg 

- Realistische Angriffssimulation : Du stellst Sicherheitsketten eines Unternehmens im Rahmen von Advanced Cyber Attacks und Red Teaming Assessments auf die Probe 

- Technisches Consulting : Du berätst unsere Kunden herstellerunabhängig zu modernen Sicherheitsarchitekturen, Angriffsszenarien und Best Practices und führst Audits / Whitebox-Reviews mit technischem Schwerpunkt durch 

- Analyse & Reporting : Du bereitest technische Ergebnisse zielgruppengerecht auf, machst komplexe Angriffe verständlich und leitest daraus konkrete, umsetzbare Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden ab 

- Research & Development : Du wirkst aktiv bei der Entwicklung neuer Angriffstechniken, Tools, Automatisierungen und Infrastruktur mit 

- Gemeinsame Expertise : Du wirst Teil eines hochqualifizierten Teams, in dem jeder seine Spezialgebiete einbringt und gemeinsam zum Erfolg des gesamten Teams beiträgt

Das bringst Du mit:

- Erfahrung : Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich IT-Security mit Fokus auf Penetration Testing und/oder Red Teaming 

- Technisches Know-how : Fundierte Kenntnisse in Active Directory, Entra-ID, Enterprise-Netzwerken und/oder Cloud-Umgebungen (AWS, Azure etc.) 

- OT/ICS-Erfahrung : Praktische Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von Assessments in kritischen OT-/ICS-Umgebungen sowie in der Bewertung von Risiken und Ableitung pragmatischer Maßnahmen zur Stärkung der Cyber-Resilienz 

- Development Skills : Programmiererfahrung, idealerweise in Python, Go, Java, oder C# 

- Mindset : Du verfügst über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bringst neue Perspektiven in komplexe Security-Herausforderungen ein („think outside the box“) 

- Kommunikation : Du hast Freude an der Beratung, bringst technische Inhalte klar auf den Punkt und kannst sie sowohl Fachteams als auch dem Management verständlich vermitteln 

- Arbeitsweise : Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und analytisch, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte und lieferst eigenständig Ergebnisse auf hohem Niveau 

- Sprachkenntnisse : Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 

- Reisebereitschaft : Du bringst eine Reisebereitschaft von rund 30 % mit. Dazu gehören gelegentlich auch internationale Reisen 

- Nice to have : Zertifizierungen wie OSCP, OSWA/OSWE, CRTO, SANS oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen 

Was Dich aber vor allem erwartet:

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Uns gibt dieser Job nicht nur ein Gehalt, sondern auch persönliche Zufriedenheit, weil wir wirklich etwas bewirken und die Welt ein Stück sicherer machen.

Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Zusätzlich bieten wir auf Wunsch attraktive Benefits, von Jobticket bis hin zu Kindergartenzuschuss. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten helfen Dir, auch auf Unvorhergesehenes im Alltag gelassen zu reagieren. Schau dir unsere Benefits gerne auf unserer Karriereseite genauer an

Was erwartet Dich noch? Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen.

As Director of Production Engineering, you are accountable for the end-to-end production engineering capability across all manufacturing operations. Your mission is to industrialize development outputs into repeatable, scalable, and compliant serial production, ensuring manufacturing readiness, process stability, quality, cost efficiency, and on-time delivery. You lead the team that converts early procedures into robust production standards, embeds them in PLM/MES systems, and drives continuous improvement across the factory.

You act as the primary interface between Engineering (design & development) and Manufacturing (production & operations)—ensuring requirements, procedures, tooling, documentation, test strategies, and digital manufacturing infrastructure are aligned for high-rate, high-quality execution. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission:

2) Assembly, integration & test (AIT) process ownership 

- Own manufacturing process definition across:

- Assembly: mechanical/electrical build procedures, torque specs, critical process parameters, work instructions.

- Testing: functional, subsystem, and system-level test strategy; test readiness, execution plans, and troubleshooting methodology.

- mBOM (Manufacturing Bill of Materials)

- Work instructions, process specifications, test reports, NCRs (non-conformance reports), deviations/waivers, and as-built configurations.

- Serve as senior escalation point for technical blockers in production: diagnose recurring issues, direct corrective actions, and prevent reoccurrence.

- Align with Supply Chain and Operations on:

- Kitting strategy, material availability, critical path timelines, and constraint removal.

- Coordinate engineering support coverage and readiness for shifts, rate increases, and critical campaigns.

- Yield, cycle time, takt adherence, OEE, scrap/rework reduction, and labor efficiency.

- Establish KPIs and operating mechanisms (tier meetings, weekly business reviews) to track and improve production engineering performance.

- Build business cases for capital investments (test equipment, tooling, automation) and manage the budget for your scope.

- Build a strong knowledge-transfer system between engineers and technicians:

- Training plans, certification matrices, standardized visual work instructions, and lessons-learned libraries.

- Ensure procedures are systematically categorized, version-controlled, and easily accessible to production teams.

- Improved first-pass yield, reduced NCR rate, reduced rework hours

title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
description:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

The Role

CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

- They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.

- They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.

- They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.

- They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.

- They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

What you'll do

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

How we build

- Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.

- Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.

- Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.

- Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.

Recent work

- Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.

- A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.

- Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.

- Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.

- A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.

What we look for

- You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working.

- You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security.

- You build the eval before you trust the result.

- You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°.

- Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics.

Stack

- Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Claude and OpenAI APIs, MCP, skills in plain Markdown

- Code: TypeScript (Bun, React), Python (FastAPI, Dagster, OpenCV, OR-Tools), PostgreSQL

- Infra: Nix and NixOS, Nomad, Terraform, Vault, AWS, Modal sandboxes, OpenTelemetry

- Architect the robot operating system. Design the core abstractions: how robots, cameras, tools and jobs are modelled, how work is planned and dispatched, how state is shared and how failures are handled. Decide what belongs in Python and what needs Rust.

- Bring in new vision. Integrate novel computer vision algorithms into the control loop, from finding and centring parts to checking every pick and placement, and make them fast and reliable enough for production.

- Build agentic robotics. Put large models to work in the robots themselves: programming a new part from its datasheet, judging a pick from a camera image, diagnosing a fault and recovering from it, with evals that prove it works before it runs alone.

- Move a fleet. Route dozens of movers at once without collisions or deadlocks, and coordinate gantries, printers and ovens around them.

- Bridge to real time. Design clean interfaces between high-level planning and the real-time controllers driving the motors.

- Make it observable. Simulation, tracing and replay, so every change is proven before it reaches the factory and every failure can be explained.

What we look for

- You've worked on, and ideally architected, a large-scale robot code base that ran on real hardware in production.

- Strong software engineering in Python and Rust (or C++ and a willingness to move to Rust). You care about types, testing, concurrency and clear architecture.

- Experience with some of: motion or path planning, multi-robot coordination, controls, perception, scheduling.

- Hands-on experience applying large models (LLMs or vision-language models) to robotics, or a strong drive to.

- You use coding agents to move faster and take full ownership of what they produce.

- You're happy to visit our factories in the US and UK to see your code run.

Stack

title: Software Engineer, Haskell
description:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

Overview 

- CircuitHub is primarily built using a combination of Haskell, Nix, and PostgreSQL, deployed to both AWS and bare metal machines. We use a significant amount of open-source technology, and also try and give back where possible (for example, both Rel8 and Fast Downward Haskell bindings ).

- CircuitHub spans a vast problem space. Challenges include computer vision (OpenCV), machine learning (PyTorch), hard optimization problems (Z3/MiniZinc/OR-Tools), and all the normal engineering challenges of building both web-based customer-facing and internal tooling.

- We work on manufacturing execution systems, enterprise resource planning, and robotics. An old video from Haskell Exchange 2019 hints at what we are up to on the robotics side. We have progressed significantly since then!

- These roles are remote (any location), in-person, or hybrid, depending on preference.

- We have offices in South Deerfield - USA, Cambridge, and London, UK.

- CircuitHub has raised $45M from top-tier VCs and has been going for about ten years. CircuitHub is profitable, with tens of millions in revenue. Small team (CircuitHub is ~50 employees) with tremendous growth opportunity and low risk. We are aiming to 10x capacity through 2027 in both our existing Massachusetts factory and expand into Europe.

Team/Environment/Role

Our R&D team is more than 20 people, with eight engineers working directly on the Haskell code base. We are looking to expand the team significantly this year. We have many exciting problems to solve, from robotic path planning to more conventional web products.

We are happy to consider candidates without commercial Haskell experience, but your other skills and experience would need to compensate. A possible profile, for instance, would be a professional robotics background with some hobbyist FP experience.

title: Global Investigator (Triage)
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.

The impact you will have: 

- Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

- Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

- Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

- Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

What we’re looking for: 

- Investigative or analytical experience in the private or public sector. One to three years is fine: we want hungry people who want to grow into deep crypto expertise.

- Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

- Excitement to deepen blockchain analysis skills.

- Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

- Strong written and verbal communication.

About the Team: 

- The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors, and the seat is designed to accelerate your development.

Team Operating Rhythms: 

- Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

- Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities: 

- Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

- Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position: 

- React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

- Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

Application Instructions 

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM 

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

- Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

- Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

- First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

- Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

- References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

- Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

- Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM 

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

- Accelerate repeatable workflows

- Structure and solve problems

- Improve output quality

- Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM 

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

- Priorities and targets to change quickly

- Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

- A high level of personal ownership and accountability

- Close collaboration across teams and functions

- Frequent, high-touch communication

- Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

- A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 

Leadership Principles 

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

- Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

- Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

- Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission 

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. 

Privacy Policy and Additional Information 

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy .

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form .

Recruitment agencies 

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The role

You will be our first dedicated engineering leader, reporting to the CTO with a direct line to both founders - no layers in between.

Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization.

We want to be honest about what this job is. It is a hands-on operator role: managing engineers, building the hiring machine, setting standards, running compliance, and working closely with our partners at SAP. If you light up at making an organization fast rather than at owning the biggest possible headcount, this is your role.

What you'll do 

- Directly manage and grow the engineering team, including building out its management layer.

- Build the hiring machine: run hiring operations across our hiring managers, design interview loops that hold up in the AI era, and keep a very high bar while the team grows.

- Own engineering standards and velocity: how we review, test, and ship - and how the team gets real leverage from AI coding tools.

- Own our security and compliance program - SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001 - right-sized, so the lab keeps its speed.

- Own the engineering side of our collaboration with SAP.

- Treat the deployment layer as a product surface: our models reach customers through a managed API, customer VPCs, and self-hosted open weights, and the engineering behind that needs customer empathy, not just platform craft.

- Act as a sparring partner to the founders on org design and engineering direction - we're hiring someone who will argue with us.

What we're looking for 

- You have directly led an engineering organization of 10+ people, including through managers or leads, and you can talk concretely about how you built it.

- You have owned platform or infrastructure scope at scale: serving, APIs, availability, cloud and vendor budgets.

- You have worked in both startups and large organizations - you can create structure from scratch and hold your own with a very large partner.

- You scaled an engineering org through a real growth phase (25 to 60+ or similar), building the management layer along the way.

- You have led engineering in a research- or ML-heavy organization and know how research code and production code differ - and how to bridge them without slowing research down.

What sets you apart 

- You have led engineering through an acquisition, working directly with the parent company.

- You have personally changed how your team works because of AI coding tools, and can show what it did to output.

- You have operated under SOC 2 / ISO-style audit regimes; having built or run the function yourself is a plus.

Life at Prior Labs

title: Pflichtpraktikum Produktentwicklung (all genders)
description:
Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern verstehen, wie aus einer Idee ein Produkt wird, das Kund:innen wirklich nachkaufen? 

Die MainTea GmbH ist ein Food-Startup aus Frankfurt am Main mit rund 30 Mitarbeitenden und Teil der MainTea-Gruppe. Zur Gruppe gehören mehrere Marken: Besser im Glas (D2C), PRO2BE , Bubble Pop und Bubble Chill , jeweils im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel. Die Produktentwicklung arbeitet für alle diese Marken, und genau dort bist du in deinem Pflichtpraktikum fest im Team: Du verkostest, recherchierst Trends, stimmst dich mit Herstellern und Lieferanten ab und begleitest neue Produkte von der ersten Idee bis ins Regal. Wenn du Food liebst und in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien echte Verantwortung übernehmen willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung.

Deine Aufgaben

- Produktentwicklung über alle Marken: Du arbeitest aktiv an Neuentwicklungen und Sortimentserweiterungen für Besser im Glas und PRO2BE, von Tee- und Gewürzmischungen über Protein-Produkte bis zu Getränken.

- Verkostung & Produkttests: Du planst und organisierst strukturierte Verkostungen, wertest Geschmack, Aroma, Textur und Optik aus und lieferst Feedback, das direkt in die Weiterentwicklung einfließt.

- Trendrecherche & Marktbeobachtung: Du behältst Food- und Getränketrends im Blick, beobachtest Wettbewerber im Onlinehandel und im Supermarkt und bringst eigene Ideen für neue Sorten und Konzepte ein.

- Rezeptur-Support: Du hilfst bei der Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Produktentwicklungen und pflegst Rezepturen und Produktdaten.

- Lieferanten & Muster: Du fragst Rohstoffe, Muster und Angebote bei Herstellern und Co-Packern an, vergleichst sie und behältst den Überblick über laufende Anfragen.

- Produktdaten & Kennzeichnung: Du unterstützt beim Erstellen von Spezifikationen, Zutatenlisten und Etikettentexten und arbeitest dabei eng mit Qualitätsmanagement und Grafik zusammen.

- Besorgungen & Testlogistik: Du besorgst Testzutaten und Vergleichsprodukte und sorgst dafür, dass bei Verkostungen alles bereitsteht.

- Dokumentation: Du hältst Ergebnisse sauber fest und machst Fortschritte für das Team nachvollziehbar.

Dein Profil

- Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in und musst im Rahmen deines Studiums ein Pflichtpraktikum von mindestens 6 Monaten absolvieren.

- Idealerweise studierst du Ökotrophologie, Ernährungswissenschaften, Ernährungsökonomie, Food Management oder etwas Vergleichbares.

- Du brennst für Food, neue Produkte und Trends und probierst gern Neues aus.

- Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Geschmack und ein Auge fürs Detail.

- Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und packst gern selbst mit an.

- Du bist kommunikativ und trittst gegenüber externen Partnern professionell auf.

- Du sprichst gut Deutsch und Englisch (unsere Partner sitzen teils im Ausland).

- Du arbeitest sicher mit MS Office, vor allem Excel.

- Führerschein Klasse B. 

Was wir dir bieten

- Praxis, die zählt: Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1. Du arbeitest an Produktentwicklungen, die wirklich in den Verkauf gehen, nicht an Übungsszenarien.

- Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden: An drei Tagen pro Woche kocht unsere Köchin frisch für das Team-Lunch, weil gutes Essen dazugehört.

- Team & Kultur: Ein offenes, vertrauensvolles und humorvolles Team, regelmäßige Teamevents und viel Hands-on-Mentalität.

- Work-Life-Balance: 24 Urlaubstage und ein strukturiertes, modernes Arbeitsumfeld.

- KI & Tools: Zugang zu modernen Arbeitsmitteln und KI — damit du von Anfang an effizient arbeiten kannst.

- Vergütung: Pflichtpraktika werden bei uns mit 600 € pro Monat vergütet.

Du erkennst dich in dieser Stelle wieder? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deine Immatrikulationsbescheinigung. Ein paar Zeilen dazu, was dich an Food und Produktentwicklung reizt, sind willkommen und helfen uns, dich besser kennenzulernen. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Director Operations & Safety (m/w/d)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Foundations
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.

Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo's operations and business.

The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.

Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.

It's an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you'll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we'd expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning.

This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It's especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains.

What you'll be doing

- Owning the Foundation: the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day.

- Evolving Our Micro-Frontend Architecture : improve composition, isolation, and shared dependency strategies so feature teams can move fast.

- Product and Planning: Independently drive projects from idea to production: breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical plans, estimating delivery, identifying risks early, and delivering high-quality solutions in a timely manner.

- Supporting Engineering Excellence : Champion best practices, raise the bar for code quality, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.

- Long-Term Thinking: Balance short-term feature unblockers with the long-term health, security, and maintainability of the platform.

- Agentic Development: Build the foundations that let AI agents work autonomously on our platform, including agent instructions, reusable skills, tool integrations, guardrails, and the automated checks that make agent-authored changes safe to ship.

- AI Fluency: Work agent-first in your own day-to-day: delegate implementation to agents, and focus your judgment on direction, architecture, and verifying outcomes.

📍This role can be based in our Berlin tech hub. Read more about our hybrid setup here .

Feel free to check out the Wolt Tech Blog for more insight into our culture and technology.

Our humble expectations 

- Proven expertise in building production frontend applications using TypeScript and React.

- Solid backend knowledge, comfortable owning and operating Node.js services that support frontend infrastructure.

- Strong knowledge of frontend build tools, bundlers, and module systems, and the ability to evolve them as the platform grows.

- Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex performance, reliability, or DX issues in large frontend codebases.

- Experience driving technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.

- Strong stakeholder management skills: aligning priorities, managing expectations, and communicating trade-offs clearly with partner teams and leadership.

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative, platform-mindset approach to working with feature teams.

- Strong documentation skills, including experience writing RFCs or ADRs.

Nice to Haves

- Experience with micro-frontend architecture.

- Frontend platform engineering experience.

- Experience building shared component libraries used by many product teams.

- Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and cloud infrastructure for frontend workloads.

- Experience or interest in observability and reliability (SRE).

- Experience building tooling or workflows for autonomous AI coding agents (e.g., agent instructions, skills, MCP servers, or evaluating agent-generated code).

What's in it for you 

- Impact: Build and shape the platform that thousands of people depend on.

- Scale: Work on real platform problems behind 250+ MFEs with hundreds of monthly contributors.

- Collaboration: Partner with talented engineers, designers, and operators across companies to make their daily work faster and better.

- Growth: Take on deep technical challenges across frontend architecture, agentic development, DX, and improving engineering efficiency.

- Culture: Be part of a diverse, open-minded team that values creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Lead Energy Services (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

Wir bei ALVA Energie treiben die Energiewende voran! Wenn bei uns eine PV-Anlage fertig gebaut ist, fängt ein Großteil unserer Wertschöpfung erst an: Über Mieterstrom, GGV und Onsite PPA versorgen wir ganze Häuser mit grünem Strom direkt vom eigenen Dach, Tag für Tag und Jahr für Jahr. Jetzt suchen wir die Person, die Energy Services als Ganzes führt: Du berichtest direkt an unseren CEO und führst ein Team aus vier Personen.

Unser Prinzip dabei: Routinearbeit gehört in Automatisierungen – die Zeit unserer Leute gehört Urteilsvermögen, Kundenbeziehungen und Entscheidungen.

Deine Aufgaben

Steuerung, Wachstum & Führung 

- Du verantwortest Contracted ARR und ARR von Energy Services und sorgst dafür, dass neue Projekte schnell live gehen und Umsatz bringen

- Du entwickelst das KPI-Framework für Energy Services und baust eine klare, für das ganze Team sichtbare Kette von den Zielen bis zu den Ergebnissen auf

- Du führst und entwickelst dein Team und gibst jeder Person klare Ziele, KPIs und Raum zum Gestalten

- Du übernimmst unsere Schnittstelle zum Energiemanagementsystem (EMS) und entwickelst sie weiter

- Du machst EEG-Vergütung, Mieterstromzuschlag, Direktvermarktung, Marktstammdatenregister und Messstellenbetrieb zu sauberen, verlässlichen Prozessen

- Du arbeitest eng mit Asset Management, Finance, Project Management und Sales zusammen und lieferst die Datenbasis für unser Reporting an Banken und Kund*innen

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

Das bringst du mit: 

- Abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder BWL, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Du konntest bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung (3+ Jahre) in der Energiewirtschaft sammeln, idealerweise in Mieterstrom, GGV, Energievertrieb oder Messwesen

- Du gehst sicher mit KPIs und Dashboards um und triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert

Zusätzlich zählen für uns folgende Kompetenzen: 

- Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung – Du steuerst über Kennzahlen statt über Bauchgefühl und fragst bei jedem KPI, welche Entscheidung er ermöglicht

- Prozess- und Automatisierungskompetenz – Du schaust auf einen gewachsenen Abrechnungsprozess und erkennst, was bleibt, was du neu baust und was eine Automatisierung übernimmt

- Führungskompetenz – In deinem Team weiß jede Person, was ihr Ziel ist und wie sie zum ARR beiträgt

- Tech-Affinität: Du siehst neue Tools und KI als Hebel, nicht als Bedrohung

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Mit deinen Ideen gestaltest du die Zukunft der Solarenergie in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up aktiv mit!

- Eine Schlüsselrolle mit direktem Draht zum CEO und 100 % Verantwortung für deinen Bereich

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist | International Ecommerce | Berlin ASAP
description:
ennovationHUB is an expanding international e-commerce group specialising in the home & living sector, with furniture at the core of our offering. Through our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers throughout the UK, North America, the EU, and APAC. 

As we work towards €160m+ in annual revenue by 2027, we are seeking a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us as soon as possible. You will lead Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands, taking direct responsibility for revenue growth, advertising efficiency, and profitability. 

About the opportunity: 

You will be part of an international business operating multiple e-commerce brands, with substantial advertising investment across several markets. Working at this scale means your decisions will directly influence revenue and commercial results.

Google Ads already plays a significant role in our growth. We are looking for someone who enjoys navigating international e-commerce, working with large datasets, and uncovering opportunities that deliver measurable improvements.

Working alongside our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists, you will use analysis, experimentation, and hands-on optimisation to develop this established channel further. Your focus will be on maintaining strong current performance while supporting efficient growth over time.

What you will be responsible for: 

- Own Google Ads performance across international markets for one of our e-commerce brands 

- Run and optimise Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign formats 

- Monitor and improve core performance measures, including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability 

- Drive growth and improve advertising efficiency across your assigned portfolio 

- Uncover opportunities within product ranges, categories, markets, and audience groups 

- Turn campaign insights into clear recommendations and practical next steps 

- Conduct account reviews and introduce continuous performance improvements 

- Work with developers and analytics colleagues to maintain accurate tracking and reliable measurement 

- Collaborate with creative and content teams to strengthen advertising effectiveness and landing page results 

- Contribute to budget allocation, forecasting, and performance reporting 

- Stay informed about platform updates, AI-powered advertising capabilities, and industry best practices 

- Help develop structured tests and experiments that strengthen account performance over time 

The impact you can make: 

Our Google Ads campaigns already generate results. You will build on that foundation by uncovering further opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling successful approaches. 

In a competitive e-commerce environment, even small improvements can make a significant commercial difference. You will connect campaign decisions to business outcomes and remain accountable for their impact. 

You will collaborate with experienced colleagues who work quickly and place a high value on execution. We welcome independent judgment, evidence-based decisions, and constructive questions about existing approaches. You will have the trust to make decisions and directly support the company’s growth. 

In-house e-commerce experience is a requirement for this position. Candidates whose Google Ads experience is primarily gained through agencies, consultancy, or freelance work will not be considered. 

We are looking for someone who has owned performance within an e-commerce company, with results evaluated through revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and sustained growth. 

You should understand how campaign performance connects to wider commercial goals and be comfortable taking responsibility for both decision-making and implementation. 

What you will bring: 

- A minimum of 2 years of practical experience managing Google Ads campaigns 

- A proven record of managing Google Ads within an e-commerce business, with direct accountability for results and profitability 

- Extensive practical knowledge of Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns 

- Experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team 

- The ability to analyse large datasets and identify opportunities that can be put into practice 

- A solid grasp of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement 

- Working familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center 

- Strong analytical skills and a thorough approach to detail 

- Fluency in spoken and written English 

- The ability to adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment 

- A curious, proactive approach and a commitment to ongoing improvement 

- Confidence operating independently, making decisions, and owning the results 

- A readiness to use AI and automation as we continue introducing them across the business 

- Availability to start immediately or as soon as possible 

Your working style: 

You bring senior-level judgment while staying actively involved in campaign execution and performance. You draw clear conclusions from data and translate those findings into practical action. 

You want to understand what drives results and regularly look for ways to improve them. You can move comfortably between longer-term planning and daily optimisation while keeping business growth and commercial outcomes in focus. 

You enjoy developing and scaling campaigns, accepting responsibility for their performance, and helping an established channel continue to grow. 

International collaboration and travel: 

Our team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. As the company grows, we are continuing to invest in our team presence. 

The role includes travel approximately every 4–8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations. These visits provide time for joint planning, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions. 

Most work takes place remotely, complemented by regular opportunities to collaborate and plan together in person as the business scales. 

This is a long-term opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the growth of an international e-commerce group. 

Our culture at ennovationHUB: 

We value: 

- Taking ownership and following through on commitments 

- Turning plans into action 

- Communicating clearly and directly 

- Building knowledge through hands-on experience 

We welcome people from different backgrounds who care about the quality of their work, take responsibility for their contribution, and help the business progress.
