MAP is part of WPP , the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

Do you have strong data and analytical skills, with a passion for shaping business strategy? Can you architect, build, and apply modern data models to deliver impactful marketing insights? Are you seeking an exciting role with significant opportunities for leadership and growth? Then you might be the Senior Data Insights Consultant we are looking for! 

What will your day look like?

As our new Senior Data Insights Consultant, you will join our growing Technology and Data team. Here, you will be a key leader in helping our clients make data-driven decisions to enhance their digital communication on an enterprise scale. This entails designing, enabling, and delivering complex data solutions and integrations for various campaign platforms. More specifically, your tasks will include: 

- Architecting, building, and delivering value-adding insights solutions, serving as a key advisor to clients on how to leverage their data assets to optimize large-scale communication strategies. 

- Performing advanced analysis to uncover actionable patterns, trends, and opportunities that directly inform client strategy and decision-making. 

- Designing and running test-and-learn programs (A/B tests, incrementality, holdouts) across channels to measure impact and continuously optimize communication performance. 

- Partnering with senior stakeholders to define strategic business questions and translating them into robust analytical frameworks and data roadmaps. 

- Supporting or leading the data-stream on complex, large-scale projects with globally recognised brands, ensuring that data solutions and integrations are designed and delivered for scalability and business impact. 

- Driving ongoing proactive client ideation — identifying new opportunities, use cases, and data-driven initiatives that help clients grow their business. 

- Helping drive agentic AI adoption, exploring and embedding agentic solutions into our data and insights workflows to enhance efficiency and client value. 

- Providing answers and insights to business-related questions via automated reporting solutions as well as ad-hoc data analyses, including building reports and insights dashboards within marketing platforms such as Adobe and Salesforce. 

- Mentoring, reviewing, and advising less senior team members — elevating quality, fostering technical excellence, and supporting their professional growth. 

- Collaborating with highly skilled specialists including Account Managers, Architects, Developers, Creatives, Strategists, Data Scientists and Marketing Operations experts to service our clients coherently. 

Who are you going to work with?

You will join a team of hands-on Data Insights Consultants, Data Scientists and Data Engineers who are passionate about bringing value and knowledge from data. We are all about unlocking insights from data through analytics and making that insight applicable in 1:1 data-driven communication and CRM. Your work will always be firmly anchored in data in a cross-disciplinary setting, collaborating closely with highly enthusiastic experts from Strategy or Creative backgrounds. 

What do you bring to the table?

As a person, you possess a strong consultancy mindset, demonstrating resilience, curiosity, and an eager-to-learn attitude. You combine this with strong business acumen, allowing you to understand and anticipate client needs effectively. You are outgoing and love being part of interdisciplinary projects and solutions. You are eager to learn and quick to understand the complexity of high-tech dialogues and solutions. 

Furthermore, you have the drive, enthusiasm, and technical credibility to act as the primary data and insights advisor for senior client leadership, guiding them through complex challenges and inspiring them to grow their business. It's an advantage if you have consulting, agency experience or marketing domain knowledge, but it's not a requirement. 

In addition, you have: 

Technical skills 

- A minimum of 5 years of experience in a consultant/business liaison role related to data, BI, analytics or reporting solutions. Can independently design, build, and optimize modern analytics solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and ready for real-world production use. 

- Write, debug, and optimize complex SQL queries, ensuring clarity, efficiency, and production readiness. 

- Design and build scalable dimensional data models from raw source systems (fact/dimension structures, performance-aware design). Apply strong data modelling principles, governance standards and practices that ensure data accuracy, consistency, and security. 

- Develop and manage DBT transformations using layered architecture, including testing and documentation best practices. 

- Build production-ready Power BI semantic models and dashboards, including advanced DAX measures, performance optimization, and secure data access (RLS). 

- Work collaboratively using GitHub, following structured branching, pull request, and code review workflows. 

- Familiarity with or a strong interest in the application of AI and agentic frameworks, and machine learning principles to generate conversational analytics, predictive and advanced marketing insights. 

- Comfortable working in modern cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Fabric). 

- Understanding the data structures and reporting capabilities within major marketing and martech platforms (e.g., Adobe Campaign/AJO, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Ability to build and deliver reports and insights dashboards natively within these tools is a strong advantage 

Interpersonal skills 

- A proven ability to build trust and act as a strategic partner to senior-level clients and internal leaders. You can confidently navigate complex, technical stakeholder environments and influence decision-making through data-driven reasoning. 

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex data concepts and insights into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and senior business audiences. 

- The ability to critically assess complex business challenges, ask probing questions to uncover root causes, and propose robust, data-driven solutions. 

- Proven experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members. You actively foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team. 

- You are a self-starter who can think critically, identify issues and opportunities autonomously, and take the initiative to propose and implement corrective actions. 

A leader in personalized customer experiences

WPP Enterprise Solutions MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper-personalisation at scale, marketing automation, and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency, and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands (including Ford, Jaguar Land Rover, Nespresso, IKEA, Lego, and Coca-Cola) to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer-centric. description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. 

The Director, MSSP Sales, EMEA will architect, build, and scale ExtraHop’s dedicated MSSP and MDR business across EMEA. As ExtraHop continues to dominate the Network Detection and Response (NDR) space, this leader will transform how managed service providers leverage the Reveal(x) platform to deliver high-fidelity threat detection and response to their end customers. You will own the entire lifecycle of the MSSP relationship: from strategic partner acquisition and commercial modeling to technical enablement and co-selling execution

Key Responsibilities 
Strategy & Commercial Modeling: 

- Define the Go-To-Market (GTM): Design and execute a comprehensive EMEA strategy specifically targeting top-tier MSSPs and MDR providers.

- Structure MSSP Frameworks: Collaborate with Finance, Product, and Operations to design scalable, competitive commercial models (e.g., consumption-based pricing, multi-tenant licensing, pay-as-you-grow, and subscription models).

- Value Proposition: Refine ExtraHop's messaging to clearly articulate how our platform reduces MSSP analyst burnout, lowers mean time to resolution (MTTR), and increases partner margins.

Partner Acquisition & Revenue Generation: 

- Pipeline Ownership: Directly hunt and secure predictable, recurring revenue streams by embedding ExtraHop Reveal(x) into the core tech stacks of major MSSPs

- Co-Sell & Sell-Through: Drive both "sell-to" (the MSSP's own infrastructure) and "sell-through/with" (leveraging the MSSP's sales force to pull ExtraHop into enterprise accounts) revenue streams.

- Executive Relationships: Build deep, trust-based relationships with C-level executives (CEOs, CISOs, CTOs) within the target MSSP ecosystem.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Enablement: 

- Team Building: Act as a player-coach initially, with the mandate to recruit, hire, and lead a high-performing team of MSSP Account Managers and Channel Solutions Architects as the business scales.

- Enablement Ecosystem: Partner with ExtraHop Technical Marketing and Sales Enablement to build specialized onboarding, technical training, and co-marketing (MDF) programs tailored for MSSPs.

- Product Feedback Loop: Act as the voice of the MSSP partner internally, providing feedback to Product Management regarding multi-tenancy, API integrations, and reporting capabilities.

● 10+ Years in Cybersecurity Sales: A proven track record of selling enterprise-grade security software (preferably NDR, EDR, SIEM, or XDR).

● Proven "Zero-to-One" Success: Experience building a new route-to-market, division, or partner program from scratch within an established tech company.
● Complex Commercial Structuring: Deep familiarity with usage-based, multi-tenant, and utility pricing models.

Preferred Qualifications 
● High Technical Acumen: Ability to speak authoritatively with MSSP SOC Directors and CTOs about architecture, APIs, and integration ecosystems.

● Gravitas & Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to navigate complex, multi-party enterprise deal cycles.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP 

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

WPP’s Performance & Culture Center of Excellence brings together the capabilities that help our people, teams and organisation perform, grow and thrive. Within it, Enterprise Effectiveness aligns WPP’s organisation, workforce and teams around its strategic priorities and enables the change required to deliver them.

About the Role

The Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager is a contract role that will build the evidence base for the workforce and organisation decisions that matter most to WPP. This role will turn fragmented people, organisation and business data into clear insight, forward-looking scenarios and practical recommendations that help leaders decide where to invest, how to shape the workforce and how to organise for performance.

Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, you will support the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence while working closely with business, People & Culture, Finance, Data and Technology partners. You will establish a trusted workforce-intelligence capability that supports strategic workforce planning and informs priority organisation, workforce, team and people decisions across Enterprise Effectiveness and the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence. This is not a traditional reporting role. It combines strategic analytics, internal consulting and leadership of a four-person data and reporting team based in India. You will be expected to work through ambiguity, connect disparate data and systems, and progressively turn fragmented analytics into a more integrated, trusted and usable capability. As a contract appointment, the initial focus will be to establish the core workforce-intelligence approach, strengthen the India-based team and deliver insight against WPP’s highest-priority workforce and organisation questions.

Why This Role Matters

WPP’s transformation requires faster, better choices about work, skills, capacity, organisation and investment. Those choices cannot be made from disconnected dashboards or backward-looking metrics alone. In this role, you will create a more integrated view of the workforce, translate evidence into choices and trade-offs, and help leaders anticipate the implications of AI, changing client demand and new ways of working. The work will directly shape how WPP builds the capabilities, capacity and organisation required for Elevate28.

What You’ll Do

Build a trusted workforce intelligence capability

- Working with the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, shape and build an enterprise workforce-intelligence approach that connects people, organisation and business data to the decisions leaders need to make.

- Define a focused set of workforce and organisational measures, dashboards and decision-support tools, moving reporting from activity and headcount toward capacity, capability, cost, productivity, risk and value.

- Partner with data owners and technology teams to map fragmented data and systems, define analytical requirements, and strengthen data definitions, quality, accessibility and responsible use, while being clear about limitations and the strength of the evidence.

- Establish repeatable analytical standards, governance and quality controls so insight is trusted, comparable and usable across WPP.

- Apply AI and automation to improve how workforce data is integrated, analysed and translated into decision support, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, transparency and responsible-use standards.

Enable strategic workforce planning

- Help business and People & Culture leaders translate strategy, growth priorities and choices about how work is organised into workforce demand, capability and capacity requirements.

- Build scenarios that show the implications of different choices, including developing, hiring, accessing external capability, automating, augmenting, redeploying and exiting work or roles.

- Assess the current workforce and future talent supply, including critical skills, capacity, cost, location and role mix, highlighting gaps, risks and investment priorities.

- Connect workforce planning to business and financial planning cycles so decisions are timely, owned and grounded in common assumptions.

Deliver forward-looking insight and decision support

- Use statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario modelling to identify emerging workforce and organisational risks, opportunities and patterns.

- Bring structure to ambiguous business questions, identify what can be answered with available data, test hypotheses and distinguish meaningful signals from correlation or noise.

- Turn analysis into clear choices, trade-offs and recommendations for senior leaders, including the consequences of action and inaction.

- Develop concise executive narratives and visualisations that make complex findings understandable without oversimplifying them.

Strengthen organisation and transformation decisions

- Provide analytical support for organisation design, organisational health, inclusion and impact, talent development, team effectiveness and change priorities across Performance and Culture.

- Create baselines and evaluate whether organisation and workforce interventions are improving the intended outcomes.

- Combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight to explain not only what is happening, but why it matters and where targeted action is needed.

- Identify enterprise patterns across businesses, markets and functions and convert them into practical recommendations for leaders and Enterprise Effectiveness partners.

Scale tools, capability and adoption

- Build practical tools, templates and self-service products that improve the quality and consistency of workforce decisions.

- Coach People & Culture and business partners to interpret workforce insight, challenge assumptions and use scenarios in decision-making.

- Create a clear intake and prioritisation approach that focuses analytical capacity on the highest-value enterprise questions.

- Continuously improve the offer through user feedback, adoption evidence and emerging practice in workforce analytics, AI and organisational science.

- Lead and develop a four-person data and reporting team based in India, setting clear priorities, strengthening analytical and consulting capability, and shifting delivery from fragmented reporting toward higher-value workforce intelligence and decision support.

Minimum Qualifications

- Relevant experience applying data and analytics in finance, commercial, operational or other business settings, together with experience in people analytics, workforce intelligence or strategic workforce planning.

- Experience translating business questions into analytical approaches, workforce scenarios and decision-ready recommendations.

- Strong capability in data analysis, forecasting, modelling and visualisation, using appropriate business intelligence or analytical tools.

- Proven experience working through ambiguity and improving a fragmented data and analytics environment by connecting disparate sources and systems, strengthening definitions and quality, and establishing practical governance, privacy and ethical standards.

- Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and influence senior stakeholders in a complex organisation.

- AI fluency, including a practical understanding of how AI and automation can improve analytics, workforce planning and decision support, and how they may reshape work, skills, roles and workforce requirements.

- Experience leading and developing an analytics or reporting team, including setting priorities, assuring quality and building capability across locations.

- A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

- Experience applying financial, commercial or operational analysis to workforce investment, capacity, productivity or organisation decisions.

- Experience in a complex global, matrixed or multi-business organisation, ideally supporting enterprise transformation or significant workforce change.

- Proficiency with relevant business intelligence, data-visualisation or analytical tools, which may include Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or R.

- Postgraduate study or relevant professional qualifications in analytics, finance, strategic workforce planning or a related field.

What Success Looks Like

title: Staff Software Engineer (ML QA)
description:
About the job

Build the software that validates Graphcore’s machine learning stack, from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware.

You’ll design production-quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. Your work will help teams deliver reliable products, with clear evidence of numerical accuracy and performance across the stack.

You’ll architect scalable test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. You’ll create representative ML workloads, analyse their execution and turn the results into practical improvements to testing and tooling.

This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not just add tests to existing systems. You’ll deepen your understanding of the AI compute stack while solving engineering problems that connect software design with hardware behaviour.

The team and culture

Graphcore’s ML QA engineers build automation, work with industry-standard frameworks and models, and contribute to upstream open-source projects. You’ll work across software teams, using code and design reviews to strengthen quality, security and maintainability.

You’ll use workload results to challenge assumptions and guide technical decisions about how Graphcore tests its ML stack. You’ll own improvements, act quickly on testing gaps and mentor junior engineers to raise the team’s technical standards.

What we’re looking for

- Strong Python skills, demonstrated through designing, developing and maintaining production-quality software.

- Software design and architecture skills for large, complex codebases, with a focus on testability and long-term maintainability.

- Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing systems in Linux environments.

- Familiarity with C or C++, including the ability to read, debug and reason about low-level code.

- The ability to mentor junior engineers and influence engineering practices through constructive feedback.

- A self-directed approach to solving complex problems, identifying gaps and driving improvements.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

title: Software Engineer Summer Intern, AI Compute Libraries & Performance 2027
description:
Location: Bristol, UK
Salary: £2500 per month
Start date: June 2027
Application deadline : Midnight, 29th November 2026 
We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. 

The Internship Programme at Graphcore

Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence.

What you’ll work on

Use your programming skills and curiosity to help AI models run efficiently on next-generation Graphcore hardware.

How you’ll learn and grow

description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role 
As a Senior Data Scientist for Product at Legora you will turn data into decisions. You'll sit close to the business, taking questions end-to-end: shaping the metric, modelling the data in dbt, running the analysis, and making the recommendation. You'll pull in new data sources when you need to. Insights are useful; impact is what we hire for.

We're an AI-first data team . We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

There's no single profile we hire for. Some of us are strongest at data modelling and analytics engineering, some at experimentation and causal inference, some at machine learning, some at stakeholder influence. You'll likely be excellent at one or two of these and competent across the rest. That's the bar.

We're a small, centralised team supporting the whole company, hiring for the person , not the seat. Depending on your strengths and where we have the biggest gap when you join, you could be embedded primarily with:

- Product : instrumentation, feature adoption, user behaviour, A/B testing, shaping the roadmap with PMs and designers.

- Finance & RevOps : ARR, NRR, forecasting, board reporting, pricing analytics across a 40-country footprint, and unit economics for an AI-native product.

- Growth & Marketing : acquisition funnels, attribution, campaign measurement, lifecycle analytics, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.

- GTM & Customer Success : pipeline analytics, customer health, expansion signals, and retention drivers in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

You'll partner directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM, most of whom are unusually data-fluent and will happily open a SQL editor with you. Your work will directly influence how we prioritise, how we sell, how we price, and how we build.

What you will be doing 

- Partner with stakeholders across Product, Finance, GTM, Growth, and beyond to translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.

- Define the metrics that matter, design the experiments or analyses that test them, and measure the impact of what we ship.

- Conduct deep-dive analyses on the questions that move the business, and proactively surface the questions nobody is asking yet.

- Model the data you need for your work in dbt, pulling in new sources when necessary, and partner closely with data engineering on anything that needs to scale beyond your immediate use case.

- Build dashboards and reporting that scale beyond you, so the company can answer its own questions where possible.

- Help shape how the data team operates as we scale: standards, tooling, ways of working.

What you'll need 

- Strong proficiency in SQL and Python .

- Solid grasp of data modelling and what it takes to build analytical work that is reliable and trusted.

- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to influence decisions through data storytelling, including pushing back when the data doesn't support what someone wants to do.

- Genuine depth in at least one of the following, with competence across the rest and curiosity to grow:

- Data modelling and analytics engineering (dbt, dimensional modelling, semantic layers, self-service)

- Experimentation and causal inference (A/B test design, quasi-experiments, statistical rigour)

- Machine learning and applied data science (forecasting, prediction, segmentation, evaluation)

- Product analytics and metric design (funnels, cohorts, adoption frameworks, North Star metrics)

Nice to have 

- Experience in a product-led or SaaS environment, ideally B2B.

- Hands-on experience with our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Dagster .

- Prior experience as an early data hire at a fast-growing company, i.e. you've built the muscle, not inherited it.

Most importantly, you are someone who 

- "Gets stuff done" and understands building a $10bn company isn't always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours.

- Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren't always clear and processes are few.

- Is genuinely domain-curious. You don't need to have worked on every part of a business, but you should be excited to.

title: Member of Scientific Staff, Cell Culture and Functional Assays
description:
LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time

The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates.

Most of it runs in 384-well plates with imaging-based or flow cytometry readouts. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift.

Assay design and the shape of the cascade sit with the scientist who leads this work today, so you are not being asked to invent the panel. You are being asked to make it run the same way every week, to record what you did in a form the rest of the system can read, and to tighten the protocols as they settle, including moving them towards the plate formats our automation will take on.

Your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS

◆ Take over routine culture and banking for the protein cell lines, working to the protocols we already run.

◆ Learn the panel end to end by running each assay alongside the scientist who owns it.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Run at least one assay in the panel independently, including its controls and acceptance criteria.

◆ Revise one culture or assay protocol so that someone else could follow it without asking you.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Hold the weekly assay schedule on your own and return results on the agreed turnaround.

◆ Bring one protocol to a tighter precision bar, or into a plate format ready for automation.

Who you are

You are a hands-on cell biologist who takes assay variability personally. You have run the same assay often enough to tell a real effect from a bad plate, and you would rather find the cause than repeat the run.

The week has a rhythm in this job: cells to feed, plates to seed, runs to finish, numbers to return. You are happy with that, you keep records someone else can pick up, and you say early when something looks wrong rather than at the end of the week.

We do not hire people into boxes. The team is small, and early hires here end up owning work beyond the job they joined for. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

MUST HAVE

◆ Strong hands-on mammalian cell culture: adherent and suspension lines, aseptic technique, and thawing, passaging and banking to a high and consistent standard.

◆ Experience running cell-based assays end to end, including relevant controls, replicates and dose-response curves behind a reported number.

◆ Comfort with plate-based work and the arithmetic that goes with it, such as dilution series, plate maps and normalisation.

◆ Careful, traceable record-keeping that someone else can follow without asking you.

◆ A PhD in cell biology, pharmacology, immunology or a related field, or an MSc and two to three years of relevant lab experience.

NICE TO HAVE

◆ Reporter cell line bioassays for binding or blockade.

◆ Receptor internalisation, lysosomal trafficking or cytotoxicity assays.

◆ High-content or fluorescence imaging, and the image analysis behind it.

◆ 384-well formats, liquid handlers or other plate-based automation.

◆ Flow cytometry, for example for surface receptor quantification.

Why this is unusual

Most cell-based assay roles sit inside a discovery project. You build an assay, you answer a question with it, and the assay goes quiet. This one is closer to running an instrument. The same assays run every week against a stream of new molecules, and the number that comes out is the product.

That changes what good looks like. Precision matters more than novelty, a protocol is only finished when someone else can run it and get your answer, and every passage, plate and reagent lot is captured as structured data, because a result is only as trustworthy as the cells behind it.

Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. Worth knowing in advance which one you are.

How we work

This is a lab-based role at our site in King's Cross, London. The cells are in the lab, so most of your week will be too, with room for writing and analysis away from the bench. The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building.

We work in the open. Decisions are written down, work happens centrally rather than scattered across tools, and the week opens with a session the whole company attends. There is a quarterly offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late.

UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and top-tier Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows.

The team you will join

You will join the protein characterisation team and report to its lead. Day to day you will work with the scientist who designs the assay cascade, with the protein production and molecular characterisation scientists upstream of you, with the functional genomics team who share the cell culture suite, and with the engineers building the software and automation the lab runs on.

We are a small, elite team, and this is the first seat given entirely to the cell-based side of the work.

Our process

Our process has four stages. A short screening call about the role and the practicalities. A behavioural interview about how you work, run from the same template for every candidate, before anything technical. A technical stage with the protein characterisation team, built around real work rather than a puzzle, including time with us in person at the lab. Then references, aimed at whatever we still want to understand.

If you are not sure whether you match every line above, apply anyway. We would rather read it and decide.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome from candidates of any background.

description:
About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social , you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. 

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities 

- Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
- Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
- Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
- Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
- Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
- Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
- Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.
Requirements 

Background & Experience 

- At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
- Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
- A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
- Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
- Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
- Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
- Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
- Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.
Benefits 

What Makes You A Great Fit 

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us? 

- Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
- Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
- Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
- Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
- Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).
Ready to Move the Needle? 

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Sales Director EMEA
description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance : software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Overview

As a Sales Director EMEA you will be part of the leadership team, reporting directly to the CRO. You will be leading a team of Account Executives. Now that the company has a repeatable sales motion, your task will be to build a well-oiled revenue engine. You will drive ARR growth by hiring and developing sales talents, lead expansion in new geographies and segments, and set an upmarket trajectory to increase ACV.

The position is based in Paris and frequent travel is to be expected.

Responsibilities

- Participate in the definition of acquisition, retention and expansion strategies that align with business goals. Spearhead our internationalisation efforts,

- Work with your team to identify, nurture and execute on key opportunities to drive high value deals, serve as an Executive Sponsor for critical customer and prospect relationships

- Build, mentor, and lead our sales team to exceed targets. Implement effective recruitment strategies to assemble a top-tier sales force

- Oversee the creation of training programs, sales materials, and a comprehensive onboarding process. Own SalesOps, including revenue forecasting and tooling

- Develop and maintain a strong network of customers, partners, and industry thought-leaders

- Implement and operate the outbound acquisition machine ;

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with with Marketing, Product and Solution Consultants to address new market segments

- Be an ambassador for the company, participate in industry events and represent Dotfile

About you

- Over three years of sales leadership experience in Enterprise SaaS or Fintech, ideally in the compliance and fraud sectors, utilizing a proven sales playbook (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and consistently exceeding quota and revenue goals.

- Experience within the Financial Services industry

- Prior success selling into large, complex environments with multiple decision makers

- Proven track record of helping VC-backed startups go from $1M ARR to $10M ARR

- Strong technical acumen and project management skills coupled with a data-driven mindset

- Extensive knowledge and proven experience in conducting business across various sectors in the EMEA region. Native-level English and French proficiency

- Successful experience building, managing and retaining high performing teams across multiple markets

- A proven ability to build connections with industry subject matter experts and customer executives

- Outstanding communication skills, high energy and deep empathy

- Willingness to embark on the startup journey, get your hands dirty and close deals yourself

What we offer

- A front row seat at a fast-growing startup with global ambitions

- CEO and Board exposition

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Ability to work from our Paris Office

The interview process

- Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

- Round 2: Two-part discussion where you'll walk us through your career journey and the choices that shaped it, followed by a values-based conversation where you'll share real examples of how you demonstrate Ownership, Pace & Intensity, High Standards, and Resilience.

- Round 3: Deep dive into one of your key projects with someone from a different team, offering a fresh, cross-functional perspective on how you work.

- Round 4: Practical exercise, case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

- Round 5: Final conversation with our founders to discuss your long-term vision and explore how you see yourself growing with us.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Python/Django) - (F/H/X) - CDI
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 Where you'll fit in: 

Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work.

Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

Our technology 

Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. This allows us to move fast and at scale, without compromising reliability. Teams work differently but the commitment to quality is the same.

Developers at Kraken are empowered to use cutting-edge AI tools and models. Any generated code is still owned by a human.

What we do 

Kraken Engineering has multiple disciplinary groups with their own management structures and teams working together to create a unified Kraken that can be deployed to any territory in the world to achieve clients’ goals.

Client Engineering is the development arm responsible for making sure our clients receive the best possible experience and their needs are met with high quality solutions. 

🚀 What you’ll own 

- We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The French energy market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

- You will be working in a multi-disciplinary software engineering team; solving design challenges; domain modeling; solving technical problems; engineering solutions for smart meters, writing robust fault-tolerant software primarily in Python and Django, Celery, and async processing

- We have challenging technical problems to solve; like processing tens of millions of meter readings a day. We need the right technology in place to handle this smoothly as well as feeding data into a machine learning pipeline that models and predicts consumption. Or thinking about how we adapt Kraken to improve other utilities like water and broadband.

- There's a great opportunity for disruption in the French energy market. The big suppliers still dominate, but are not exactly popular. The energy landscape is changing as we move to more dis-aggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism and smarter technology.

🧠 What you bring to the party 

- Python (minimum 7 y.e.)

- Django (or equiv. web framework)

- Fluent in French, and level B2 at least in English

- Domain modelling

- HTTP and REST APIs

- Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

- Celery and async processing

- Postgres

⭐️ Bonus points

- AWS

- Terraform, Packer, Consul

- React and Redux

title: Digital Design Leader [Permanent - CDI] (f/m/d)
description:
Contexte & projet 

La mission de Decathlon est de rassembler chacun autour des merveilles du sport pour rendre le bien-être accessible à tous. Pour y parvenir, l’excellence du design est indispensable à chaque étape de notre expérience numérique : aussi bien pour les millions de sportifs qui utilisent nos sites et applications, que pour les milliers de coéquipiers qui s’appuient chaque jour sur nos outils en magasin, en entrepôt et dans nos bureaux pour accomplir leur mission.

Le design digital joue un rôle clé dans la croissance et la relation humaine chez Decathlon. Comment ? En garantissant des outils simples, fiables et agréables, et en apportant à notre communauté de designers les fondations, les systèmes et les pratiques partagées dont ils ont besoin pour concevoir les meilleures expériences possibles.

Ta mission 

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un(e) Digital Design Senior Manager au sein du Product Center of Excellence (CoE) pour piloter nos capacités centrales de design, porter la vision stratégique, faire progresser l’excellence de notre métier et animer notre communauté de designers à travers tout Decathlon Digital.

Tu auras une double mission :

- Manager directement l'équipe dédiée au Design System ainsi que l'équipe Design & Research Ops .

- Animer et inspirer fonctionnellement la communauté des product designers digitaux intégrés dans nos différents domaines métier (eCommerce, applications magasin, Supply Chain, plateformes internes) et nos pays. Tu guideras également l'évolution de nos pratiques de design à l'ère de l'IA.

Rôle & responsabilités 

En tant que Digital Design Senior Manager, tu seras le partenaire stratégique chez Decathlon Digital pour :

- Manager et faire grandir tes équipes en direct (Design System et Design & Research Ops) : fixer leurs priorités, accompagner leur développement et veiller à ce que leur travail bénéficie concrètement aux équipes de Decathlon.

- Piloter notre Design System : garantir sa pertinence pour l’ensemble de nos expériences digitales : en accompagnant les spécificités des produits B2C, E2E, B2B et les expériences sportives. Mesurer son adoption et sa contribution à l’efficacité des équipes et à la qualité des expériences.

- Piloter le Design & Research Ops : Veiller à ce que les outils, méthodes et dispositifs mis en place répondent aux besoins réels des équipes, soient effectivement adoptés et contribuent concrètement à leur efficacité ainsi qu’à la qualité des décisions produits.

- Accompagner et coacher nos coéquipiers designers de manière fonctionnelle : clarifier les parcours professionnels, structurer les parcours d'intégration (onboarding), faire monter en compétences et favoriser les synergies et le partage de pratiques entre les domaines.

- Porter la vision prospective du design et des ses pratiques, notamment à l'ère de l’IA, à travers une veille active et l'expérimentation de nouvelles pratiques.

- Créer les conditions d’une contribution active de la communauté design à l'évolution de nos outils, standards et pratiques

- Construire des partenariats solides avec les leaders Produit et Engineering afin de promouvoir l'excellence du design, l'accessibilité numérique (RGAA / WCAG), l'écoconception et l'impact business.

Savoir-faire / Compétences clés

- Expérience : Une première expérience en banque, back-office, middle-office ou opérations titres est un réel atout, tout comme une connaissance du PEA, du post-marché ou d’Euroclear France.

- Motivation : Un véritable intérêt pour les marchés de capitaux et les opérations post-marché.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre 

- Un travail à fort impact : Nous construisons l’infrastructure qui portera l’avenir de l’investissement en Europe. C’est complexe, ambitieux et porteur de sens. Vous travaillerez avec des technologies modernes et créerez quelque chose de totalement nouveau, sans système hérité et sans limites.

Nos valeurs 

- Make it easy for others. Nous simplifions le complexe et agissons avec les meilleures intentions.

title: Apporteur d’affaires indépendant (H/F)
description:
🚀 Apporteur d’affaires indépendant — Développez votre réseau avec PropertyOS

100 % à distance · Organisation libre · Commission sur les ventes issues de vos recommandations 

Vous aimez créer des contacts, repérer des opportunités et mettre les bonnes personnes en relation ?

Avec PropertyOS, vous identifiez des propriétaires, bailleurs ou petites agences intéressés par une gestion immobilière plus simple. Vous organisez le rendez-vous : le fondateur assure la démonstration et le closing. 

🏡 PropertyOS, c’est quoi ?

PropertyOS est une plateforme SaaS qui centralise les biens immobiliers, les locataires, les finances, les documents et les tâches dans un même espace.

Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de gagner du temps et de garder une vision claire de leur activité immobilière.

La plateforme est accessible directement en ligne. Nous développons également un réseau de partenaires indépendants pour la faire découvrir à de nouveaux clients grâce à une approche plus personnelle.

🎯 Votre mission : créer des opportunités qualifiées

Votre rôle consiste à :

- Identifier des propriétaires bailleurs, investisseurs et petites agences susceptibles d’être intéressés.

- Entrer en contact avec eux et comprendre leur organisation actuelle.

- Présenter simplement PropertyOS et son intérêt.

- Vérifier leur intérêt pour une démonstration et pour le budget proposé.

- Organiser un rendez-vous avec le fondateur.

- Enregistrer les informations utiles dans PropertyOS Advisor pour préparer l’échange.

Vous vous concentrez sur la prospection et la mise en relation. Le fondateur prend ensuite le relais pour la démonstration détaillée, les questions commerciales, la négociation et la conclusion de l’abonnement.

Vous ne négociez pas les conditions et ne signez pas de contrat au nom de PropertyOS.

⚡ PropertyOS Advisor : votre application partenaire

Vous disposez de PropertyOS Advisor , notre application dédiée aux apporteurs d’affaires.

Pensée pour fluidifier votre activité, elle vous permet de centraliser les informations de vos prospects, suivre vos mises en relation et transmettre le contexte nécessaire à la préparation des rendez-vous.

L’objectif : une prospection organisée et un passage de relais simple , pour donner à chaque opportunité les meilleures chances d’aboutir.

💸 Une rémunération liée aux clients apportés

L’offre mise en avant dans ce partenariat est l’abonnement annuel PropertyOS à 990 € .

Vous percevez une commission pour chaque nouveau client qui souscrit et règle cet abonnement à la suite de votre mise en relation, selon les conditions prévues au contrat.

- Rémunération à la commission uniquement. 

- Aucun salaire fixe ni revenu garanti.

- Le montant de la commission et le calendrier de versement sont communiqués avant tout engagement.

- Les règles d’attribution des prospects, de traitement des doublons et d’annulation sont précisées au contrat.

- Un rendez-vous seul ne déclenche pas de commission : celle-ci dépend de la souscription et de l’encaissement correspondants.

👋 À qui s’adresse cette opportunité ?

À des personnes autonomes, à l’aise dans les échanges et capables de créer un premier contact de qualité.

Vous pouvez avoir une expérience commerciale, un réseau dans l’immobilier ou simplement une vraie capacité à prospecter avec méthode.

Nous recherchons surtout :

- De l’écoute , pour repérer un besoin réel.

- De la clarté , pour expliquer la solution sans faire de promesses excessives.

- De la régularité , pour développer votre activité.

- De la rigueur , pour transmettre des informations fiables.

- Un bon relationnel , pour représenter PropertyOS avec professionnalisme.

Une expérience en prospection, en immobilier ou dans le SaaS est un atout. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être un expert du logiciel ni un closer confirmé.

🌴 Notre culture : détendue, directe et orientée résultats

Chez PropertyOS, on apprécie les échanges simples, les idées utiles et les personnes qui prennent des initiatives.

Vous organisez librement votre activité : pas d’horaires imposés ni de volume hebdomadaire obligatoire. Cette collaboration peut compléter d’autres activités professionnelles.

Notre façon d’avancer : partager les retours du terrain, améliorer les approches et privilégier des mises en relation pertinentes.

Une ambiance chill, des engagements tenus et des opportunités concrètes. 

🤝 Pour bien démarrer

La prise en main comprend :

- Une présentation de PropertyOS et de ses principaux cas d’usage.

- La découverte de PropertyOS Advisor.

- Des repères pour identifier les profils de clients recherchés.

- Des supports pour présenter la solution.

- Une explication du processus de mise en relation et de rémunération.

Vous avez un interlocuteur direct pour transmettre vos questions et vos retours.

📋 Cadre de la collaboration

Nature : partenariat indépendant d’apport d’affaires, sans contrat de travail.
Lieu : à distance, depuis la France.
Organisation : libre, sans exclusivité.
Démarrage : à convenir ensemble.

Vous devez disposer d’une activité indépendante déclarée et d’un SIRET pour exercer depuis la France. La micro-entreprise est une possibilité.

Vous pouvez candidater avant d’avoir créé votre activité , mais les formalités nécessaires devront être réalisées pour démarrer la collaboration.

Un contrat écrit définit les missions, les commissions et les conditions du partenariat.

🚀 Intéressé ? Présentez-vous simplement.

Envoyez-nous quelques lignes sur :

- Votre parcours et votre éventuelle expérience en prospection.

- Les types de prospects que vous pourriez contacter.

- Votre statut actuel et vos disponibilités pour démarrer.

Vous créez le contact. Nous prenons le relais pour transformer l’intérêt en abonnement.

description:
About WPP Media 

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. 

À propos de WPP : 

WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie. Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing. Pour plus d’informations, visitez www.wpp.com .

À propos de WPP Media : 

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez www.wppmedia.com .

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs qui nous unissent :

- Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif et une créativité transformationnelle.

- Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction client.

- Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et la curiosité.

À propos de Conexance / Choreograph : 

Choreograph constitue le cœur technologique et data de l'écosystème WPP, reliant la réflexion stratégique marketing à son déploiement opérationnel à grande échelle.

Conexance , entité clé de Choreograph, est le leader reconnu du Marketing Data-Driven en France. Forts de 20 ans d'expertise, nous proposons des solutions data uniques basées sur la mutualisation de données transactionnelles (base de données coopérative multi-secteurs) et sur l'Intelligence Artificielle au service de nos clients en France et au Royaume-Uni (UK) .

Notre mission : permettre à nos clients (e-commerce, retail, presse, associations/caritatif, etc.) d'exploiter tout le potentiel de leurs données pour optimiser leurs campagnes de prospection, de fidélisation et d'activation (lookalike, scoring, segmentation, CRM, profiling).

Missions & Rôle : 

Au sein du Service Études de Conexance et rattaché directement au Senior Lead Data Analyst , vous intégrez une équipe dynamique et collaborative de 7 collaborateurs (Lead Data Analyst, Data Analysts, prestataires et alternant).

Dans un contexte résolument Customer Centric , vous intervenez en support direct du commerce (FR et UK) afin de produire, analyser et restituer des études statistiques à forte valeur ajoutée.

Vos responsabilités clés : 

Production d'analyses statistiques & modélisations : 

- Élaborer des scores de prospection et modèles de lookalike (cas simples à complexes).

description:
EggAI · Full-time · Remote (EU & UK)

The Role

A very strong senior software engineer with deep, hands-on experience building and operating production systems. We hire for engineering strength first: people who write good software, reason about failure, and own what they ship.

You will work in a team of 2 to 6 engineers on a client project . Clients come to us because we work at the forefront of AI in the enterprise; you help implement our AI strategy.

AI experience is required. Much of our work involves LLM-powered and agentic systems, and while you may not be working directly on LLMs, you will be working on LLM based systems.

What You'll Do

- Build and operate the production systems at the centre of the engagement, end to end — you own what you ship, including after it's reached production

- Lead architecture discussions for your part of the system, with the support of the wider team

- Take ownership: pick up the ambiguous problem, chase down the answer, and say so when something is going wrong

- Work directly with the client's engineers and with our project manager / product owner

- Work in a "normal" team rhythm — daily standups, planning, retrospectives, code and design review

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years designing, building and maintaining production systems that real users depend on — clean testable code, sound API and data modelling, and the judgement to know which abstractions are worth it

- Production AI experience : You have built and operated GenAI systens in production with real users

- Has owned code in production — deployment, monitoring, on-call or equivalent — and can debug hard problems in live systems: concurrency, performance, data correctness

- Distributed systems fundamentals : services, queues, retries, idempotency, failure modes, and integrating third-party APIs that are not reliable

- Databases : schema design, query performance, migrations

- Operational rigour : meaningful automated testing, useful instrumentation, CI/CD and shipping incrementally

- Client-facing ability : has delivered against real business requirements and can hold a technical conversation with non-engineers

- Languages : Python (primary), TypeScript/JavaScript. Strong engineers coming from Go, Java, C#, Rust or similar who are willing to work in Python are in scope

- Infrastructure : cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerisation

Desired qualities 

- Depth — you can explain the systems you built and the trade-offs you chose

- Balances speed of iteration with production reliability

- Clear communicator, in writing as well as in conversation

- Learns new domains quickly and deliberately

Interview Process

- Introductory call - 30 minutes

- Behavioural/Management interview - 60 minutes

- Technical interview (choice of walking through own code, live coding, or take home exercise) - 60 minutes

description:
EggAI · Full-time · Remote (EU only)

The Role

You will lead a small, highly-skilled remote team of engineers designing and shipping production-grade agentic AI systems. Working directly with enterprise clients, you will validate where AI can create value, redesign business processes, and own the resulting system from early experiments through adoption and measurable results.

Across these environments, you will learn from recurring production failure modes and have the latitude to choose the models, tools, and architecture to solve the business problem.

Alongside client delivery, you will turn successful approaches into shared assets that strengthen future engagements. Those contributions will shape EggAI's engineering culture and give you broad influence over how we work.

- Discover: Validate business opportunities against AI capabilities and constraints, and identify new opportunities enabled by the technology.

- Design: Own solution design and system architecture across agents, tools, data, evaluations, controls, human oversight, and deterministic boundaries.

- Build: Personally implement the system's critical agents, integrations, evaluation infrastructure, permissions, observability, controls, and feedback loops.

- Deliver: Lead the team and client from implementation through adoption, owning engineering quality and production readiness while establishing a clear delivery rhythm and engineering accountability across the project team.

- Compound: Package successful work as tools, datasets, evaluations, patterns, and engineering methods.

What We're Looking For

- A sustained record of exceptional technical leadership that generated real business impact, including experience leading small engineering teams.

- Experience designing, shipping, and operating production-grade AI systems, with practical judgment across architecture, context, tools, evaluation, observability, production controls, reliability, and cost.

- A demonstrated ability to keep pace with advances in AI, test what matters, and change working methods when new capabilities prove substantive, evidenced by advanced use of agentic AI in day-to-day work.

- Repeated ownership of difficult stakeholder environments and the judgment to connect technical decisions to business value, user needs, risk, and organizational change.

- Excellent communication skills across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

- Strong coding skills and the ability to write and review production-grade code in languages such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.

- A strong engineering foundation and the first-principles judgment to understand what established practices protect and how those protections should be implemented in AI-native systems.

title: Doctorant(e) "Développement et caractérisation d’une plateforme multi-capteurs pour le monitoring de sites de stockage onshore de CO2" - Contrat doctoral
description:
ENGLISH VERSION 

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. 

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. 

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. 

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. 

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. 

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. 

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité. 

Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins. 

L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité. 

🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’ industrie du futur. 

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ? 

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous 

En tant que doctorant, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de recherche et innovation et, dans une moindre mesure de nos missions d’enseignement. Vous serez affecté au centre SPIN – LGF (Laboratoire Georges Friedel, UMR CNRS 5307). Au sein de ce centre, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal.

Le centre SPIN (Science des Procédés Industriels et Naturels), qui sera fortement impliqué dans la thèse, développe, au sein de Mines Saint-Etienne, son expertise dans le domaine du Génie des Procédés appliqué aux systèmes dispersés : grains, particules, gouttes, bulles, milieux poreux. Il possède également des compétences en développement de capteurs et d’instrumentation.

Les technologies de captage et stockage du CO2 sont des technologies clés pour la décarbonation du secteur industriel. Les stockages offshores ont déjà démontré leur faisabilité, mais les stockages onshores semblent nécessaires pour augmenter les capacités de stockage tout en réduisant le transport de CO2. Or, la proximité de ces sites avec les populations rend leurs déploiements incertains et soulève des questions relatives à l’acceptabilité sociale.

La surveillance à long terme des sites de stockage de CO2, exigée par la directive européenne CCS, constitue une opportunité pour renforcer la transparence et l’acceptation locale du stockage en engageant les parties prenantes dans l’acquisition et l’interprétation des données. Cependant, les systèmes actuels de surveillance ne permettent pas à la fois de réaliser des mesures in-situ, simulations numériques et visualisation interactive pour une approche du suivi intégrée des sites de stockage. Le projet CO2MET vise à développer et faire progresser des unités ou éléments clés pour préparer un futur système intégré de surveillance numérique à long terme améliorant la fiabilité et l’acceptabilité du stockage géologique de CO2.

Pour atteindre ces objectifs, le consortium CO2MET a été constitué et est composé de l'IFPEN, du BRGM, de Mines Saint-Etienne et de Cerema.

La surveillance à long terme nécessite des outils fiables et performants, notamment dans le domaine des capteurs environnementaux, ce qui soulève la question de la mise en œuvre de mesures correctives pour traiter le signal, ainsi que celle de l'influence des variations à long terme des paramètres externes sur la réponse des capteurs (et de l'impact du changement climatique). Étant donné que les signaux de concentration en CO₂ peuvent, à eux seuls, ne pas être suffisamment discriminants (les concentrations biologiques dans les sols pouvant dépasser 10 % vol.), compte tenu de leurs origines diverses (sources profondes, provenant du stockage ou de l’interaction gaz-roche ; processus de respiration ; oxydation du méthane), la prévention des faux positifs dans la surveillance des sites de stockage doit s'appuyer sur des capteurs de CO₂ (NDIR ou photoacoustiques) et sur d'autres capteurs (par exemple, un capteur chimique d'O₂), ainsi que sur des capteurs environnementaux (humidité, pression, température) afin de permettre une attribution correcte de la source de CO2.

Parmi les missions qui lui seront attribuées, le doctorant devra :

· Sélectionner des capteurs existants répondants aux spécifications afin de mettre au point une plateforme de détection 

· Etudier, en conditions de laboratoire, la sélectivité des capteurs vis-à-vis des espèces gazeuses interférentes, à l’aide d’une analyse multivariée

· Définir des algorithmes de prédiction tenant compte de la reproductibilité, de la dérive, de la linéarité et de la variabilité dans des mélanges gazeux complexes et des conditions environnementales variables (température, pression et humidité relative)

· Etudier l'influence du vieillissement des capteurs sur leur réponse et sur les prévisions établies, afin de proposer un algorithme de compensation

· Enfin, mener des études de cas concrets sur le site de Sainte-Marguerite (Puy-de-Dôme), avec des niveaux d'émissions de CO₂ variables, afin de tester et de valider les plateformes de capteurs développées.

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer enseignement, recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir.

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un :

· Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent

Et idéalement :

· Titulaire d’un de master 2 dans les domaines suivants : Mesure / Instrumentation / Métrologie ; Acquisition, traitement et analyse de la donnée

· Avec une expérience de stage ou professionnelle dans la recherche (goût prononcé pour la partie expérimentale)

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

• La thématique du sujet étant multidisciplinaire de solides connaissances en instrumentations / capteurs, traitements de données, analyse multivariée seront nécessaires. D’autres part, des connaissances en probabilités / statistiques seront également appréciées.

• Le sujet comporte un volet expérimental important mais de solides connaissances numériques seront utiles pour la partie traitement des données (notamment codage sur python)

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde .

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet VARIMA (VAlorisation des Résidus d’Incinération en Matériaux Avancés) du dispositif Partenariats d'innovation Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - volet Preuves de Concept.
