title: Senior Information Security Officer
description:
Your Role in Our Story: 

ACT is strengthening its data, technology and AI capabilities as we build a more integrated digital platform alongside our core environmental commodities trading and market-making business. This transformation is commercially driven, enabling us to scale, deepen client relationships and support increasingly complex and digital markets.

As Senior Information Security Officer, you will own ACT’s enterprise information security strategy and governance at Group level, spanning our core operations, emerging digital businesses and client-facing technology platforms. You will define the security risk appetite, lead our response to an evolving threat landscape, and ensure security and resilience are embedded by design as our technology landscape develops.

Working across business and technology leadership, you will translate commercial ambition into a pragmatic and scalable security posture that protects our systems and data while maintaining the trust of clients, counterparties and regulators. In essence, your role involves:

Strategy & Governance 

- Own the Group-wide information security strategy and roadmap across ACT’s core market-making business and digital and client-facing platforms, aligned with business goals and industry frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST CSF. Define and maintain ACT’s cyber risk appetite.

- Establish and lead security governance, including policies, standards and control frameworks, with clear accountability across the Group. Report on security posture and material incidents to executive leadership and, where relevant, the Board.

Client Platforms & Secure-by-Design 

- Embed security-by-design into new products and client platforms, partnering with Data, Architecture and Commercial teams to ensure emerging digital capabilities are secure from inception, while acting as a credible security voice to clients and counterparties.

- Oversee application, product and SaaS security, embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle for internal and client-facing platforms, and assessing third-party services handling ACT and counterparty data.

Risk & Resilience 

- Lead enterprise security risk management, including risk assessments, vulnerability management and third-party/supply-chain risk, driving timely mitigation across core and digital environments.

- Direct incident preparedness and response, coordinating detection, containment, eradication and recovery, while continuously strengthening incident and crisis-management plans.

Infrastructure & Emerging Technology 

- Secure ACT’s cloud and infrastructure through Zero-Trust-aligned controls, including identity and access management, segmentation and encryption, across a hybrid and multi-platform environment.

- Govern emerging technology and AI security, extending security oversight to AI and data platforms, including model and data-exposure risks and AI-enabled threats, as ACT expands its use of AI.

Compliance & Leadership 

- Ensure regulatory and compliance alignment, including GDPR, DORA and relevant sector obligations, advising the business on required adaptations and coordinating audits and certifications.

- Lead the security function and strengthen security culture across the Group, developing the team, raising security awareness, and acting as ACT’s primary authority and trusted advisor on cyber security to executives and business leaders, working alongside existing teams and capabilities.

Your Expertise: 

To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes: 

- A Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field. A relevant Master’s degree is an advantage.

- 10–15 years of progressive experience in information security and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years in a senior security role, with ownership of enterprise security strategy, governance and risk management.

- Broad security leadership experience across incident response, cloud and infrastructure security, product/application security and regulatory compliance. Experience securing client-facing platforms or digital products is highly valuable.

- Experience within trading, financial services, commodities or another data-intensive and regulated environment is highly advantageous.

- Strong knowledge of security frameworks and standards, including ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and CIS Controls, with practical experience implementing them.

- Good understanding of data protection, regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, DORA and standards such as SOC 2.

- Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CISA, or equivalent, are highly desirable.

- Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex security risks into clear business implications and advise technical teams, executives, business stakeholders and clients.

If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer 

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero 

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity .

Your team 

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters 

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like 

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

· Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

· Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

· Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

· Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

· Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

· Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

· Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves 

· A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

· At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

· Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

· Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

· Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

· Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

· Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

· Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

· You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

· You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves 

· Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

· Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

· Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

· Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

· Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

· Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero 

· Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

· Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

· Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

· International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

· Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

title: Marketing & Communications Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Du möchtest nicht einfach Marketing machen. Du möchtest etwas bewegen.

Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und aus guten Ideen etwas Konkretes zu machen? Du bist neugierig, stellst Fragen und probierst auch mal neue Wege aus? Und Du findest, dass gute Ergebnisse am besten gemeinsam entstehen?

Dann könnten wir gut zusammenpassen.

Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur einen Marketingplan abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt, Dinge hinterfragt und Lust hat, mit uns etwas zu gestalten.

Dabei glauben wir an klare Worte, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und hohe Ansprüche an unsere Arbeit. Wir nehmen unsere Aufgaben ernst – uns selbst aber nicht immer. Und wir sind überzeugt, dass Professionalität und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören.

Über OIXIO

OIXIO gehört zu den führenden IT-Anbietern Estlands – einem Land, das wie kaum ein anderes in Europa für gelebte Digitalisierung und einen hohen Stellenwert von Cybersecurity steht.

Was dort über viele Jahre gewachsen ist, bringen wir jetzt verstärkt nach Deutschland: technologische Kompetenz, pragmatische Lösungen, direkte Zusammenarbeit und die Überzeugung, dass gute Digitalisierung vor allem eines tun muss – funktionieren.

Mit OIXIO erminas verbinden wir diesen estnischen Spirit mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung mit deutschen Hidden Champions im Mittelstand und unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre IT sicher, verlässlich und zukunftsfähig aufzustellen – von Cybersecurity und IT-Infrastruktur über Business-Anwendungen und Cloud bis zu Daten, KI und Industrial IoT.

In Deutschland stehen wir mit unserer gemeinsamen Geschichte noch am Anfang – und kaum jemand kennt hier bisher unseren Namen. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der das ändern will und lieber etwas aufbaut, als eine fertige Rolle zu übernehmen.

Die Aufgabe

Als Marketing & Communications Manager Deutschland machst Du OIXIO bei mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen bekannt und vertrauenswürdig – vor allem in Norddeutschland und Nordrhein-Westfalen – und schaffst die Gespräche, auf denen unser Vertrieb aufbaut.

Du entwickelst unsere Botschaften für den deutschen Markt und übersetzt unser Angebot in klare Geschichten für IT, Produktion und Geschäftsführung.

Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Account Manager steuerst Du gezielte Kampagnen für eine definierte Liste von Zielunternehmen und machst aus Interesse konkrete Gespräche.

Du baust die Präsenz von OIXIO auf LinkedIn auf – für das Unternehmen sowie für unsere Expertinnen, Experten und Geschäftsführung.

Du pflegst Kontakte zu Fach- und Regionalmedien und platzierst Artikel, Fachbeiträge und Kundengeschichten.

Du organisierst eigene Veranstaltungen – vom Kundenfrühstück im Werk über Webinare bis zu Roundtables – und wählst die Messen und Netzwerkveranstaltungen aus, auf denen wir präsent sind.

Du erstellst Inhalte, die überzeugen: Case Studies, One-Pager, Präsentationen, Videos und Webinhalte – gemeinsam mit unseren Fachleuten in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen.

Du misst, was wirkt – Website-Besuche, Anfragen, Veranstaltungsteilnahmen, aktivierte Zielunternehmen und Vertriebstermine – und steuerst Deine Aktivitäten in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

Unsere Themen: Cybersecurity, Informationssicherheit, Managed IT Services, Microsoft Business Central/NAV-Modernisierung, Prozessdigitalisierung, Industrial IoT, Cloud, Daten und KI.

Was Du mitbringen solltest

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing oder in der Unternehmenskommunikation, idealerweise mit IT-Services, Managed Services, Industrieautomation, Beratung oder Business-Anwendungen.

- Nachweisbare Erfolge darin, Sichtbarkeit aufzubauen und Nachfrage zu erzeugen – gerne auch als erste oder einzige Marketingverantwortliche in einem Unternehmen oder Markt.

- Erfahrung mit Kampagnen für konkrete Zielunternehmen und mehrere Entscheiderinnen und Entscheider auf Kundenseite.

- Gutes Verständnis für mittelständische Unternehmen, besonders im industriellen Umfeld, und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären.

- Starke Schreibkompetenz, sicherer Umgang mit LinkedIn, CRM und Web-Analytics, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gutes Englisch.

- Du kennst die wichtigsten Werkzeuge des modernen B2B-Marketings und weißt, wie Du ihre Wirkung misst. Ob Dynamics 365, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Analytics, SEO-Tools oder KI: Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Du jedes Tool bereits beherrschst, sondern dass Du weißt, was Du erreichen willst, und Dich schnell in neue Werkzeuge einarbeiten kannst.

- Flexibler Wohnort in Norddeutschland, sofern regelmäßige persönliche Treffen mit dem Team in unserem Büro in Oldenburg gut möglich sind; Reisebereitschaft deutschlandweit, gelegentlich auch nach Estland und Litauen.

Was gut zu uns passt

- Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen. Ein komplett bestelltes Feld brauchst Du nicht – im Gegenteil: Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, entwickelst Ideen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, daraus etwas zu machen.

- Du bist neugierig auf Menschen, Unternehmen und Technologien und willst verstehen, bevor Du kommunizierst.

- Du schätzt Flexibilität, möchtest aber nicht ausschließlich im Homeoffice arbeiten. Der persönliche Austausch im Team, mit unseren Kunden und mit der Presse ist Dir wichtig.

- Du kannst die Stärke und Erfahrung einer etablierten internationalen IT-Gruppe nutzen und gleichzeitig mit uns herausfinden, was davon für den deutschen Mittelstand wirklich relevant ist.

- Du arbeitest eigenständig, aber nicht als Einzelkämpfer. Bei uns ist Marketing Teamsport: Gute Ergebnisse entstehen gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Consultants, Technik und Geschäftsführung.

- Du misst Deinen Erfolg at Gesprächen und Kunden – nicht an Likes – und versprichst nichts, was unser Team nicht halten kann.

- Und Du hast Lust, ein Stück des OIXIO Spirits aus Estland nach Deutschland zu bringen – und ihm hier gemeinsam mit uns eine eigene Handschrift zu geben.

Was wir bieten

- Eine konkrete Rolle beim Aufbau von OIXIO in Deutschland – mit Gestaltungsspielraum und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

- Ein echtes Budget für Veranstaltungen, Inhalte und Medienarbeit sowie Unterstützung durch Spezialisten, wo es nötig ist.

- Erfahrene Fachleute in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen, die Inhalte, Demos und Vorträge beisteuern.

- Ein breites Leistungsportfolio rund um IT, Cybersecurity, Digitalisierung, Business-Anwendungen und Industrial IoT – mit vielen Geschichten, die erzählt werden wollen.

- Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit estnischer Bodenständigkeit, direkter Kommunikation und pragmatischer Zusammenarbeit.

- Wir erwarten viel und geben auch viel zurück: Vertrauen, Freiraum, faire Bedingungen und Menschen, auf die Du Dich verlassen kannst.

Warum diese Rolle interessant ist

Deutschland ist für OIXIO ein wichtiger Wachstumsmarkt. Mit unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg, einem erfahrenen Team und einem relevanten Angebot passen wir gut zu den Herausforderungen vieler mittelständischer Industrieunternehmen – jetzt muss es der Markt nur noch erfahren.

Wenn Du Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing mitbringst, Lust hast, eine Marke von Grund auf bekannt zu machen, und lieber mit einem guten Team als mit großen Schlagworten arbeitest, freuen wir uns auf das Gespräch mit Dir.

Die Elbphilharmonie und Laeiszhalle Betriebsgesellschaft mbH ist die Betreiberin der Elbphilharmonie sowie der über 100 Jahre alten Laeiszhalle. Wir glauben an die Stärke divers aufgestellter Teams und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Personen, die uns durch andere Perspektiven und Erfahrungshorizonte ergänzen. Bewerbungen von BIPoC und Menschen mit Migrationshintergrund sind eindeutig erwünscht.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. - Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity

- Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options

- Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

We’re excited about you because you have

- 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership

- Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics

- Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points

title: Staff Engineer
description:
About Andercore 

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

- Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

- Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

- 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

- $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role 

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times. 

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack 

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.

What you will do 

- Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture. 

- Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it. 

- Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading. 

- Make reliability, security and observability part of how we build: monitoring, alerting, incident response and postmortems that lead to real changes. 

- Design how our AI agents act safely on money-touching paths, with evaluations, guardrails, audit trails and human review where it matters. 

- Set standards for correctness and data integrity, including idempotency, validation and testing, together with QA. 

- Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and direct feedback, and help us hire by defining what great engineering looks like at Andercore.

In your first six months, you might 

- Design the architecture of our pricing engine so it scales with a growing assortment and more markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds. 

- Lay out the target architecture and first steps for moving our transaction core off Salesforce.

- Build the observability and incident setup that lets us catch problems before customers or colleagues notice them

What you bring 

- At least 8 years of experience building and running software in production, including systems where errors cost real money. 

- Deep backend expertise at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. 

- A track record of setting architecture across several teams, through influence rather than a management title. 

- Experience designing transactional, distributed and event-driven systems, with a strong focus on correctness, failure modes and performance. 

- Hands-on depth in reliability, security and observability, and experience leading incidents and postmortems. 

- Experience in a fast-growing company, and a track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

- Experience with re-platforming or carving out systems from a platform like Salesforce or an ERP is a plus

Practical details

title: Field Service Engineer – Semiconductor Equipment (f/m/d)
description:
Description 

Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across Taiwan, the United States, and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important.

As our Field Service Engineer, you'll take hands-on ownership of our systems throughout their operational lifecycle — from installation and commissioning to preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.

You'll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You'll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus.

This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base.

Who we are 

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join Quantum Diamonds? 

Picture this: 

- Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

- Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

- Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

- An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us? 

- You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

- From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

- Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

- You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible! 

What will you do 

- Install, commission, and qualify our quantum sensing systems at customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams.

- Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems.

- Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when deeper technical expertise is required.

- Take ownership of system reliability and technical service, working closely with Field Application Engineers who focus on measurement execution and customer applications.

- Manage spare-parts availability for your installed base, including inventory tracking, consumption planning, replenishment, and coordination of service logistics.

- Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development.

- Build trusted relationships with customers by providing clear technical communication, reliable support, and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments.

- Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, documentation, and training materials.

What is expected of you 

- 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Field Service Engineer, Equipment Engineer, or in a comparable technical service role, ideally working with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment.

- Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software.

- Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures.

- Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications.

- Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage.

- A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, even when working under time pressure.

- Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and build trust with different stakeholders.

- Willingness to travel internationally for approximately 80% of your working time, primarily supporting customer installations across the US, Europe, and Asia.

- Fluency in English; German, Mandarin, Japanese, or Korean would be a plus.

- A degree in Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent technical training and relevant practical experience.

Our benefits 

- Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

- Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

- Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

- Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

- Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

- Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

- Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

About us 

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: AI Builder — Working Student
description:
EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems. 

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions? 

We will explore EvalOps : the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

- Regression suites : How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

- Coverage estimation : How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

- Live monitoring : Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?

- Eval analysis : How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.

The role

As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:

- Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

- Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.

- Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.

- Communicate decisions and learning clearly.

- Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.

- Code and build end to end.

This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.

Three pillars, different passions

Pillar

Driving question

Possible EvalOps focus

Product 

What should we build?

Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.

Engineering 

How should we build it?

Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.

Data Science 

How do we know it works?

Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.

We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.

What we value

- Problem obsession . A difficult question captures your curiosity. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.

- Initiative and follow-through . You turn uncertainty into something you can investigate, test, and improve—and stay resourceful when the first approach fails.

- Evidence of making things work . Show us something you created, the decisions you made, and what you learned along the way.

- Independent judgment . You test new capabilities yourself, distinguish evidence from enthusiasm, and change your mind when the findings warrant it.

- Generosity in collaboration . You explain your thinking, seek candid feedback, act on it, and help others make progress. 

What is required

- You are pursuing a Master’s degree.

- You can write code and turn an idea into working, tested software.

- You can work from Tübingen and communicate fluently in English, our company language.

Relevant fields include Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics, Computational Neuroscience, Medical Informatics, Quantitative Data Science, Cognitive Science. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.

What you will gain

- Industry insight . Learn what works and what breaks in real enterprise AI systems, with access to problems from EggAI’s client work

- Meaningful ownership . Take an EvalOps problem from investigation to a working, evaluated solution, with freedom to shape the approach.

- Close mentorship . Work directly with EggAI’s Chief AI Officer and sharpen your judgment through feedback from engineering, product, and project leads.

- Room to develop . Deepen your strengths, learn from peers with complementary perspectives, and use modern AI-development tools on unresolved problems.

- A say in the Lab’s direction . Help establish its working practices, propose new questions, and influence what it pursues next.

- Competitive compensation , including recognition for exceptional contributions, and a potential path to a full-time EggAI role after graduation.

How to apply

A short cover letter is required.

Your CV tells us what you have done so far, but we're also interested in the why . Use the letter to explain why you made those choices, what drives you, and why the AI Builder role at EggAI Labs feels like the right next step in your career. 

We are looking for exceptional students, and excellence takes many forms, e.g., academic results, research or ambitious projects. Whatever form yours takes, show us the appropriate evidence, be it grades, publications, something you've built or other evidence of impact.

This is an in-person role in Tübingen. We can only consider candidates who live within commuting distance.

title: Senior Accountant – Finance Operations (m/f/d)
description:
About us

EggAI is a fast-growing, 100% remote AI consulting and development startup based in Munich. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets at the same time, are actively building our internal structures — and are looking for someone to help shape this growth phase.

Your role

You are our go-to person for day-to-day accounting. You make sure every receipt, invoice and expense ends up in the right place — cost center, account, country — and you prepare everything so that our external tax advisor can book without back-and-forth. You work across several European countries, with employees and freelancers, and with local payroll providers. We don’t have fully established processes yet, so you won’t just follow a playbook: you spot gaps, think the process through and set it up yourself. You work closely with our Head of Finance, who owns controlling, forecasting and reporting, and with our external tax advisor, who handles ongoing bookkeeping, annual financial statements and German payroll. You ideally bring your own experience from a tax advisory firm or a similar environment.

Your responsibilities

● Preparatory bookkeeping: Pre-code receipts and prepare them for ongoing bookkeeping by our tax advisor

● Receipt and invoice management: Collect receipts and incoming invoices, review them, and consistently follow up on open items

● Correct allocation: Make sure expenses are assigned to the correct cost center and the correct account in the chart of accounts

● Travel expenses across Europe: Manage per diems (meal allowances), mileage allowances and comparable expense rules across countries for our teams in Europe

● Employees & freelancers across Europe: Know the Europe-wide controlling and accounting topics that apply to employees and freelancers — or get up to speed on them quickly

● International payroll interface: Manage local payroll providers and salary payments

● Cash flow: Think along on cash flow structures & reporting, and keep them up to date

● Process setup: Independently think through and set up finance processes and structures in an international, growing environment

What you bring

Must have

● 4+ years of professional experience in finance & accounting

● German at a fluent professional level (C1/C2), including German accounting and tax terminology; English at least B1, as our team is diverse and English is often the working language

● Very good DATEV skills and solid understanding of the chart of accounts and correct account assignment

● Flexibility with tools: you quickly find your way around other systems such as Odoo

● You have owned finance and accounting topics end-to-end, without day-to-day guidance

● You are comfortable in gray areas and make good decisions even without complete information

Nice to have

● Completed commercial vocational training or a degree with a focus on finance, accounting or controlling

● Understanding of how a balance sheet should be structured to be meaningful for investors — ideally through your own experience in a tax advisory firm or similar environment

● Exposure to controlling topics such as cost centers, forecasts or project margins

● Motivated, proactive and creative personality with a hands-on mentality — you want to shape things, not just administer them

Why EggAI?

● 100% remote work in an international, highly motivated team

● Flat structures and direct access to the Head of Finance and the founders — short paths, fast decisions

● Freedom to shape: you help build the finance infrastructure of an AI scale-up from the ground up

● Insight into one of the most dynamic growth fields in tech and into building a company across Europe

Sounds like you?

We'd love to hear from you!

If your profile looks like a good match we'll be in touch to organise a first stage interview.

Please note, due to the high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.

title: Staff Digital Media Manager (w/m/d) Programmatic & Social
description:
Über IONOS

Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. 

Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen. 

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Du kennst Programmatic in- und auswendig und willst Deinen Kanalbereich nicht nur steuern, sondern verantworten? Bei uns gestaltest Du Programmatic Video, CTV und Paid Social für unsere Brand-Kampagnen über mehrere Marken und Märkte und machst sie mit KI-Workflows schneller und besser.

Aufgabenbereich

- Du verantwortest Programmatic Video, CTV, Online Video und Paid Social für unsere Brand-Kampagnen über mehrere Marken und Märkte, von der Kanalstrategie über das Setup bis zur laufenden Optimierung.

- Du entwickelst die Budget- und Kanalplanung für Deine Kanäle inklusive Performance-Forecasts und bringst Deine Empfehlungen in die übergreifende Mediaplanung ein.

- Du verhandelst und steuerst Deals mit Streaming-Publishern und Vermarktern, z. B. Private Marketplaces, Programmatic Guaranteed und Direct Deals.

- Du definierst Standards für Tracking, Taxonomie und Testing in Deinen Kanälen, etwa für Brand-Lift- und Creative-Tests, und sorgst dafür, dass alle Märkte sie einhalten.

- Du baust und betreibst KI-gestützte Workflows für Setup, Reporting und Optimierung, von der ersten Idee bis zum laufenden Betrieb.

Qualifikationen

- Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Media-Management auf Agentur- oder Unternehmensseite mit Schwerpunkt Programmatic Video, CTV oder Online Video.

- Fundierte Hands-on-Erfahrung mit DSPs wie DV360 oder The Trade Desk, mit CM360 und Adservern sowie mit Paid Social Video auf Meta, YouTube und TikTok.

- Tiefes Verständnis von Video-Inventar, Auktionsmechaniken, Deal-Typen und CTV-Besonderheiten wie Frequency Capping und Viewability.

- Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Budget- und Kanalplanung über mehrere Märkte inklusive Forecasting und Reporting mit BI-Tools wie Looker oder Tableau.

- Du hast eigene Automatisierungen mit KI-Tools gebaut, die im Arbeitsalltag laufen, und kannst Beispiele zeigen.

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, da du Deals mit deutschen Publishern und Vermarktern verhandelst und betreust, sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, denn Englisch ist unsere Alltagssprache in der Zusammenarbeit mit Teams über Marken und Märkte hinweg.

Benefits

- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell.

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.

- Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.

- Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.

- Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.

- Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

- Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbung

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

title: Senior Software Engineer (all identities) - Healthcare Integrations
description:

Caspar Health connects digital rehabilitation with personal therapeutic care. We help people receive care during and after their clinic stay, wherever they are.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Integration Squad. You will strengthen our backend engineering capacity and help clinic IT teams and software partners connect reliably to Caspar Health.

The role covers both existing interfaces and new integrations, from implementation and partner onboarding through production support and ongoing improvement. Hands-on experience implementing and operating FHIR integrations in production is a required qualification.

We would like to hear about the production FHIR integrations you have delivered, the systems you connected, the decisions you owned and how you kept the integrations reliable after launch. 

This role is located in Germany and requires full physical presence within the country . Due to our existing payroll and social security framework, permanent remote employment from abroad is not supported. Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany and resident from their first day. Please be advised that we cannot offer visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time. 

Deine Herausforderungen

- Develop, roll out, operate and maintain integrations across our interface landscape

- Take integrations through requirements clarification, data mapping, implementation, partner testing, go-live and ongoing support

- Maintain and improve existing interfaces, resolve production issues and support changes in clinic and partner systems

- Build reliable data flows for patient information and therapy schedules

- Design and maintain backend services and versioned APIs in our Ruby on Rails and TypeScript environment

- Handle duplicate messages, delayed or out-of-order updates, cancellations and partial failures with clear retry and reconciliation behaviour

- Extend our developer portal with runnable quickstarts, accurate API references, synthetic examples and troubleshooting guidance

- Work with clinic IT teams and software partners on tested interface contracts and repeatable onboarding

- Improve automated contract and end-to-end tests, monitoring and operational runbooks

- Share maintenance, support and knowledge through pairing, design discussions and code reviews

- Apply secure authentication, authorisation, tenant isolation and data-handling practices with our infrastructure and privacy specialists

Dein Profil

- Substantial hands-on experience delivering FHIR integrations used in production, including personal responsibility for implementation and troubleshooting after launch

- Practical knowledge of FHIR resources, profiles, implementation guides, identifiers, terminology bindings, extensions and validation

- Hands-on production experience with Ruby on Rails, including maintaining and troubleshooting backend APIs and asynchronous integrations.

- You have practical experience working with AWS infrastructure, including the ability to integrate and manage cloud-based services

- Experience with healthcare data models, patient and encounter lifecycles, identity matching and appointment changes

- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modelling, migrations and performance-conscious queries

- Experience designing secure REST APIs and asynchronous or event-driven integrations

- Clear documentation and communication with engineers, product colleagues and integration partners

- A collaborative, pragmatic approach and strong written and spoken English

Warum Caspar Health?

- Remote-first with flexible working hours – office optional in Berlin-Mitte or up to 90 days a year outside of Germany

- To match this, we support you with a monthly home office allowance and an additional meal subsidy

- Plenty of time to recharge – with 30 vacation days per year

- Budget for learning & development, conferences, and coaching – tailored to your potential and growth opportunities

- High level of ownership and decision-making freedom – no micromanagement. We hire experts who know what they’re doing. #MakeAnImpact!

- Genuine collaboration – no silos, no egos. After all, we’re all working toward the same vision. #ValueFocus!

- Access to all Caspar offerings for mental and physical well-being #HealthyTogether!

- And yes – all the snacks your heart desires, group sports sessions, a never-empty drinks fridge, and a healthy dose of humor are included too

What defines us as a team

- We live diversity – it's not a marketing slogan, it's part of our everyday reality

- Feedback isn’t a tool – it’s part of our culture

- We believe that technology only makes sense when it truly helps people

- Our drive is purpose – but our standard is professionalism

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!" 

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at our Hamburg headquarters. Our goal is to supercharge how our business works with AI and technology, wherever it makes a real difference. You'll build the systems our teams rely on every day, from internal applications to the data and AI capabilities behind them, and see the impact of your work directly in the business. 

This is a role for an experienced engineer who takes real ownership: someone who designs solid systems, builds AI into them where it adds value, and drives their work through to production and real users.

Your Mission

- Own systems end to end: Design, build and run features across frontend and backend, from technical approach through deployment and support in production.

- Build AI into our products: Design and integrate AI-powered features such as structured extraction, classification, automation and agentic workflows. Make them reliable through validation, evaluation and human review where it matters.

- Data modelling and architecture: Build solid data models in PostgreSQL that serve as the foundation for our applications and AI features. Make architecture decisions that keep our systems maintainable as they grow.

- Modern and established codebases: Build new applications on our modern stack, and maintain and modernise our established JavaScript platform, which our teams rely on every day.

- Quality you can stand behind: Write tested, reviewed code and verify your own work before it reaches users. Monitor and troubleshoot production issues.

- Work closely with the business: Understand the processes behind what you build, work directly with our commercial and operational teams, and help shape what gets built and why.

- Raise the bar: Share knowledge,

Your Profile

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building and running production applications end to end.

- Proven experience building AI into production systems or applications, for example LLM-based extraction or classification, RAG, or agentic and tool-use workflows. You know how to make AI output reliable through validation, evaluation and fallbacks. Using AI coding assistants alone does not meet this requirement.

- You use AI tools in your daily development work and have solid habits for checking and reviewing what they produce.

- Strong TypeScript and JavaScript, and modern React, including hooks and state management.

- Strong backend experience with Node.js and Express or a comparable framework, REST APIs, and integrating external systems.

- Deep PostgreSQL and SQL skills, with solid data modelling and experience with an ORM or query builder such as Knex, Sequelize or Prisma.

- Comfortable working across both modern TypeScript applications and an established JavaScript codebase.

- Strong quality mindset: automated testing, code reviews, and taking responsibility for what you ship.

- High ownership and drive: you push your work through to done, raise problems early, and don't wait to be told what to do next.

- Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- Fluent English required; German is a plus.

- Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate.

Nice to Have

- Depth in LLM tooling: provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality.

- Vector search (pgvector or similar).

- Product or process awareness: experience understanding how a business works and turning messy processes into structured systems.

- Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data).

- Our wider stack: Bun, Vite, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS.

- Observability and product analytics tools (e.g. Sentry, Datadog, PostHog).

- Python for data tooling.

- Background in eCommerce, wholesale or B2B environments.

Why Us?

- An awesome team & great vibes: Work with motivated colleagues in an agile, ambitious, and friendly atmosphere where collaboration and fun go hand in hand with high speed.

- Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities: Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title.

- Modern workplace & cutting-edge equipment: State-of-the-art office setup including adjustable desks, mobile treadmills, air conditioning, and everything you need to excel in your role.

- Company pension program (bAV): Smart pension plan with a 30% Buying Labs grant on your contribution, investing in your financial future together.

- Corporate Benefits membership: Access exclusive discounts from a wide range of partner brands and retailers.

- Full "Deutschlandticket" coverage: We cover the complete cost (ca. €60/month) so you can travel sustainably and conveniently throughout Germany.

- Free bike options: Choose between a complimentary "Swapfiets" bike (original or deluxe 7) or opt for JobRad bike-leasing with an additional €26/month grant from Buying Labs.

- Complimentary food & beverages: Free Friday lunch in the office, plus organic fruit & vegetables, drinks, snacks, coffee/tea, healthy shots and seasonal treats (e.g. ice cream, soups) throughout the week.

- Personalized workspace setup: €100 welcome voucher to customize and optimize your workspace from day one.

- Refer-A-Friend (employee referral program): You love being part of Buying Labs? Fantastic! Then recommend people from your personal network and receive attractive rewards.

Sounds like a perfect fit? We can't wait to meet you. Apply now and be part of our journey!

title: Junior Marketing Manager
description:
Welcome to MVST 

We're a full product delivery studio based in Munich and Barcelona, on a mission to help companies build products and services that truly make a difference in the world.

At MVST, we take ideas from 0 to 1, whether it's through strategy, UX/UI design, product management, or software development. We empower and collaborate with businesses at every pivotal stage to craft tailor-made digital experiences that stand out.

What makes us unique? A few things: 

We're completely independent.

We're known for innovative design, progressive ways of working, and cutting-edge technology.

And most importantly… we don't take ourselves too seriously. We believe in enjoying the journey, celebrating wins (big or small), and creating things that matter.

Our services are: 

Full Product Delivery

Product Management & Strategy

UI/UX Design

Software Development

⚙ DevOps / MLOps / AI

Role Overview: 

Marketing & Content 

- Plan and run multi-channel campaigns across various channels (LinkedIn, newsletter, website, etc.) that grow MVST's brand, bring in qualified leads and acquire new customers, from the first brief to the final report.
- Turn our work into stories. Collaborate with our designers, developers and product managers to create project showcases, articles and short-form video that show what we build and how we build it.
- Own our social media presence, with a focus on LinkedIn, and keep our followers hooked, well-informed and craving more!
- Keep our brand visible wherever people search: classic SEO for our website, plus making sure we show up in AI-powered search and answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews.
- Get hands-on with performance marketing (Google Ads, Social Media Ads, etc.) to squeeze the most out of every campaign.
- Use AI tools smartly across your workflow, from research and first drafts to repurposing content and analysing results, while keeping our voice human and our quality high.
- Help us throw killer events that not only rock but also give our brand some serious street cred! 
- Ensure consistent messaging and branding across every channel and touchpoint.

Business Development & Growth 

- Conduct comprehensive market and competitor research to identify trends, opportunities, and threats.
- Use data-driven insights to inform decisions, optimize campaigns, and measure ROI, with simple dashboards to track what works.
- Identify and pursue new business opportunities and partnerships to boost revenue and market share.
- Set up and execute lead generation strategies (e.g. email marketing, marketing automation and CRM).
- Maintain customer relationships and help develop sustainable business development and sales strategies.

Ideal Qualifications:

At MVST, we know that our strength lies in our people, and in the diversity of perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds they bring. We're committed to building inclusive, supportive, and diverse teams that reflect the world we design for.

We warmly welcome applications from people of all cultures, identities, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, and age groups. Everyone deserves to feel valued and respected at work, and we work hard to foster an environment where that's the standard, free from discrimination, bias, or harassment.

If you are applying from outside the EU, please clearly state this in your application.

title: Webdesigner (w/m/d)
description:
Einleitung

Wir sind auf der Suche nach neuen Kollegen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Prozess der Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht, unserer juristischen Kompetenz und einem starken Team von zahlreichen Mitarbeitern begleiten wir tausende Mandanten erfolgreich auf dem Weg zur deutschen Staatsbürgerschaft. Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich einen Einblick unter migrando(.)de/karriere, unserer Karriere-Page. Denn wir können hier schreiben was wir wollen, im Endeffekt bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung. 

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang in der Praxis gearbeitet und Hands-on-Erfahrungen gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Wir bieten Dir

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Mix aus gestalterischer Freiheit und echtem Impact. Du arbeitest nicht an abstrakten Konzepten, die irgendwann vielleicht live gehen – sondern an Produkten, die täglich tausende Menschen sehen und nutzen. Dein Output ist sichtbar, messbar und macht einen Unterschied. 

- Abwechslungsreiche Kreativprojekte 
Bei uns gestaltest du echte Produkte: von Landingpages für Rechtsberatung über Infoportale bis zu interaktiven Online-Assistenten.

- Zugang zu Premium-Tools 
Du arbeitest mit modernen Plugins und Tools wie Figma, Lovable, Bricks und Hubspot.

- Firmen-Zugänge für Adobe und Co. 
Selbstverständlich erhältst du bei dieser Stelle Zugriff auf die Adobe Creative Cloud und alle anderen Tools, die du brauchst.

- KI-Design 
Du darfst direkt Hand anlegen, wenn es darum geht, neue KI-Tools für deine Designs auszuprobieren. Vielleicht ergibt sich ein neuer Workflow für dich? Wir ermutigen unsere Mitarbeiter in vielen Bereichen, KI zu nutzen, um die Arbeit schneller und leichter zu machen. Dazu stellen wir dir Claude, ChatGPT und Gemini in der jeweiligen Pro-Version zur Verfügung.

- Große Inspirations- und Asset-Bibliotheken 
Dir stehen zahlreiche Icons, Illustrationen und hochwertige Design-Assets zur Verfügung. Wir haben außerdem Pro-Zugänge für Tools wie Mobbin, damit du direkt von den großen Playern lernen kannst.

- High-End Hardware nach Wahl 
Egal ob MacBook Pro M3 oder Dell XPS mit Linux. Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, inkl. 4K-Monitoren.

- Große Reichweite 
Über die Jahre konnten wir mit unserer Plattform bereits viele Menschen erreichen. Diese große Menge an Traffic ermöglicht es uns, schnell Ergebnisse zu sehen und führt zu einem sinnesstiftenden Arbeitsgefühl.

- Echte Eigenverantwortung 
Du bist nicht Umsetzer fremder Ideen. Du bringst eigene Perspektiven ein, triffst gestalterische Entscheidungen und hast einen direkten Draht zu allen Teams und der Geschäftsführung – ohne lange Freigabe-Schleifen.

- Kleine Teams statt Großraumbüro 
Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt und schnell ins Gespräch kommt.

- Musik bei der Arbeit 
Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und keinen anderen stört), kannst du auch gerne Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.

- Modernes Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus 
Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen in den Räumen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch. Einen Einblick in unsere Räumlichkeiten kannst du dir auf unserer Website anschauen.

- Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit moderner Ausstattung 
Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, ein leistungsstarker Laptop und eine ruhige Umgebung.

- Homeoffice-Möglichkeit 
Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Gleichzeitig ist Home Office jederzeit möglich. Auch spontan und ohne lange Abstimmung.

- Vertrauensarbeitszeit ohne Kernzeiten 
Bei uns gibt es keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster, in denen du anwesend sein musst.

- Flexible Teilzeitmodelle 
Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell. Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.

- Spontan Urlaub nehmen 
Manchmal braucht man einfach eine Auszeit. Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen.

- Familienfreundliche Kultur 
Kranke Kinder, Elternabend oder kurzfristiger Arzttermin – wir wissen, dass solche Situationen zum Alltag gehören. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.

- Kurze Wege 
Bei uns musst du dich nicht durch die Hierarchien hangeln oder lange Mails schreiben, um gehört zu werden. Du kannst jederzeit direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung sprechen. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Austausch ist direkt und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.

- Mitgestalten statt nur abarbeiten 
Wir suchen Kolleg:innen, die mitdenken. Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie ein Prozess besser laufen kann, ein Tool sinnvoll wäre oder ein Workflow smarter funktionieren könnte, dann wirst du gehört.

- Sinnstiftende Arbeit 
Deine Tätigkeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit – es ist Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung und spürbarer Wirkung.

- Feel-Good-Angebote im Haus 
Unsere Feel-Good-Managerin sorgt regelmäßig für kleine Auszeiten – von Nacken- und Schultermassagen über kurze Entspannungs- und Beauty-Sessions bis hin zu Momenten zum Durchatmen.

- Regelmäßige Team-Events 
Wir feiern gern. Sommerfest am See, gemütliche Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner mit der Abteilung. Unsere Events sorgen dafür, dass wir als Team zusammenwachsen und den Arbeitsalltag auch mal beiseiteschieben können. Aber keine Sorge: Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht und eher Gehen auch kein Problem.

- Fitnessraum im Haus 
Unser eigener Fitnessraum steht dir direkt im Haus zur Verfügung – kostenlos, gut ausgestattet und jederzeit zugänglich.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Mix aus Design- und Implementationsarbeit. Je nach deinen Stärken und Interessen übernimmst du Aufgaben, die dich als festes Standbein des Design-Teams etablieren oder das Entwickler-Team frontend-seitig unterstützen. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. 

- Landingpages entwickeln 
Du baust klare und überzeugende Landingpages – etwa zu Einbürgerung, Aufenthaltstiteln oder neuen Tools – und schaffst Strukturen, die sowohl Nutzer abholen als auch gute Conversions bringen.

- Visuelle Konzepte entwickeln 
Du entwirfst moderne und gut strukturierte Layouts für Landingpages, Websites und interne Projekte und Tools. In Figma baust du komplette Design-Konzepte und setzt diese ggf. auch um.

- Infobeiträge entwickeln 
Du gestaltest Blog- und Newsbeiträge und hilfst dabei, Inhalte verständlich aufzubereiten, einzupflegen und live zu schalten.

- Mobile Optimierung 
Du passt Designs gezielt für mobile Geräte an und bist dir bewusst, dass unsere Website zum größten Teil auf dem Handy genutzt wird.

- Seiten mit WordPress + Elementor aufbauen 
Du setzt deine Figma-Designs in WordPress um – mit Elementor Pro, Custom HTML/SCSS und Liebe zum Detail. Hier und da wirst du auch mit anderen Tools in Kontakt kommen: Bricks, Hubspot oder bspw. E-Mail-Designer-Tools.

- Modulare Templates entwickeln 
Du erstellst wiederverwendbare Elementor-Templates, globale Styles und komponentenbasierte Layout-Bausteine, damit unsere Projekte nicht nur schön, sondern auch effizient und konsistent bleiben.

- Laufende Pflege 
Du machst HTML/CSS-Anpassungen, pflegst Menüs, Custom Post Types und globale Styles und kümmerst dich um Performance-Themen wie Bildoptimierung, Lazy Load oder Caching.

- Zusammenarbeit mit SEO, Content & Performance 
Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Teams zusammen, um Conversion zu verbessern und Elemente suchmaschinenfreundlich aufzubereiten.

- Bildbearbeitung & Auswahl 
Du wählst passende Bilder oder erstellt diese selbst. Denk an: Beitragsbilder für Blog- oder Newsbeiträge.

- A/B-Testing 
Du entwickelst Designvarianten für Tests und stimmst dich mit dem Team ab, um herauszufinden, was bei unseren Nutzer:innen wirklich funktioniert.

Dein Profil

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang Hands-on-Erfahrungen in der Praxis gesammelt, Seiten gebaut, Layouts optimiert und Designs für echte Nutzer:innen umgesetzt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. 

- WordPress & Elementor 
Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit WordPress und Elementor und kennst die typischen Stolpersteine aus eigener Arbeit.

- Grundlagen im Webdesign-Stack 
HTML5 und CSS3 beherrschst du gut, gern auch mit SASS/LESS.

- Gespür für Design 
Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie, Abstände und Struktur und gleichzeitig ein Verständnis dafür, wie Nutzer:innen online denken und navigieren.

- Sicher im Umgang mit Design-Tools 
Du nutzt Figma (oder vergleichbare Tools wie Sketch oder Adobe XD), um Wireframes, Prototypen und finalen UI-Designs umzusetzen. Du arbeitest visuell klar, strukturiert und gerne kollaborativ.

- Detailverliebt mit Blick fürs Ganze 
Du achtest auf jedes Pixel, auf Abstände und Micro-Details, behältst aber trotzdem die größere User Journey und das strategische Ziel der Seite im Blick.

- Routine im Responsive Design 
Desktop, Tablet, Mobile – für dich sind das keine Extras, sondern ein selbstverständlicher Teil jedes Projekts. Du kannst Layouts für verschiedene Breakpoints sauber aufeinander abstimmen.

- Erfahrung im Webdesign 
Du hast bereits mit WordPress, Elementor, Figma oder HTML/CSS gearbeitet und fühlst dich in dieser Welt wohl.

- Keine formellen Voraussetzungen 
Du musst kein Studium oder 30 Weiterbildungen haben. Wir wollen Talente und fähige neue Kollegen finden. Selbst wenn du nicht alle Punkte hier erfüllst - wir sind auf der Suche nach erfahrenen und verantwortungsbewussten Kollegen, idealerweise bist du schon viele Jahre in dem Bereich aktiv und konntest viele Learnings mitnehmen. Denn genau daran sind wir interessiert: saubere, langfristig robuste Problemlösungen. Und die hat man meist erst, nachdem man es einige Zeit auf die harte Tour lernen musste.

- Einfache Kommunikation 
Du bist kommunikativ und offen. Eigentlich wollen wir hier keine generischen Sachen schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist wichtig. Gute Zusammenarbeit schlägt oft reines Know-how. Ein Kollege, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos ist, kann im Alltag wertvoller sein als jemand mit mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber eher schleppend ist.

- Deutsch oder Englisch 
Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch oder am besten beides (ca. B2-Level). Keine Angst, wir wollen keinen Sprachnachweis sehen.

title: OT Network Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

ju:niz Energy entwickelt, baut und betreibt netzdienliche Batteriegroßspeicher in ganz Deutschland. Unsere Anlagen stabilisieren das Stromnetz, schaffen Flexibilität und ermöglichen den weiteren Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien. Wir investieren in unsere Batteriespeicherprojekte und behalten diese langfristig im eigenen Bestand.

Als OT Network Engineer sorgst du dafür, dass die Netzwerke und Infrastruktur unserer Batteriespeicheranlagen zuverlässig und sicher funktionieren. Gemeinsam mit unserem OT-Team betreibst du die technische Infrastruktur, sicherst die Kommunikation zwischen den Systemen und unterstützt die Anbindung neuer Anlagen. 

Deine Aufgaben

- Du betreibst und wartest unsere OT-nahen Infrastrukturkomponenten – von Netzwerken und Servern bis zu Endgeräten und Backup-Systemen.

- Beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer OT-Netzwerke gestaltest du die Architektur, setzt Netzwerksegmentierung und DMZ-Konzepte um und sorgst für sichere Schnittstellen zwischen IT und OT.

- Firewalls und Remote-Access-Lösungen administrierst du so, dass Fernzugriffe kontrolliert erfolgen und die Sicherheitsgrenzen unserer Systeme eingehalten werden.

- Die sichere Anbindung von Edge- und IoT-Komponenten sowie das Endpoint Management im OT-Umfeld liegen ebenfalls in deinem Aufgabenbereich.

- Gemeinsam mit unserem Cyber-Security-Team setzt du technische Standards, Systemhärtungen und ein abgestimmtes Patch-Management um.

- Bei Störungen in Netzwerk, SCADA oder Energiemanagementsystemen analysierst du die Ursachen und koordinierst die Behebung in enger Abstimmung mit dem Digital OT Lead und dem OT-Team.

- Neue Standorte und Anlagen begleitest du beim Infrastruktur-Rollout und unterstützt ihre Einbindung in unsere bestehende OT-Landschaft.

- Durch eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation und einheitliche Konfigurationen schaffst du die Grundlage für einen verlässlichen Betrieb und die weitere Standardisierung unserer Infrastruktur.

- Mit unseren Managed-Services-Partnern und dem Cyber-Security-Team arbeitest du bei Monitoring und Incident Response eng zusammen.

Dein Profil

- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im IT-/OT-Umfeld bildet die Grundlage deiner Qualifikation.

- Im Betrieb von Netzwerk-, Server- und OT-Infrastruktur hast du bereits mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung gesammelt.

- OT-Netzwerke, Netzwerksegmentierung und die sichere Integration von IT und OT gehören zu deinen fachlichen Stärken.

- Mit der Administration von Firewalls und Remote-Access-Lösungen bist du vertraut.

- Kenntnisse im Endpoint Management mit Microsoft Intune sowie im Microsoft-365-Umfeld sind von Vorteil.

- Technische Probleme gehst du strukturiert und lösungsorientiert an; dabei behältst du die Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit der Systeme im Blick.

- Für Rollouts und technische Einsätze bringst du die Bereitschaft mit, zu unseren Anlagenstandorten zu reisen.

- Für die enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team bist du regelmäßig für zwei bis drei Tage vor Ort in unserem Büro in Aschheim bei München.

- Auf Deutsch(mindestens C2) und Englisch kannst du dich im Arbeitsalltag und zu technischen Themen gut verständigen.

Warum wir?

- Verantwortung im Anlagenbetrieb: Deine Arbeit trägt unmittelbar zur sicheren Kommunikation und zuverlässigen Verfügbarkeit unserer Batteriespeicher bei.

- Technischer Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entwickelst unsere OT-Infrastruktur weiter und bringst eigene Lösungen für Standards, Sicherheit und Betrieb ein.

- Enge Zusammenarbeit: Im Austausch mit dem OT-Team, Cyber Security und externen Servicepartnern bearbeitest du technische Herausforderungen gemeinsam.

- Beitrag zur Energiewende: Du arbeitest an der Infrastruktur von Anlagen, die das Stromnetz stabilisieren und erneuerbare Energien besser nutzbar machen.

Kontakt

Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten.

Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann.
