title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

What You'll Do

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

- Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production
- Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.
- Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.
- Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.
- Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.
What You Bring

- Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.
- Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.
- Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.
- Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.
- Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.
Why Limatica

- Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.
- Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.
- Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.
- Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning
- Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages
What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.

Ready to find the signal in the noise? Let's build the future of battery diagnostics together. ⚡

title: Regional Sales Director
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role

As the Regional Director, Sales for Germany, you’ll lead a high-performing team of Strategic & Major Account Executive professionals to grow adoption of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll be responsible for managing software sales, bookings, and revenue, while building strong relationships with new and existing customers who rely on GitLab to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk. Reporting to the VP, Central EMEA, you’ll hire and develop top talent, set clear territory and industry strategies, and ensure your team’s sales plans align with GitLab’s overall growth goals in this market. In your first year, you’ll focus on building a strong team culture, deepening our presence with German clients, and consistently meeting or exceeding performance objectives in a fast-paced, open source software and SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and motivate a team of Strategic & Major Account Executives focused on the German market to deliver software sales, bookings, and revenue results

- Drive territory and industry planning by analyzing market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive trends to identify and execute on growth opportunities

- Develop and own accurate sales forecasts, territory management plans, and growth strategies that align to GitLab’s overall revenue goals

- Establish, track, and report on key performance metrics for the team, and take action to address gaps and improve outcomes

- Collaborate closely with Renewals, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to manage pipeline health, renewal performance, and deal execution

- Recruit, hire, and onboard top sales talent while building and maintaining a strong pipeline of potential future hires in the region

- Create a high-performing, inclusive, and positive team culture through regular coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing development

- Educate and enable your team on GitLab’s product, pricing, AI-powered DevSecOps positioning, and key industry and regulatory factors relevant to the German market, such as data privacy, data sovereignty, and sector-specific compliance requirements

Requirements

- Progressive experience in field sales and sales operations in an open source software, DevOps, or similar software-as-a-service environment

- Demonstrated success leading and developing account-focused sales teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management

- Proven track record of meeting or exceeding performance objectives (revenue targets, pipeline targets, etc.)

- Experience building and executing go-to-market strategies for the German market, with a willingness to both lead and participate directly in selling activities

- Commercial and analytical skills to interpret sales performance data and adjust regional plans in ways that drive sustainable, long-term growth

- Practical experience working with CRM and sales/marketing tools (for example Salesforce, Clari, Marketo) to manage forecasts, territories, and pipeline

- Ability to analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics to inform territory planning and team enablement

- Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills, including executive-level written and verbal communication and the ability to mentor others

- Alignment with GitLab’s values and interest in open source, with openness to candidates who bring transferable leadership and regional sales experience from adjacent software markets

Remote-Global 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees 

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being 

- Flexible Paid Time Off 

- Team Member Resource Groups 

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan 

- Growth and Development Fund 

- Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. title: Enterprise Account Executive (Germany South)
description:
Recruitment Fraud Alert 

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number. 

What to know: 

- Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.

- We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.

- Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at 

About Commvault 

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. 

At Commvault, we help some of the world’s most complex organisations strengthen their cyber resilience and protect what matters most: their data, operations and ability to recover.

We are expanding our Enterprise Sales team in Germany and are looking an Enterprise Account Executive to cover Germany South 

This is not an account-maintenance role. We are looking for proven enterprise sellers who know their market, have built trusted relationships with senior customers and partners, and consistently turn market access into qualified pipeline, strategic opportunities and profitable growth.

What You Will Own 

- Deliver quarterly and annual revenue targets across a defined portfolio of large enterprise customers and high-value prospects.

- Build and execute strategic territory and account plans focused on net-new logo acquisition, competitive displacement and sustainable account expansion.

- Personally create and progress qualified pipeline through executive engagement, targeted prospecting, customer referrals, partners and technology alliances.

- Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving CIOs, CISOs, infrastructure leaders, procurement, partners and executive sponsors.

- Develop compelling business cases that connect cyber resilience and data protection outcomes with financial value, risk reduction and operational priorities.

- Orchestrate an integrated account team across Sales Engineering, Channel, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services and executive leadership.

- Maintain accurate opportunity management, qualification and forecasting throughout the sales cycle.

- Build long-term customer relationships based on credibility, business value and consistent delivery.

What Successful Candidates Will Bring 

- A demonstrable track record of achieving or exceeding quota in enterprise software, SaaS, cybersecurity, data management, cloud infrastructure or a closely related market.

- Proven experience closing complex six- and seven-figure enterprise transactions with long sales cycles and multiple decision-makers.

- Evidence of winning net-new enterprise customers , not only expanding inherited accounts.

- An established and active network across enterprise customers, C-level decision-makers, channel partners and technology alliances within the relevant German territory.

- Strong knowledge of the German enterprise technology market, including customer priorities, competitive dynamics, procurement structures and partner ecosystems.

- The ability to independently create access, shape opportunities and maintain momentum without relying on continuous management intervention.

- Strong business-value selling, negotiation and executive communication skills.

- Disciplined use of CRM, qualification methodology, account planning and forecasting processes.

- A collaborative leadership style combined with personal accountability, resilience and a strong desire to win.

- Business-fluent German and English.

Territory and Travel 

- The role is field-based and should ideally be located within Germany South with convenient access to major rail, road and air connections.

- Regular customer and partner engagement across the assigned territory is an essential part of the role. Candidates should therefore be comfortable travelling based on customer and business requirements.

How We Define a Winning Mindset 

For us, a winning mindset is about:

- Creating opportunities rather than waiting for them.

- Taking ownership from initial access through successful close.

- Combining ambition with disciplined execution.

- Being transparent about risks, pipeline quality and forecast confidence.

- Mobilising the wider team while remaining personally accountable for the outcome.

- Learning quickly, responding constructively to setbacks and maintaining momentum.

- Winning in a way that strengthens customer trust, partner relationships and the team.

If you have consistently built enterprise pipeline, developed trusted executive relationships and converted complex customer challenges into significant business outcomes, we would like to hear from you.

We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.

Join us as a working student and help build an internal data platform for analyzing scientific publications in robotics and AI research. The platform brings together openly available information about publications and turns it into a clear, reliable picture of how the research field is developing.

Your work will give our team a solid data foundation for understanding research trends, emerging topics, and where new momentum is building. Build and maintain an internal research data platform

- Develop components for automated data acquisition from open sources such as scholarly APIs, repositories and websites

- Implement backend services and data pipelines for reliable processing and integration

- Contribute to frontend components for accessing, managing and exploring the data

Ensure data quality and automation

- Keep the data consistent, traceable and usable across the whole system

Visualize and report

- Improve usability and functionality of the application together with its users

- Help to continuously enhance the platform

What You Bring 

- Currently enrolled in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Statistics, Robotics or a related field

- Good knowledge of Python and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

- Knowledge of SQL and databases

- Experience with APIs, web scraping and workflow automation

- Experience with AI-based software development, such as working with AI coding assistants and integrating AI models into applications

- Experience with Git and Docker

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail and data quality

- Structured, independent working style and good communication skills

- Interest in robotics and AI as a research field, and the ability to read and understand scientific publications

- Full professional proficiency in English

title: Sales Development Representative (New Graduates)
description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) 

➡️ Ready to kick-start your career in sales, selling a best-in-class AI product you can genuinely be proud of? 

➡️ Want to learn how to open doors, engage senior decision-makers and create opportunities with some of the world’s most innovative organisations? 

➡️ Looking for a culture that rewards ambition, invests in your growth and offers exceptional training, uncapped commission and a clear path to becoming an Account Executive? 

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. 

Role Summary: 

AI is changing how organisations research new technologies, evaluate ideas, understand competitors and decide where to invest. At Patsnap, we’re helping to lead that change.

We’re looking for an ambitious Sales Development Representative to join our High Tech division and help drive the next stage of our growth.

As an SDR, you’ll be the first point of contact for prospective customers across a diverse range of industries. You’ll introduce senior R&D, Innovation, Engineering and Intellectual Property professionals to Patsnap’s AI-powered platform, start meaningful commercial conversations and create qualified opportunities for our Account Executives.

This is a proactive, high-activity outbound sales role. You’ll research potential customers, make cold calls, deliver personalised outreach and learn how to capture the attention of busy senior decision-makers. It takes confidence, resilience and consistency, but it also gives you the opportunity to develop valuable commercial skills quickly and see the direct impact of your work.

You don’t need previous sales experience to succeed here. We’re looking for curious, ambitious people who are eager to learn and prepared to put in the work. Through structured onboarding, regular coaching and close partnership with experienced Account Executives, you’ll build the skills and confidence needed to become a successful SaaS sales professional.

For someone who is competitive, motivated by personal growth and achievement who wants to build a career with that offers uncapped earning potential and a clear development path towards becoming an Account Executive and beyond, this could be the perfect opportunity.

With significant investment in AI, ambitious growth plans and a clear progression path, there's never been a better time to join Patsnap.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing? 
Check out this short overview:

This is a hybrid role based in our London office, with the flexibility to work either hybrid (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday in the office) or fully office-based if you prefer. 

Why This Opportunity?

Starting your sales career is about more than getting your first title. It is about finding the right environment to learn, build confidence and prove what you can achieve. At Patsnap, you’ll sell a sophisticated AI platform with a clear purpose and strong credibility in the market. You’ll receive structured training, practical coaching and daily exposure to experienced sales professionals who want to help you improve.

You’ll learn how to research accounts, communicate with senior stakeholders, handle rejection, uncover business challenges and create genuine commercial opportunities. As your capability grows, so will your responsibility, earning potential and opportunity to progress. You’ll also join a high-performing but low-ego team that shares ideas, supports one another and celebrates success properly.

Who are we? 

Patsnap is a global, Series E, unicorn SaaS platform that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our user-friendly platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle — using industry-leading, domain-specific AI to generate and validate ideas and bring innovative products to market faster, better, and cheaper. More than 12,000 R&D and IP teams worldwide use and trust PatSnap to innovate and commercialize new products.

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Shanghai, and Singapore. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

What You'll Be Doing:

As an SDR, you'll be on the front line of Patsnap's growth, helping us connect with leading innovative organisations. This is a true business development role where you'll learn how to identify opportunities, build relationships and create commercial value. Sales isn't about having all the answers, it's about asking great questions. Your curiosity will help you understand customer challenges, while we'll teach you the commercial skills to build a successful career in SaaS sales.

You will:

- Develop a hunter mindset, proactively identifying and engaging new prospects through phone, email and LinkedIn.

- Use your scientific background to build credibility with senior R&D, innovation and scientific leaders.

- Create and qualify new sales opportunities, turning cold prospects into valuable commercial conversations.

- Build resilience by handling rejection positively and consistently achieving ambitious activity and pipeline targets.

- Work closely with experienced Account Executives, helping convert qualified opportunities into revenue while learning every stage of the sales process.

- Develop the commercial skills needed to progress into a closing role, including influencing, negotiation and relationship building.

- Using your incredible communication skills to build brand new relationships between Patsnap and potential clients 

- Working closely with an Account Executive, who will mentor and help to develop your sales skills, while you support their activity by creating sales leads and booking their product demonstrations 

- Owning your territory and choosing which companies to call and will have the autonomy to be creative with how you introduce Patsnap to prospects 

- Learning the necessary tools to be able to succeed in the role; what we ask of you is a can-do attitude and an open mind to learning 

- Researching using varied and creative techniques to identify business opportunities (sales leads)

What We'd Love From You

You don't need previous sales experience – we're looking for people with the attitude, curiosity and ambition to build a successful career in tech sales. You could be starting your professional career, moving into sales from another sector or bringing some initial B2B sales or lead-generation experience.

We're looking for someone who is:

- A recent graduate (or early career professional) or has B2B sales or lead generation experience, ideally within the software industry (desirable) 

- Ambitious and motivated by success, with the drive to excel in an uncapped commission environment.

- Confident and proactive, comfortable starting conversations and building relationships with new people.

- Resilient and determined, with the mindset to overcome challenges and thrive in a target-driven environment.

- Naturally competitive, with a strong desire to achieve goals and progress quickly in your career.

- An excellent communicator, able to explain complex scientific concepts in a simple, engaging way.

- Curious, coachable and eager to learn, always looking for ways to improve.

- Organised and self-motivated, with the ability to manage your time and priorities effectively.

- Passionate about technology, AI and innovation, and excited by the impact they have on R&D and scientific discovery.

- A natural problem solver who enjoys understanding customers' challenges and helping them find solutions.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two days are the same.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong sales culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits 

- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

- Two paid volunteering days

- Private healthcare with AXA

- Pension with Scottish Widows

- Enhanced parental leave policies

- Work from home stipend

- Cycle to Work scheme

- Life assurance

- Payroll giving options

- Eyecare vouchers

Compensation: 

- Base Salary: £28,330 + uncapped commission

- On-Target Earnings Total (OTE): £47,217 (60/40 split)

- High achievers regularly exceed target, with earnings of £60k+

title: Graduate Software Developer
description:
Salary: £30,000 - £40,000 depending on experience and qualifications

Location: Remote (all UK locations considered) with flexible working arrangements. Our flexible office collaboration spaces, for those wishing to use them, are in London, Bristol and Exeter.

Term/Hours: Permanent (6-month probation). Full-time (40 hours per week)

Right to Work: Must have own right to work in the UK for more than 2 years

Closing date: Monday 9th November 2026

CVs FROM RECRUITERS (INCLUDING THOSE ON OUR PSL) WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. DIRECT APPLICATIONS ONLY. 

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of sex, gender identity, age, disability, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. 

We are only accepting direct applications (no recruiters please). 

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications requiring visa sponsorship now, or in the future. 

ABOUT US 

City Science is an SME founded in 2015 with a core mission of delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations who are committed to decarbonisation achieve meaningful and quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently.

Our software and product development team produce innovative and uniquely insightful digital tools, like Cadence and our decarbonisation tool, to successfully deliver our projects.

We work collaboratively across our consultancy team made up of transport, energy, sustainability, carbon accounting and applied data science specialists to provide integrated solutions to our clients. Our range of clients is extensive and includes forward-thinking local authorities like Oxfordshire County Council, sub-national transport bodies like England’s Economic Heartland and national organisations like Department of Energy Security & Net Zero (see our full list of projects here ).

We have a series of emerging services lines (which are all underpinned by market areas), including the following focused within:

· Net Zero Strategies & Roadmaps (e.g. Area-based future decarbonisation pathways, green growth strategies)

· Net Zero Development (e.g. Transport evidence bases for Local Plans and infrastructure strategies)

· Sustainable Transport (e.g. Local cycle & walking infrastructure plans (LCWIPs), bus service planning and movement strategies)

· Net Zero Transport (e.g. Electric Vehicle charging strategies and net zero transport pathways)

· Transport Modelling (e.g. Strategic, freight, micro-simulation and active travel modelling)

· Heat & Retrofit (e.g. Heat pumps sizing, internet of things)

· Energy Planning (e.g. Local Areas Energy Plans)

· Energy Modelling (e.g. DNO capacity, building monitoring/benchmarking) 

· Data Engineering (e.g. Future technology roadmaps)

· Carbon Accounting (e.g. Business decarbonisation, circular economy)

About the Role 

We are looking to grow our team of developers working across the full stack to deliver cutting edge applications and tools to support our decarbonisation mission. This role requires highly talented individuals who can take a proactive role in problem solving. Successful candidates must be able to show extremely high aptitude in mathematics and analytical problem solving.

Existing coding skills are not required but are desirable and driven candidates with self-taught skills are particularly encouraged to apply. City Science predominantly uses JavaScript and Python, but other languages are also used, and all experience is considered. Experience working with cloud-based services is also desirable. Experience using AI to support software development is welcome but we expect candidates to demonstrate and develop independent skills, motivation and communication throughout the application process.

Key Responsibilities: 

· Develop and maintain a range of applications and tools that support clients to plan, monitor, evidence and visualise their decarbonisation pathway

· Energy Modelling (e.g. Home Energy Model, building physics/benchmarking) 

· Support staff internally to provide insights with a high level of automation/digitisation, meeting or exceeding industry standard practices

· Manage the full development stack and work flexibly to meet emerging need

· Collaborate across teams and grow relationships between consultancy professionals and software developers

· Drive new technologies and integrated ways of working

· Communicate the case for decarbonisation through cutting edge software tools

· BSc 2:1 or better in a STEM subject (1st class degree, PhD or higher-level qualification desirable)

· Able to demonstrate very strong mathematical and numerical skills

· Drive to learn and develop coding and technology skills across the full stack (experience and/or self-taught skills desirable)

· Excellent problem solver

· Can demonstrate ability to work as part of a team, collaborating effectively with both internal and external stakeholders

· Proven science communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences

· Passion to make the case for, and execute, decarbonisation

Rewards & Benefits 

· Opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects across the consultancy business

· Opportunity for career progression

· 25 days annual leave entitlement

· Competitive salary (based on skills and experience)

· Ongoing mentoring, training and support from senior professionals within the business (including towards professional chartership)

· Paid membership of a maximum of two institutions

· Flexible working arrangements

· Membership of our group pension scheme

FURTHER INFORMATION 

We are building a team who are motivated by collaboration with the desire to solve problems for our customers. We want people to own their field of responsibility, take decisions, be pro-active and have pride in everything they do. Our team of experts includes prize-winning consultants, experienced technologists and distinguished academics.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we passionately believe in supporting each person reach their full potential.

title: CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager
description:
Better Collective is looking for an experienced CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager to establish and lead a group-wide approach to customer relationship management across our portfolio of global sports media brands.

This is a senior role combining CRM strategy, customer lifecycle management, technology, data, commercial thinking and operational leadership .

The successful candidate will move CRM beyond campaign execution and develop it as a strategic capability that helps Better Collective build deeper, more valuable relationships with its audiences.

Working across Product, Audience, Data, Commercial, Editorial, Technology and local brand teams, the CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will create the frameworks, programmes and operating model required to turn first- and zero-party audience data into personalised customer experiences and measurable business value.

The Opportunity 

Better Collective reaches millions of sports fans across a diverse portfolio of digital brands.

The next stage of our audience strategy is to develop stronger direct relationships with those users — moving from anonymous audiences → known users → understood customers → engaged and valuable relationships .

CRM will be central to that transformation.

The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will establish the strategy, capabilities and standards that allow Better Collective brands to acquire, activate, engage, retain and monetise audiences across the customer lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities 

CRM Strategy & Leadership 

- Develop Better Collective's group-wide CRM and lifecycle strategy.

- Establish CRM principles, standards and best practices across brands.

- Create a scalable operating model balancing central CRM expertise with local brand execution.

- Identify where CRM can deliver the greatest audience and commercial impact.

- Build CRM roadmaps for priority Better Collective brands.

- Act as the senior CRM subject-matter expert across the organisation.

Customer Lifecycle Management 

Design lifecycle strategies covering:

Acquisition → Registration → Onboarding → Engagement → Conversion → Retention → Reactivation 

Develop automated programmes including:

- Welcome and onboarding journeys

- Profile completion

- Content discovery

- Personalised sports and player updates

- Newsletter engagement

- Subscription conversion

- Premium product promotion

- Renewal

- Retention

- Churn prevention

- Lapsed-user reactivation

- Win-back programmes

The objective is to create relevant, personalised experiences rather than simply increase communication volume.

First & Zero-Party Data Activation 

Work closely with Audience, Product and Data teams to translate Better Collective's growing first- and zero-party data capabilities into meaningful customer experiences.

Use behavioural, declared and transactional data to improve:

- Audience segmentation

- Personalisation

- Content recommendations

- Lifecycle triggers

- Subscription propensity

- Retention

- Cross-sell opportunities

- Audience insight

Help establish the connection between data capture, customer understanding and CRM activation .

Multi-Channel CRM 

Develop a coordinated CRM approach across:

- Email

- App push

- Web push

- In-app messaging

- On-site messaging

- Emerging direct audience channels

Establish channel roles, contact strategies, frequency management and customer communication principles.

Ensure customers receive coordinated experiences rather than disconnected messages from individual channels.

CRM Technology & Automation

Responsibilities include:

- Marketing automation

- Journey orchestration

- Audience segmentation

- Triggered communications

- Dynamic content

- Personalisation

- CRM/CDP integration

- Data flows

- Preference management

Balance liquidity needs against permissible investment options under CASS15

Own the KPIs for UK Treasury operations, ensuring all targets are tracked, reported, and achieved

Requirements 

Experience

Solid treasury understanding, with a track record of taking ownership of cash management decisions

title: Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Industries
description:
About Anthropic 

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

À propos du poste 

En tant que leader de deuxième niveau pour l’équipe Applied AI Industries en Europe du Sud et au Moyen-Orient chez Anthropic, vous piloterez l’adoption d’une IA de frontier en partenariat avec le reste de l’organisation de mise sur le marché. Nos clients Industries en France, Ibérie et Italie incluent de nombreuses plus grandes entreprises de la région dans les services financiers, santé et sciences de la vie, fabrication, télécommunications, commerce de détail, énergie et autres secteurs. Vous mettrez à profit votre expérience de construction et de direction d’équipes de vente technique pour piloter une transformation IA positive qui répond aux besoins métier de nos clients, satisfait à leurs exigences techniques et réglementaires, et offre un haut degré de fiabilité et de sécurité.

Vous serez responsable de la direction et de la croissance de l’équipe d’architectes de solutions qui partenaire avec les directrices et directeurs de compte pour aider les entreprises à adopter et déployer les produits d’Anthropic, notamment Claude Cowork, Claude Code et la Plateforme de Développement Claude (notre API). Cela inclura l’utilisation de vos compétences techniques et votre expérience de vente consultative pour recruter d’excellentes personnes en première ligne de management et contributeurs individuels, établir des processus pour évoluer votre équipe, et représenter Anthropic directement dans les engagements clients stratégiques. Votre équipe couvre plusieurs pays et secteurs à la fois, vous serez donc responsable de la réflexion stratégique sur les comptes d’industrie complexes et de l’identification et du déploiement de solutions qui résonnent dans chaque marché, avec sa propre langue, sa culture métier et son contexte réglementaire.

Responsabilités 

- Recruter, manager et guider une équipe de managers de première ligne qui construiront à leur tour des équipes d’Applied AI Architects (H/F) de pré-vente en France, Ibérie et Italie

- Définir les objectifs de votre équipe en collaboration avec le leadership commercial et établir les attentes de performance de base sur votre équipe

- Agir en tant que sponsor technique et exécutif pour les clients stratégiques de haute valeur dans la région et les conseiller sur leurs stratégies globales d’adoption de l’IA ou la délimitation des cas d’usage et l’exécution de pilotes

- Collaborer étroitement avec le leadership commercial d’Europe du Sud (couvrant également le Moyen-Orient et l’Afrique) pour construire des stratégies pour les comptes d’industrie complexes et identifier de nouvelles façons de piloter l’adoption des produits Anthropic dans des secteurs verticaux spécifiques ou des cas d’usage horizontaux

- Aider les clients à naviguer dans les exigences réglementaires locales et européennes (par exemple, la Loi sur l’IA de l’UE, le RGPD, DORA et les attentes de résidence des données) et adapter la façon dont votre équipe s’engage à la culture métier de chaque marché

- Travailler avec des équipes interfonctionnelles comme le produit et l’ingénierie pour assurer qu’Anthropic priorise les commentaires des clients ou résout les obstacles à l’adoption dans la région

- Voyager régulièrement en Europe du Sud pour les clients ou conférences pour des sessions de haut niveau, des ateliers techniques et la construction de relations

- Établir une vision commune pour créer des solutions qui permettent une IA bénéfique et sûre dans les produits technologiques

- Contribuer à la pensée stratégique par des présentations en conférences, des webinaires et la création de contenu technique

- Rester au courant des tendances émergentes en IA et du paysage concurrentiel

Ce profil est un bon ajustement si vous : 

- Avez 7+ ans d’expérience en gestion de pré-vente technique, incluant un leadership de deuxième niveau ou supérieur (direction de managers)

- Avez vendu des produits techniques complexes aux grandes entreprises en France, Ibérie, Italie, Moyen-Orient et Afrique

- Avez travaillé dans plusieurs secteurs, tels que services financiers, santé et sciences de la vie, fabrication, télécommunications, commerce de détail et énergie

- Comprenez les différences culturelles entre les marchés d’Europe du Sud et le contexte réglementaire dans lequel opèrent vos clients, et adaptez votre approche à chacun

- Pensez de façon hautement stratégique aux comptes d’industrie complexes et transformez cette réflexion en plans que votre équipe et vos homologues commerciaux peuvent exécuter

- Avez une profonde maîtrise technique des cas d’usage IA en entreprise, des intégrations d’API et des déploiements LLM

- Prospérez dans la construction et l’évolution rapide d’équipes et de processus dans des environnements ambigus et mouvants

- Ayez d’excellentes compétences en communication, collaboration et coaching

- Ayez une présence exécutive forte et la capacité à cultiver des relations profondes avec les leaders métier et technique des plus grandes entreprises de la région

- Ayez au moins une familiarité de haut niveau avec l’architecture et le fonctionnement des LLM

- Ayez une passion pour rendre les technologies puissantes sûres et bénéfiques pour la société

- Restiez à jour et informée en vous intéressant activement à la recherche émergente et aux tendances du secteur en IA

Les candidates et candidats solides pourraient avoir : 

- Leadership de pré-vente d’entreprise à grande échelle : 5+ ans de direction d’équipes d’architectes de solutions à travers une hypercroissance (idéalement des dizaines de personnes dans plusieurs pays), avec expérience directe de direction de managers et développement de talents dans des environnements de vente de logiciels d’entreprise complexes

- Gamme multilingue et multiculturelle : En plus de l’anglais, maîtrise d’une ou plusieurs langues parmi le français, l’italien, l’espagnol ou le portugais, et expérience de direction d’équipes distribuées dans plusieurs pays

- Expérience avec les modèles commerciaux basés sur la consommation : Les candidats idéaux ont construit des cadres GTM ancrés sur la consommation, pas seulement sur les licences basées sur SaaS

- Profondeur technique en IA + Engagement exécutif : Expérience pratique avec les plateformes d’IA et les modèles d’intégration d’entreprise, combinée à un historique avéré d’engagement des parties prenantes au niveau C dans des évaluations techniques de 10 M€+ et des cycles de vente d’entreprise

- Expérience GTM multi-secteurs dans les secteurs réglementés : Succès démontré dans l’adaptation des approches techniques à différents secteurs verticaux, en particulier les secteurs réglementés tels que la banque, les assurances et la santé, y compris le travail avec les parties prenantes en matière de risque, de conformité et de comité d’entreprise

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services . We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. 

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner , with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents.

- Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables. 

- Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy. 

- Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients. 

🤝 The team 

You will join our Enterprise Customer Success team for the EMEA, APAC, and NA regions, a group of Customer Success Managers, each responsible for a focused portfolio of our largest and most strategic accounts. 

You will join a team of 6, including 5 CSMs and Majhon , Head of Customer Success Enterprise, who will support you in achieving your goals. You will also be part of a global Customer Success community across our five offices. 

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide: 

- Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts 

- Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment 

- Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth 

- Support Engineers : Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience 

🖋️ Your responsibilities 

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own the end-to-end relationship with a portfolio of our largest, most strategic accounts . You will build deep, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders, lead high-impact business reviews, and act as a trusted advisor, proactively protecting and growing revenue across your book through both retention and expansion. 

This is a role for someone who thrives on depth: fewer accounts, higher stakes, and the ability to build genuine, senior-level relationships that compound into long-term growth, while knowing how to sync with regional counterparts on accounts that span multiple geographies, keeping a global view of the relationship without owning every part of it directly. 

Account Ownership & Revenue Growth (50%) 

Own the business performance, strategy, and health of your portfolio of strategic accounts: 

- Take full ownership of your portfolio (ARR, NRR, renewal, risk level) 

- Build and execute structured, tailored account plans for 100% of your accounts, with clear growth and retention objectives 

- Proactively identify both expansion opportunities and churn risk through data analysis and direct relationship insight, and own them through to resolution or close 

- Monitor account health through usage data, adoption metrics, contact network and mapping, and stakeholder engagement 

- Maintain accurate forecasting (renewals, churn, upsell potential) and rigorous CRM discipline (Salesforce accuracy and completeness) 

Customer Value & Expertise (40%) 

Drive measurable value and position UpSlide as a strategic partner: 

- Lead high-impact Business Reviews focused on ROI and value realization 

- Lead complex or sensitive conversations (renegotiation, escalations, dissatisfaction) with confidence and clarity 

- Secure executive sponsors and build multi-threaded relationships within each account 

- Develop and maintain strong product expertise and a deep understanding of client industries and use cases 

- Craft value-driven narratives tailored to each stakeholder's priorities 

Cross-functional Collaboration (10%) 

Align with internal teams to maximize customer outcomes and business impact: 

- Partner with Sales on the account expansion strategy and account mapping 

- Collaborate with Professional Services when deeper deployment or training support is needed 

- Work closely with Product and Support to relay structured feedback and improve the customer experience 

- Coordinate with CSMs in other regions on shared or global accounts 

- Contribute to Customer Success best practices and performance improvement initiatives 

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Microsoft Office, UpSlide, Salesforce, Gong, PowerBI, and Notion (or local equivalents). 

⚡Your goals 

You will be assessed on: 

- Net Revenue Retention (NRR) 

- Churn 

- Expansion / upsell contribution 

- Depth and health of executive relationships across your portfolio 

- Ability to maintain full ownership and visibility on shared accounts 

You are a great fit if you have: 

- 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing/revenue role, including managing enterprise or large, multi-entity accounts in a B2B environment 

- Proven experience managing renewals and churn on strategic / enterprise accounts, with meaningful revenue responsibility 

- A proven track record of generating expansion (upsell/cross-sell) within an enterprise account base 

- Experience in autonomously managing a portfolio of large or multi-entity accounts with significant revenue responsibility 

- Confidence leading executive-level conversations, including complex or difficult ones (renegotiation, dissatisfaction, escalations) 

- Advanced negotiation skills 

- A structured, strategic approach to account planning (objectives, stakeholders, action plans) 

- A value- and ROI-oriented mindset, able to build and defend a business case with senior stakeholders 

- Operational rigor: accurate CRM data, reliable follow-up, dependable forecasting 

- Excellent written and verbal communication in English and French 

- Comfortable working in an international environment, engaging with senior and executive stakeholders 

We’d love it if you have: 

- Experience with a CRM / Customer Success platform (Salesforce, Planhat, or equivalent) and analytics / BI tools (PowerBI or equivalent) 

- Knowledge of the financial services/consulting sector 

- Experience managing group or multi-entity account structures 

- Familiarity with SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, forecasting) and reporting to leadership 

- Fluency in another language (e.g. German) 

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why. 

Recruitment process 

- Screening call with Talent Acquisition : A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role. 

- Interview with your future manager and a team-meet : A deeper dive into your Customer Success experience and approach to account management. This also includes a live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team. 

- Final conversation with leadership : A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps. 

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer 

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries 

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH , which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management 

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year) 

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc. 

💻 Hybrid work: A policy adapted to each team’s rhythm 

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget 

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities 

👶 Family support: 

- Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents 

- 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement 

- Flexible return to work options 

- An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent 

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day) 

✅ General: 

- Meal vouchers (Tickets resto) : €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year) 

- Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle) : Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children 

- Commute (Transports) : Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

€115.000 — €150.000 EUR

title: Senior Growth Manager - 60 à 75K package + BSPCE
description:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect 

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us ! 

- Discover our company culture and values 

- Here is a product teaser 

- Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle 

- Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest 

- Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog )

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents for medical practices: they answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, and free up time for care teams. 250 healthcare organizations use Vocca today, and we are a team of 50+ across Paris and New York.

In France we sell to imaging centers, to networks and health centers, and to independent practices. We have tested many acquisition channels without measuring them properly, so we can't say which one works best or for which type of practice. Our website is made to be read: a visitor can't try the product, estimate a return on investment or compare us with the alternatives. In the US, paid acquisition starts from zero.

The target is set: 100 MQLs in Q4 2026, then +30% every quarter. We are hiring the person who will own that number. You report to Pierre, Head of Marketing.

Your mission

Build Vocca's inbound lead engine. You own paid acquisition and website conversion, in France first and then in the US, and you are accountable for the quarterly MQL target: 100 in Q4 2026 and about 285 per quarter by the end of 2027.

Expected outcomes

After 1 months: 

- Tracking and attribution work: every lead has a source and a cost, and can be followed in the CRM up to the signed deal

- Google Ads and Meta accounts audited and rebuilt, with campaigns live for each segment

- A first ranking of channels by cost per MQL, and budget moved accordingly

- The first conversion pages live on the website

After 3 months: 

- The quarterly MQL target is met and on the +30% trajectory

- Cost per MQL and MQL-to-opportunity rate known for each channel and segment

- ROI calculator, comparison pages and a way to try the product live on the website

- Email and SMS nurturing running on leads who are not ready to buy yet

- A tested approach to practitioner communities, starting with dentists' Facebook groups

After 9 months: 

- About 285 MQLs per quarter, close to three times the Q4 2026 level

- Paid acquisition live in the US, with a first read on cost per lead

- A channel mix the sales team trusts, with lead quality reviewed with them on a regular basis

What you will own

Paid acquisition (the core of the job) 

- Run the Google Ads and Meta campaigns yourself, and test other paid channels when the numbers justify it

- Own the budget: split it by segment and channel, and cut what doesn't convert

- Write and test ads and landing pages without waiting for a brief

- Open paid acquisition in the US

Website and conversion 

- Turn the website into something visitors can act on: ROI calculator, comparison pages, product trial, lead magnets

- Build and test landing pages for each segment and specialty

- Work with our web agency, which runs SEO and GEO, so that paid and organic use the same keywords and pages

Nurturing and communities 

- Run email and SMS campaigns to leads and prospects. RevOps owns the tools and the CRM sync, you own the messages and the calendar

- Join the communities where practitioners talk to each other and turn them into a source of leads

- Try new channels as they appear and drop them quickly when they don't pay

Measurement 

- Report cost per MQL, conversion to opportunity and revenue for each channel

- Agree with sales on what a qualified lead is, and review lead quality with them

- Tell the team every month where the next euro should go

This role is for you if

Must have: 

- 4 to 7 years in growth or performance marketing with paid acquisition as your strongest skill. You have run Google Ads and Meta accounts yourself, on real budgets, and you can show the results

- You are a generalist out of curiosity. Beyond ads, you have built landing pages, set up tracking and written email sequences, and you prefer learning a tool to briefing someone else on it

- Fluent French and professional English.

What we will assess: 

- Numbers: you think in cost per lead, conversion rate and payback, and you can explain a campaign you stopped and why

- Doing it yourself: you build the campaign, the page and the automation, with AI and no-code tools when they save time

- Curiosity: you test channels nobody asked you to test

- Ownership: you have one number, and you say so early when it is off track

- Closeness to sales: you care about what happens to a lead after the form is filled in

- B2B lead generation for a SaaS product, experience marketing to healthcare professionals or small businesses

- Nice to have: paid campaigns on the US market.

This role is NOT for you if

- You want to specialize in one channel and stay on it

- You manage agencies and freelancers and no longer operate the accounts yourself

- You are looking for a brand or content role

Compensation and benefits

- 60-75K package

- Equity (BSPCE)

- Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with 8 to 12 RTT days per year

- Hybrid: 3 days per week at our Paris office

- MacBook provided

- Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company)

- Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered; public transport: 50% of Navigo covered; EGYM Wellpass

- Annual offsite and team events throughout the year

Hiring process

- Video call with our Head of Talent Acquisition (30 min)

- Video interview with Pierre, Head of Marketing (45 min)

- On site Technical interview: a paid acquisition case, with Pierre

- Interview with Eliott, CEO or Maxime Chief of Staff

- Reference checks

- Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days . You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca? 

- An entrepreneurial adventure , with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

- A product already live , with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

- A true scaling phase , with everything still to build

- Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles. 

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: People & Workplace Experience Manager
description:
About Dust 

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. 

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. 

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 .

The role 

Dust is growing fast, and we want every person who joins us to feel welcome, supported, connected and able to do their best work. As our People Experience Manager, you'll shape how people experience Dust, from their first day and the moments that bring us together to the way our offices in Paris, London, New York and San Francisco support the team.

We're looking for someone who is operationally excellent and creatively ambitious. You'll handle the details carefully, and you'll also look for ways to make the employee experience much better. One day you might be redesigning part of onboarding, the next planning a company offsite, acting on survey feedback, or working with a site lead to improve one of our offices. 

This role works as a partner across the company. You'll work most closely with People Operations, who lead on the core people processes. Together, you'll make sure the employee experience is well run behind the scenes and thoughtful in how people actually experience it. In Paris, you'll also work closely with our Office Manager, who runs our HQ on site and leads much of our day-to-day office life and events. In London, New York and San Francisco, you'll coordinate with local site leads. You'll also work with IT, Finance, Legal, Marketing, leadership and outside partners. Your guiding principle: consistency where it matters, local adaptation where it creates a better experience. 

What you will do: 

Own the employee journey 

- Own the onboarding experience end to end, working closely with our People Ops Specialist, from pre-boarding and equipment to first-day logistics and the first few weeks, so new joiners can contribute from day one in every location.

- Work with People Ops, IT, Finance, hiring managers, our Paris Office Manager and site leads so every handoff in the employee journey is smooth.

- Partner with People Ops and IT on offboarding, so people leave with the same care they got when they joined.

- Be a trusted point of contact for everyday employee questions and needs, and know when to bring in People Ops.

Build culture and community 

- Run and improve our team rituals, including weekly lunches, team drinks, dinners and company gatherings.

- Organise one or two company offsites or retreats each year.

- Create moments that help people connect, celebrate progress and feel they belong, across offices and time zones.

- Pay attention to the details that make experiences feel personal and inclusive, such as dietary needs, accessibility, preferences and team milestones.

- Partner with People and Marketing on selected external and brand-building events.

Listen and turn feedback into action 

- Build feedback loops (surveys, conversations, informal check-ins) to understand how people experience Dust.

- Turn what people tell us into concrete recommendations and visible improvements.

- Define and track simple, useful measures of employee and workplace experience.

- Communicate clearly and consistently about updates, events, practical information and team norms. Be assertive when needed.

Shape our workplaces 

- Make sure our offices are safe, welcoming, functional and ergonomic, and that they reflect how we want people to feel at Dust.

- Work with our office manager on day-to-day operations: supplies, maintenance, access, equipment and services.

- Manage workplace vendors, contracts and budget, and look for efficient ways to improve the experience.

- Spot operational needs early and fix issues before they disrupt anyone.

Scale the experience as Dust grows 

- Help shape how our physical, hybrid and digital environments evolve as the company grows.

- Set up simple, scalable processes and clear ownership across People, IT, Finance and Legal topics.

- Keep the employee experience personal and high quality without making it bureaucratic.

What success looks like 

After your first 100 days, you will have:

- Built a smooth, consistent onboarding experience for every new joiner, in every location.

- Delivered team rituals, events and offsites that strengthen connection and culture.

- Set up feedback loops and a practical set of metrics that guide People Experience decisions.

- Created well-run, welcoming offices where operational issues are handled quickly and proactively.

- Established clear processes and ownership across People, workplace, IT, Finance and Legal.

- Helped Dust grow its employee experience without it becoming bureaucratic or impersonal.

What we are looking for 

- 4+ years of experience in People Operations, People Experience, Workplace Experience in a fast growing, globally distributed environment

- A proactive generalist who can handle many kinds of work at once without losing sight of the bigger picture.

- Real ideas, sound judgement and the confidence to improve how things work today.

- Strong operational ownership, project management skills and attention to detail.

- Warmth, empathy and a genuine interest in helping people feel comfortable and connected.

- Clear, direct, thoughtful communication, and discretion with sensitive situations.

- Confidence working with vendors, budgets and outside partners.

- The ability to build simple processes that scale, and to keep a high bar for quality while staying pragmatic.

- Comfort with a fast-moving environment where priorities can change, working on your own while collaborating across the company.

Location 

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust 

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. 

Learn how we think and work. 

- Our product constitution, a story about our mission 

- Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

- Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: €55K – €65K • Offers Equity

title: Directeur de Projet DATA CENTER
description:

1. Présentation du poste 

Intitulé : Directeur de Projet Data Center (Data Center Project Director)

Rattachement hiérarchique : Directeur des Opérations / Directeur de Programme / Direction Générale

Périmètre : France et International

Secteur : Data Centers – Infrastructures critiques – Construction – Ingénierie

2. Mission principale 

Le Directeur de Projet Data Center assure le pilotage stratégique, technique, opérationnel et financier de projets complexes de conception, de construction, d'extension ou de transformation de Data Centers.

Il garantit la bonne exécution des projets dans le respect des engagements contractuels, des budgets, des délais, des exigences de qualité, de sécurité, de performance énergétique et de disponibilité des infrastructures.

Il intervient sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets, depuis les études de faisabilité jusqu'à la réception des installations, leur mise en service et leur transfert aux équipes d'exploitation.

Véritable chef d'orchestre, il coordonne les différentes parties prenantes et assure l'interface entre la maîtrise d'ouvrage, la maîtrise d'œuvre, les bureaux d'études, les entreprises de construction, les fournisseurs et les exploitants.

3. Responsabilités principales 

A. Direction et pilotage stratégique des projets 

- Définir la stratégie globale d'exécution et les objectifs du projet.

- Piloter des projets de Data Centers neufs (Greenfield), d'extension ou de rénovation (Brownfield).

- Superviser toutes les phases du projet, de la faisabilité à la livraison.

- Définir les jalons, les livrables et les indicateurs de performance.

- Mettre en place la gouvernance et les instances de décision.

- Arbitrer les choix techniques, économiques et organisationnels.

- Anticiper les risques et définir les plans d'atténuation.

- Assurer le reporting auprès de la Direction Générale, des investisseurs et des clients.

B. Management technique et coordination des études 

Superviser et coordonner l'ensemble des disciplines techniques :

Électricité – Courants forts et faibles 

- Réseaux HTB/HTA/BT et postes de transformation.

- Tableaux électriques, TGBT et distribution électrique.

- Groupes électrogènes et systèmes d'alimentation secourue.

- Onduleurs (UPS), batteries et systèmes de distribution.

- Architectures de redondance N+1, 2N et autres configurations adaptées aux exigences de disponibilité.

- Coordination des protections électriques, sélectivité et continuité de service.

CVC – Refroidissement et traitement d'air 

- Production et distribution frigorifique.

- Groupes froids, free cooling et refroidissement adiabatique.

- CRAH, CRAC et Fan Walls.

- Systèmes de refroidissement liquide (Liquid Cooling).

- CDU et solutions de Direct-to-Chip Cooling.

- Optimisation des performances thermiques et énergétiques.

Bâtiment et infrastructures 

- Génie civil, structure et architecture.

- VRD et raccordements aux réseaux.

- Sécurité incendie et systèmes de détection/extinction.

- Contrôle d'accès, vidéosurveillance et sûreté physique.

- BMS, DCIM, GTB et supervision technique.

- Intégration des infrastructures IT et télécoms.

Assurer la cohérence technique des études, la gestion des interfaces et la conformité aux exigences contractuelles et réglementaires.

C. Pilotage des études et de la conception 

- Superviser les études de faisabilité et les avant-projets.

- Piloter les phases de conception selon les référentiels contractuels applicables, notamment RIBA 0 à 4 pour les projets concernés.

- Valider les choix architecturaux et techniques.

- Organiser les revues de conception et les analyses de risques.

- Superviser la coordination BIM et les études de synthèse.

- Garantir la constructibilité, la maintenabilité et l'exploitabilité des installations.

- Piloter les démarches de Value Engineering.

- Optimiser le CAPEX sans compromettre les exigences de performance et de résilience.

D. Direction de la construction et de l'exécution 

- Définir la stratégie de réalisation et le phasage des travaux.

- Superviser les entreprises générales, les lots techniques et les sous-traitants.

- Coordonner les équipes de maîtrise d'œuvre et de construction.

- Garantir le respect des plannings et des jalons contractuels.

- Veiller au respect des exigences HSE.

- Gérer les modifications, non-conformités et situations critiques.

- Organiser les opérations préalables à la réception.

E. Gestion financière et contractuelle

- Superviser les engagements financiers et le suivi des dépenses.

- Identifier les dérives budgétaires et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

- Piloter les contrats de maîtrise d'œuvre, d'ingénierie, de construction et de fourniture.

- Assurer un reporting financier fiable et régulier.

5. Profil recherché

Expérience

Langues

title: Associate Team Lead - Customer Support (T2)
description:
Résumé 

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable dans leur quotidien. L’équipe Support Niveau 2 intervient sur les demandes les plus complexes ou nécessitant une expertise métier et produit approfondie, en lien avec les équipes Support Niveau 1, Support Technique, Produit et Tech.

Ce rôle est un poste de management de proximité : tu seras le relais opérationnel du Team Lead Support N2 et accompagneras une équipe de 6 à 12 agents au quotidien pour leur permettre de répondre aux utilisateurs avec efficacité, qualité et empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité, à l’amélioration continue du support et à des projets transverses.

Notre culture 

Au sein du Support, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience .

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust .

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça 

- Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

- Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

- Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations pour donner du feedback constructif.

- Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité de l’équipe, comme le temps de première réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume de tickets traités.

- Participer aux rituels de pilotage opérationnel : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

- Remonter les irritants utilisateurs aux équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops.

- Contribuer à améliorer les process, la documentation et les outils internes.

Responsabilités 

- Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Team Lead Support N2, en les accompagnant dans leur activité quotidienne, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

- Donner des feedbacks clairs, réguliers et transparents, réaliser des écoutes et analyses de conversations, suivre les bilans et plans d’accompagnement individuels, proposer des coachings et identifier les besoins de formation.

- Suivre les indicateurs de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, notamment le temps de première réponse, la satisfaction client, le temps de résolution, le volume traité, la prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et le suivi des tickets en cours.

- Participer aux rituels de pilotage et à la gestion des files de demandes communes, notamment lors des rotations de permanence, en identifiant les alertes et en remontant les besoins de renfort ou d’arbitrage.

- Être force de proposition pour optimiser les process, les outils, la documentation et les modes de fonctionnement du Support.

- Collaborer avec les équipes support de niveau 1, l’équipe technique, les équipes opérationnelles ainsi que les équipes produit et tech, faire remonter les irritants utilisateurs et contribuer aux projets transverses.

- Partager les bonnes pratiques avec les autres Associate Team Leads et contribuer à maintenir une communication fluide au sein du Support.

- Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes internes urgentes ou des situations complexes nécessitant l’expertise du Support Niveau 2, en sachant orienter ou escalader lorsque cela est nécessaire.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si 

- Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

- Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

- Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant toujours en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

- Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même quand les sujets sont complexes.

- Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications 

- Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en comptabilité, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

- Expérience d’au moins 1 an en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe, idéalement dans le secteur du support.

- Bonne capacité à analyser une situation, prendre une décision mesurée et proposer des solutions concrètes.

- Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

- Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

- Aisance avec les outils informatiques, notamment les outils de ticketing et de documentation comme Intercom, Zendesk ou Notion.

- Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

- Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have 

Ces éléments sont un plus, mais ne sont pas indispensables si tu as une forte appétence pour le support, le management de proximité et l’apprentissage produit/métier.

- Connaissances en comptabilité.

- Expérience préalable en tant que contributeur individuel au sein d’une équipe Support.

- Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

- Expérience dans le management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

- Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops.

- Anglais niveau B1 minimum.

- Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

Modalités pratiques 

- Tu reporteras au Team Lead Support N2.

- Le rôle combine management de proximité, pilotage opérationnel et contribution ponctuelle sur des situations complexes ou urgentes.

- L’équipe collabore principalement en français, avec des interactions possibles en anglais selon les sujets et les équipes.

description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision 

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant
