Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu te formes sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible)
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision 

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la Pennylane Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

🤝 Process de recrutement

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu 

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: 

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s 

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires). 

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @ pennylane.com ou ----- . 

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement. 

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement ." 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps. 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles 

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : 
Notre data policy 

🇬🇧 Personal Data 

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten 

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 

🇪🇸 Datos personales 

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

3 premiers mois :

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
At evenito, we build enterprise event management software centered on human connection. By combining cutting-edge technology with personal support, we empower event teams to automate routine logistics and free up time for what truly matters: crafting memorable, sustainable event experiences.

As our Head of Customer Success (CS) you will have a front row seat. Together with your team you will be responsible for evenito’s customer excellence. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will not only ensure that our customers receive professional support, but also be the strategic business owner of our post-sale organization and act as a key customer voice within the company. You will develop and execute a scalable CS operating model and play a pivotal role in shaping our product and the future of evenito.

Are you ready to make an impact?

Your Mission: 

Drive customer success, develop a high-performing team and turn everyday user insights into strategic product growth.

- Lead by Example: You set the tone through your actions. From onboarding our largest enterprise clients (ICPs) to handling support tickets alongside your team, you showcase what great customer service looks like while equipping your team with the tools and support they need to succeed.

- Team Development & Coaching: You will lead and coach a team of five. Through regular 1-on-1s, clear goals and constructive feedback, you will foster a positive, supportive work environment focused on steady growth and a resilient team setup.

- Escalations & Problem Solving: You view complex situations as opportunities to build trust with our clients. When high-stakes issues arise, you partner directly with Product and Management to find clear solutions, using customer data to guide thoughtful decisions.

- Cross-Functional Advocacy: You serve as a key connector between our clients and internal teams. By sharing real customer insights with Product, Sales and Marketing, you help shape and prioritize our product roadmap while keeping team priorities aligned with company strategy.

- Process & Project Innovation: You stay current on Customer Success best practices and enjoy improving how things work. You will have the freedom to introduce new CS workflows that streamline daily operations and support our current growth stage.

- Commercial Impact & Growth: You ensure Customer Success is a growth engine by delivering clear, measurable value. You will drive product adoption and offer high-impact paid services, positioning expansions as a natural result of client success. This, while tracking performance with clear, business-focused metrics.

- Knowledge Base Development: You will own and champion our self-service tools (Knowledge Base, Video Academy, Automation). By making resources clear and accessible, you help our customers find quick answers independently and keep support queues manageable.

Your Story 

You have a solid B2B SaaS experience, a practical doer mindset and a genuine drive to grow people and businesses - all fueled by a real enthusiasm for the magic of event tech.

- SaaS Experience: You bring 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation or Account Management in the B2B SaaS environment.

- Hands-on Doer Mindset: You keep your cool and stay positive when things go sideways. You are pragmatic, humble and jump into daily support queues without hesitation.

- Effective Communicator: You are a skilled communicator and workshop facilitator who connects effortlessly with enterprise executives, end-users and internal teams alike.

- Tech Savvy and Agile: You are at home analyzing usage data, mapping workflows and collaborating with Product on technical escalations. You adapt quickly to new software, shifting priorities and changing processes.

- Leadership Drive: You genuinely care about people. Ideally, you have led a small team before and take true fulfillment in coaching others, building confidence and helping your team grow.

- Passion for Events and Tech: Events are all about emotion and experience. We are looking for someone who brings that exact enthusiasm for events, event tech and / or digital products.

- Languages: Fluent in English and German, with the ability to comfortably follow Swiss-German in client meetings.

What We Offer 

Unlock your full potential in an inspiring and fast-paced environment. We provide the stage; you take the reins.

- Impact : Take ownership of a role where your work directly shapes evenito's growth and sets new standards for the industry. You will work closely with management, an amazing team, passionate clients and drive projects that make a difference.

- Flexibility : As one of our core values, we strongly believe in hybrid remote work options and flexible schedules that allow you to align your professional commitments with your personal life.

- Time to Recharge : Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day off for every year of service, giving you plenty of time to rest and recharge.

- Modern Zurich HQ: Located just a five-minute walk from Zurich HB, our centrally located office offers an inspiring work environment with local coffee, a variety of snacks and access to many lunch spots.

- Unique Event s: Events are our DNA. Beyond building great software, we truly enjoy spending time with each other - whether through spontaneous summer swims in the Limmat-river, Friday Beer um Vier drinks, our annual Global Team Event or legendary Christmas parties.

- Mobility Support: We contribute toward your public transport pass (öV-Abo) to support convenient and sustainable commuting.

- Growth Potential: Thrive in a workplace with flat hierarchies, fast decision-making and an open feedback culture designed to help you continuously develop.

Are you ready to shape the future of events with us? 

Discover more about life at evenito on our career page, send us your CV and tell us what excites you most about joining our team. We are building something special at evenito - and we can’t wait to meet the person behind the application.

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. 

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Responsibilities 

- Plan your sourcing. You take the bill of materials and build a sourcing plan for each commodity. You weigh criticality, lead time and single or dual source options.

- Find the right suppliers. You run market scans, requests for information and requests for quote. Then you shortlist the suppliers worth a closer look.

- Judge capability together. You work with R&D, Production, Finance and Compliance to build one clear view of what each supplier can do.

- Negotiate the deal. You agree pricing, volume tiers, tooling and payment terms. You also set up the NDAs, supply agreements and long-term agreements that back them.

- Set suppliers up properly. You onboard new suppliers and keep vendor data, price breaks and lead times current in our ERP system.

- Lead supplier qualification. You coordinate our tiered qualification process, including quality agreements and first-article inspections.

- Audit on site and remotely. You check suppliers for quality management, traceability and compliance. You also screen them against trade compliance requirements.

- Keep builds moving. You place and expedite orders for prototype, validation, pilot and pre-series builds. You track supplier performance on delivery, price and quality.

- Bring costs down. You work with suppliers on cost reduction, using should-cost and landed-cost models.

- Grow our supplier base. You qualify suppliers for additional production sites and regions, reusing existing qualification records.

- Make it repeatable. You document sourcing processes, templates and playbooks, so the purchasing team can take over mature suppliers.

Requirements 

- You have 6+ years in sourcing, purchasing or new product introduction for hardware products, across a variety of product types, complexities and technologies.

- You can read technical drawings and specifications, and you work closely with engineers.

- You’re willing to travel regularly, including international trips of several days.

- You’ve audited suppliers hands-on or worked within a quality management system such as ISO 9001.

- You have working knowledge of trade compliance rules.

- You’ve used an ERP system for purchasing and vendor data.

- You have a qualification in engineering, supply chain, business or a related field.

- You communicate excellently in English and build good working relationships with colleagues and suppliers.

Plus 

- Experience in aerospace, drones or other safety-critical products

- Experience sourcing custom electromechanical parts such as plastic parts, motors, batteries and avionics

- Experience qualifying suppliers for production in more than one region

- Experience with supplier scorecards and performance reporting

If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

title: Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d)
description:
Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. Es positioniert sich als Innovationsführer im Bereich industrieller Bedienoberflächen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

- Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
- Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
- Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)
- Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau
- Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung
- Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform
Deine Aufgaben

- Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
- Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
- Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
- Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
- Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
- Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
- Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
- Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen
Dein Profil

- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
- Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
- Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
- Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
- Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)
Was hier nicht funktioniert

- Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
- Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
- Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
- Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
- Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln
Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

- Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
- Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
- Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz
Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

title: Senior Documentation Specialist
description:
About this position

As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement.

Your tasks: 

- Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system.

- Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements.

- Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks.

- Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure.

- Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions.

- Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working.

- Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance.

- Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks.

- Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices.

Role requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline.

- Minimum seven years of experience in TMF and documentation management within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including at least three years of experience in biotechnology or another fast-growing, dynamic environment.

- Advanced knowledge of eTMF solutions, such as Veeva Vault Clinical, PhlexTMF or comparable platforms, together with strong working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and the CDISC TMF Reference Model.

- Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight.

- Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions.

- Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions.

- Proactive and accountable approach, with sound judgement, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and implement pragmatic, GCP-compliant solutions.

- Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment.

- Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Work permit

Candidate needs to hold a Swiss work permit or be an EU citizen eligible to work in Switzerland

Your path forward

If you meet most of these requirements and bring a strong dedication to technical documentation, we encourage you to apply. You will contribute directly to our mission of advancing new medicines for patients.

title: Staff Solutions Architect, AI Subject Matter Expert

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role 

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.

Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.

You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI & Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.

Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.

What you’ll do 

- Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.

- Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.

- Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.

- Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.

- Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.

- Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.

- Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.

- Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.

What you’ll bring 

- Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.

- Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.

- Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.

- Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.

- The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.

- Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.

- Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.

- Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.

If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.

Samen met multidisciplinaire projectteams geef je richting aan ontwerp en realisatie, met directe invloed op de dagelijkse operatie én de toekomstbestendigheid van luchthavens. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap til je niet alleen projecten, maar ook collega’s naar een hoger niveau.

De projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn 

- We werken aan het verduurzamen van Terminal 1 & 2 van Schiphol, zo’n 40% van de gehele terminal: De huidige installaties die zorgen voor een aangenaam binnenklimaat, maken gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen. Wij werken aan het ontwerp van de nieuwe installatie, die warmte en koude opslag combineert met warmtepompen zodat Schiphol energieneutraal de toekomst tegemoet kan. De uitdaging van dit project zit met name in het toepassen van nieuwe techniek in een bestaand gebouw waar ruimte moet worden gecreëerd om alle apparatuur en leidingen goed onder te brengen en te zorgen dat elke ruimte wordt voorzien van voldoende verwarming en koeling. - We werken aan het nieuwe operationele gebouw van DC ANSP, de luchtverkeersleiding van het Nederlandse luchtruim in de Cariben. Dit is een faciliteit voor de luchtverkeersleiders die verantwoordelijk zijn voor area control, waarbij de operations room en de ruimte waar de apparatuur staat opgesteld aan strenge bouwfysische en klimaateisen moeten voldoen met een hoge mate van redundantie. De omgeving vraagt daarnaast om een robuust ontwerp dat bestand is tegen orkanen en aardbevingen.

- We werken op Schiphol aan diverse grote en kleine projecten waarin klimaatbeheersing een grote rol speelt door intensiever gebruik van diverse ruimtes en toename van de apparatuur. Wij worden veel ingezet om de oorzaak van klachten te achterhalen en de juiste oplossing te bieden, of om de juiste oplossing te vinden voor nieuwe apparatuur die hogere eisen stelt aan de installaties. Vrijwel altijd gaat het hier om locaties waar zich passagiers bevinden en Schiphol deze een comfortabele omgeving wil bieden, of waar medewerkers taken uitvoeren die essentieel zijn voor het primaire proces van de luchthaven, waarbij een prettig klimaat een belangrijke voorwaarde is.

Je werkt in een team van collega’s binnen een organisatie met ruim 750 medewerkers, actief in verschillende sectoren. title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD 

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

- You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

- You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

- You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

- You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence.

- You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early.

- You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster.

- You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

- Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years.

- In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

- You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production.

- Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough.

- You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

- Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases.

- Experience with Kubernetes.

- Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR 

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

- A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

- Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

- Base salary between €5,500 and €6,450 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

- A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

- 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

- A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

- A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

- Collective insurance plans.

- A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

- Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

- Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

Want to know more? 

We’d love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you’ll hear from us within 5 working days. Any questions first? Message or call Nadine on 06 28556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

title: Director Research & Development
description:
Purpose of the job The Director Research & Development (R&D) leads the exploration and development of potential business and technology initiatives, from initial ideation through feasibility analysis, testing, validation and proof of concept (POC)/prototyping. For assigned initiatives, the role coordinates the full exploration phase and develops substantiated proposals for consideration and approval by the relevant governance bodies. 

The role requires a proactive, self-motivated approach, the ability to work independently and to manage multiple subjects concurrently. Initiatives may range from joint venture (JV) model enhancements and artificial intelligence (AI) to customer experience development and new approaches to distribution. 

KEY RESULT AREAS/ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Ideation and concept generation 

- Ensure that potential initiatives align with SkyTeam’s strategic goals and assess their purpose, expected value, rationale and the implications of not proceeding.
- Ask relevant questions and gather appropriate information to support well-founded recommendations and help build consensus among member airlines.
- Organize and facilitate ideation and brainstorming sessions.
- Monitor developments in the transport industry and at IATA to identify emerging trends and opportunities or gaps for improving existing legacy systems.
- Generate, collect and develop ideas and concepts in partnership with member airlines and other contributors for marketable initiatives that could become SkyTeam priorities.

Exploration, feasibility and concept development 

- Lead the exploration of assigned initiatives, including relevant research and data analysis, feasibility assessments, business cases, business requirements documents (BRDs) and POCs/prototypes, as appropriate.
- Analyze business and technical challenges across different airline domains; identify and assess potential solutions and determine the most relevant product concept, design and feasibility approach.
- Develop evidence-based recommendations, supported by tangible data and analysis, that demonstrate the potential business value of the proposed initiative.
- Prepare proposals and supporting materials for review and approval by the relevant SkyTeam and member-airline decision-making bodies.

Stakeholder engagement and governance 

- Work effectively within SkyTeam’s matrix organization and collaborate with member airlines, internal teams and relevant external contributors.
- Engage with operational and technical stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, to understand requirements, assess options and build alignment around proposed concepts.
- Support informed decisions through clear analysis and recommendations. Strategic prioritization and formal initiative approval remain with the Executive Board (EB), Strategy Committee (StratCom) and relevant governance bodies.

Transition to implementation 

- Following approval, coordinate with Digital/Delivery to transfer the agreed concept, supporting analysis, business requirements and relevant POC findings for MVP development and implementation.
- Where assigned, act as project owner or coordinate relevant project activities within the agreed governance arrangements. Accountability for implementation transfers to Digital/Delivery.
- Budget, resource or external-partner responsibilities may be assigned depending on the approved initiative and are not standing responsibilities of the role.

Your profile REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE 
- Strong airline-industry background, with demonstrated experience in core airline businesses such as PRM, distribution, operational research and e-sales.
- Broad understanding of airline business and technical domains, sufficient to assess a variety of potential initiatives.
- Good understanding of relevant technical aspects; experience in a Business Analyst role is an advantage.
- Excellent facilitation skills, with the ability to engage and guide diverse groups towards innovative solutions.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain and present complex concepts and inspire teams.
- Analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to evaluate complex options and communicate evidence-based recommendations.
- Ability to work independently on multiple subjects and collaborate effectively in a multicultural matrix organization.

Responsibilities and tasks of the position are not limited to the above mentioned, and deviations can occur at any point in time as the position evolves and in concert with the manager.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Tellent Intelligence (AI)
description:
Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location. 

About the Role 

As a Senior Quality Engineer – Tellent Intelligence (AI) , you'll own and grow the quality of the AI-powered experiences built by our Tellent Intelligence team alongside our existing QE team. You'll help shape how we test applications powered by large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, ensuring they are reliable, safe, and deliver high-quality experiences for our customers.

You'll expand our end-to-end test coverage in Playwright and help build robust approaches for validating AI-powered systems, where quality extends beyond functional correctness. This is a hands-on, collaborative role with genuine ownership, direct impact on product development, and the opportunity to shape how we test AI at Tellent.

Your 12-Month Journey 

- During your first 3 months: You'll get to know our Tellent Intelligence domain, engineering practices, AI-powered features, and quality standards. You'll learn our testing framework and development workflow while contributing to automated, exploratory, and AI-focused testing.

- Within 6 months: You'll take ownership of quality across key AI-powered features, expand our Playwright test coverage, and work closely with engineers to validate AI behaviour, prompts, and model-driven functionality throughout development.

- After 1 year: You'll be a trusted quality partner within the Tellent Intelligence team, driving improvements to our AI testing strategy, strengthening our automation framework, and helping shape how we build reliable, safe, and responsible AI experiences across Tellent.

What You'll Be Doing 

- Work closely with fellow Quality Engineers to bring our test automation strategy to life across the Tellent Intelligence domain, taking shared ownership and continuously improving it as our platform evolves.

- Partner with developers, AI engineers, and fellow QEs to embed quality early in the development process, sharing knowledge and shaping testing practices collaboratively.

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites across frontend, backend, and AI-powered functionality.

- Develop into a product domain expert, using your understanding to identify risks early and guide quality decisions across the Tellent Intelligence domain.

- Design and execute testing strategies for AI-powered features, validating not only functional correctness but also the quality, relevance, consistency, and safety of AI-generated outputs.

- Develop approaches for testing non-deterministic systems by creating evaluation datasets, defining quality benchmarks, and identifying hallucinations, bias, regressions, and prompt-related issues as models and prompts evolve.

- Partner with engineers to validate prompt changes, AI agent behaviour, and safety guardrails, ensuring our AI behaves reliably and responsibly before reaching customers.

- Continuously improve how we evaluate AI quality by helping establish best practices, quality metrics, and testing frameworks for LLM-powered applications.

What You Bring 

- Strong QA experience: Several years of hands-on quality engineering, with senior-level ownership of testing for complex web applications.

- AI quality mindset: Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based products, conversational AI, or machine learning systems is a strong plus. If you haven't worked directly with AI before, you're excited to learn and apply quality engineering principles to this rapidly evolving space.

- E2E automation: Experience building and maintaining end-to-end test suites in Playwright.

- API & backend testing skills: Experience testing APIs and backend services.

- Balance of product and technical thinking: Equally at home discussing product behaviour and digging into technical detail.

- Understanding of AI testing challenges: Familiarity with concepts such as prompt engineering, AI agents, hallucinations, model bias, evaluation datasets, and AI safety principles is a plus.

- Analytical mindset: Comfortable defining quality expectations for systems where outputs may vary while still delivering a great user experience.

- Communication: Fluent English for daily collaboration. Polish is a plus.

What We Offer 

- Hybrid or remote working setup across Amsterdam, the Cologne area, or Poland

- A chance to shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe and lead a company-defining tech transition.

- Work in a diverse, multicultural, and remote-friendly team.

- €1,500 annual training budget + 2 dedicated learning days

- Pension plan, travel reimbursement, and wellness perks.

- 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax.

- Work from anywhere for 4 weeks/year.

- Apple MacBook and top-tier tooling.

- €200 home office budget.

Please note: Benefits may differ based on your employment location. 

About Tellent 

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System ( Tellent Recruitee ), an intuitive HRIS ( Tellent HR ), and powerful Performance Management software ( Tellent Grow ).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. title: Manager, Machine Learning Engineering
description:
About Tala 

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on. 

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

The Role

We’re looking for a Manager, Machine Learning Engineering to lead Tala’s ML Platform team. This person will manage a team of Machine Learning Engineers responsible for building the platforms, frameworks, and infrastructure that enable our Data Science teams to securely train, deploy, monitor, and operate machine learning models at scale.

This is a player-coach management role. You’ll be responsible for developing and growing the team while also providing enough technical leadership to guide architecture, engineering practices, reliability, and production systems. The role has a particular focus on real-time machine learning inference and streaming data systems, as well as the platforms that support batch model development and deployment.

What You'll Do

Lead & Grow the Team 

- Manage and develop a team of 4–6 Machine Learning Engineers across mid-to-senior levels.

- Hire, source, interview, and close strong MLE talent.

- Establish clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and create development plans for direct reports.

- Coach engineers toward growth and promotion while addressing performance gaps directly and thoughtfully.

- Create opportunities for engineers to take on challenging projects and grow their technical leadership.

Own Engineering Delivery 

- Set quarterly goals and ensure the team consistently delivers against them.

- Own prioritization across product roadmap work, run-the-business activities, and operational excellence.

- Balance team capacity across new development, maintenance, technical debt, and production support.

- Improve team productivity by reducing context switching and delegating effectively.

- Partner with engineers and technical leads to estimate and scope complex work.

Provide Technical Leadership 

- Guide the development of platforms and frameworks that allow Data Scientists and Analysts to explore data, develop features, and train, test, deploy, and monitor ML models.

- Provide technical leadership across model infrastructure, real-time inference, streaming feature extraction, batch processing, and production ML systems.

- Drive strong engineering practices around testing, automation, observability, fault tolerance, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment.

- Own and improve SLOs, on-call health, capacity planning, reliability, and incident response.

- Review technical designs and help drive architectural standards and technical debt reduction.

Partner Across the Organization 

- Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Platform, Product, Credit, and Business Development teams.

- Translate business and technical needs into scalable ML platform solutions.

- Coordinate dependencies and delivery across multiple engineering and data teams.

- Help create structure and clarity in an environment where priorities and requirements can evolve.

What You'll Need

Management Experience 

- 2+ years of directly managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development.

- Experience managing a team through at least one full performance cycle.

- Demonstrated ability to coach engineers toward promotion and address underperformance effectively.

- Experience owning team goals, prioritization, estimation, and delivery.

- Experience with production on-call, incident response, and capacity planning.

- Willingness to be actively involved in sourcing, interviewing, and closing engineering talent.

Technical Experience 

- 6+ years of backend software engineering experience in consumer-scale applications.

- At least 3 years of hands-on Python experience.

- Experience building and operating machine learning or causal inference systems in production.

- Earlier-career experience personally building and deploying ML models or ML infrastructure.

- Ability to participate in technical architecture and system-design discussions and provide technical direction without needing to be the primary coder.

- Strong understanding of software quality, security, reliability, testing, and production operations.

Technical Skills 

We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience across:

- Languages: Python, SQL

- Machine Learning: Jupyter, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face

- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker

- Streaming: Kafka, Kinesis, Beam, Flink, Spark Streaming

- Batch Processing: Airflow, Metaflow

- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Snowflake, Druid, and/or similar technologies

- APIs: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, Protocol Buffers

- Production Engineering: DevOps, SLOs, monitoring/observability, on-call, capacity planning, root-cause analysis

- ML/Analytics: Machine learning, causal inference, scalable algorithms

Compensation

Additional Information

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About Us: 

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About the Role 

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help us build and ship AI-powered features that directly improve our product experience and business outcomes. This is a hands-on, product-focused role where you'll take ideas from concept to production — designing intelligent systems, validating them with real users, and turning them into reliable, scalable services.

You'll work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering — partnering closely with cross-functional teams to identify high-impact opportunities, prototype quickly, and iterate based on data. This isn't a research-only role. You'll own the full lifecycle: experimentation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is excited about applying LLMs and modern ML tooling to real-world problems. You think in terms of systems, tradeoffs, and outcomes — not just models. You care about performance, quality, latency, and cost in production. Most importantly, you're motivated by shipping impactful AI experiences that customers actually use.

What You'll Do 

- Build and ship AI agents that serve real users: tool-calling LLM systems with structured output, parallel API orchestration, and streaming responses.

- Design evaluation harnesses and quality scoring — we use Langfuse, rubrics to measure safety, effectiveness, and personalization.

- Own the full loop: prototype a new agent capability, validate it with evals, deploy it to staging and production, monitor traces, and iterate.

- Improve reliability, latency, and cost through prompt caching strategies, token budgets, retry logic, and observability.

- Write the tools agents use: API integrations with Pydantic validation, exercise search over local databases, structured workout submission.

What You Bring 

- Strong Python skills: you've built and deployed services on large production systems.

- Experience with LangChain/LangGraph or similar agent frameworks.

- Hands-on experience with LLMs in production: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured output, evaluation.

- Comfort with async Python, HTTP APIs, and streaming protocols (SSE, webhooks).

- Experience with data validation and schema design (Pydantic, JSON Schema).

- Ability to debug across layers: from a broken LLM tool call to a misconfigured Terraform resource.

- Clear communication: you'll work directly with product, mobile, and backend engineers.

Nice to Have 

- Familiarity with AWS (Bedrock, ECR, CloudFront, S3, Cognito) or other cloud agent hosting.

- Observability and tracing tools (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Datadog).

- Exposure to evaluation frameworks: LLM-as-a-judge, automated scoring, dataset management.

Compensation & Benefits

Equal Employment Opportunities at Future

title: Senior Software Enginner (Full-stack Node + React)
description:
About us: 

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve the full stack systems that power Airtm’s financial products. You’ll work within one of our autonomous product pods, taking ownership of projects end-to-end, from technical design through production, and mentoring the engineers around you.

Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices deployed on Kubernetes, paired with React front ends. You’ll work across the entire stack, backend and frontend, as needed to deliver on your pod’s goals, collaborating with engineers in other pods when initiatives cross boundaries. AI-assisted development is core to how we build software: you’ll be expected to use AI coding tools fluently to move faster without sacrificing quality.

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Design : Lead the design of medium-to-large features across the stack, document decisions, and anticipate edge cases and long-term maintainability

- Full Stack Development : Build and maintain TypeScript/Node.js microservices, event handlers, and cronjobs, as well as the React UIs that consume them, powering our core financial flows

- AI-Assisted Development : Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your daily workflow, from scaffolding and refactoring to test generation and code review, while maintaining a high bar for correctness and judgment about when and how much to rely on them

- Project Ownership : Break down complex problems into actionable work across multiple services and UIs; drive delivery from design through deployment

- Code Quality : Write well-tested, maintainable code; conduct thorough code reviews (including AI-generated code) and hold a high bar for the team

- Mentorship : Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, including on effective and responsible use of AI tooling; share knowledge and elevate the team’s technical practices

- Cross-Pod Collaboration : Coordinate with engineers in other pods when work crosses service boundaries; contribute code to shared services following established ownership guidelines

- On-Call : Participate in on-call rotation for services the pod owns; lead incident response and post-incident reviews

- Technical Debt : Proactively identify and address technical debt; balance short-term delivery with long-term health of the systems

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated full stack range (backend services and frontend UIs)

- Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for building production services

- Proficiency in React for building production-facing UIs (state management, component design, performance)

- Experience designing and building REST or GraphQL APIs 

- Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), modeling, query optimization, and migrations

- Familiarity with event-driven architecture and messaging patterns (Kafka, SQS, or similar)

- Experience working in a microservices environment

- Hands-on, day-to-day experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Zed’s Agentic editing, or similar) for coding, debugging, and code review; comfort with prompt/context engineering and sound judgment about validating AI-generated output

- Strong grasp of software design principles : separation of concerns, error handling, testing strategies

- Experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests 

- Comfort operating in a cloud environment (AWS preferred), understanding of deployments, logs, and basic infrastructure concepts

- Strong communication skills; proactive about sharing progress, blockers, and technical risks

Nice to Have

- Experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered features into products (RAG, agents, tool calling, prompt pipelines)

- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container-based deployments

- Background in fintech, payments, or financial systems 

- Experience working with GraphQL (schema design, federation, or tooling)

- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD)

- Familiarity with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)

- Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design discussions

What We Look For

Beyond the technical skills, we’re looking for engineers who:

- Take ownership , they drive their work to completion and communicate early when something is at risk

- Write code for the next engineer , clean, tested, and documented, whether they or an AI tool wrote the first draft

- Improve the team around them, through reviews, mentorship, and knowledge sharing

- Collaborate across boundaries , they engage other pods constructively when work crosses service lines

- Have good technical judgment , they balance pragmatism with quality, know when to push back on scope, and know when (and when not) to lean on AI tooling

Compensation

title: AI Senior Engineer (Vision)
description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. 

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. 

What you’ll be doing 

We are seeking someone who enjoys working at the cutting edge where Computer Vision meets Logic . You will be responsible for the "eyes" and the "brain" of our system—extracting complex data from visual documents and then orchestrating how that data is used by Large Language Models.

In short, someone who likes:

- Unlocking Visual Data: Building pipelines that can "read" complex documents, understanding layout, charts, and visual context using Vision-Language Models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5) and Layout Analysis .

- Orchestrating Intelligence: Owning the application logic layer. You will use LangChain or LangGraph to build the agents and chains that query our data, reason about it, and generate responses.

- Native PDF Handling: Handling the messy reality of PDF processing (PyMuPDF, layout parsing) to preserve structure before the AI even sees it.

- Prompt Engineering & Logic: Crafting complex prompts and control flows to ensure models interpret financial charts and layouts accurately without hallucinating.

- Cost & Scale: Applying a cost-optimization mindset (batch processing, model selection) to ensure our vision and orchestration layers are economically viable.

What we’re looking for 

We want to work with people who have a passion for collaborating with their teams, building software while nurturing inclusive and respectful relationships with their coworkers. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps.

Ideally, they would also have:

- LLM Orchestration (Must Have ): Deep experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks. You know how to manage context windows, tool calling, and agentic workflows.

- Multimodal AI Experience: Hands-on experience integrating state-of-the-art vision models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) and embedding models (CLIP).

- Document Intelligence Specialist: Familiarity with specialized models (e.g., Donut, Pix2Struct) and tools like Unstructured.io or Docling.

- PDF Processing Mastery: Mastery over tools like PyMuPDF or pdfplumber for native element extraction.

- Python ML Stack: Strong proficiency in PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Nice-to-Have: 

- Fine-Tuning: Experience fine-tuning vision or language models, specifically to improve accuracy on domain-specific artifacts like financial charts or tables.

- Domain Knowledge: Prior experience handling documents in the Real Estate or Finance sectors.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

- To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.

- Payments made in USD.

- 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.

- Wellness + Remote Stipend

- AI Voucher

About Able 

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

title: Full-Stack Growth Engineer
description:
About Us: 

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a Full-Stack Growth Engineer to build and maintain the product and systems that help more of the right people discover Future, convert into members, and reach their first moments of value.

You’ll work across web and backend surfaces that power acquisition, signup and access, onboarding and activation, and early engagement. You’ll ship experiments end to end, instrument funnels carefully, and partner closely with product, design, data, and marketing on a small, senior team.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll move between product judgment and system design, write production code, run trustworthy experiments, and turn learnings into durable product improvements — not one-off hacks.

What You’ll Own:

- Acquisition and Conversion: Build and improve the web and product surfaces that introduce Future to prospective members and turn interest into signup. These include landing experiences, checkout and plan selection flows, and the instrumentation that shows where people drop off.

- Access and Onboarding: Simplify signup, login, account creation, and first-session activation. Remove friction, clarify value on Day 1, and help new members connect with coaching and get started quickly.

- Experimentation Systems: Design, ship, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across the funnel. Partner with data to define metrics, guardrails, and experiment hygiene so we learn fast without polluting the product.

- Full-Stack Delivery : Implement features across frontend and backend — APIs, services, web UI, and the glue between growth surfaces and the core member product. Prefer clear ownership and fast iteration over brittle one-off paths.

- Measurement and Insight: Instrument funnels, cohorts, and activation milestones. Use qualitative and quantitative signal to find leverage, prioritize work, and explain why experiments won or lost.

- Reliability for Growth Paths: Keep high-traffic growth journeys fast, stable, and observable. Treat conversion-critical paths with the same engineering care as core product.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Work tightly with product, design, data, and marketing. Translate growth hypotheses into shippable product work and bring engineering judgment into roadmap tradeoffs.

- AI-Assisted Development: Use coding agents and AI tools to speed up exploration, implementation, testing, and review. Apply engineering judgment to validate their output before it reaches members or prospects.

Who You Are:

Experience and Background

- You have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful ownership of consumer growth, acquisition, activation, or conversion surfaces.

- You are strong full-stack: comfortable across modern web frontend and backend services, and able to ship an experiment from UI through API and data without waiting on another team for every layer.

- You have run growth experiments in production — A/B tests, funnel instrumentation, and iteration based on measured outcomes, not vibes alone.

- You understand customer journeys: segments, touchpoints, dropoff analysis, and how product changes move activation and retention metrics.

- You can debug across web UI, networking, backend services, analytics pipelines, and CI.

- You have partnered with product, design, and data (or marketing) to take ambiguous growth problems from hypothesis to shipped learning.

- You write clear, maintainable code and care about experiment integrity, observability, and long-term operability — not just shipping the next test.

- You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and know how to verify their output.

Domain Passion

You care about health, fitness, and helping people start — and stick with — better habits. You’re motivated by the craft of turning curiosity into membership and first value.

Working Style

- You bias to action, then measure. You ship small, learn, and compound.

- You raise concerns early and bring possible solutions when experiments or funnels look wrong.

- You share context, invite feedback, and keep partners aligned on metrics and tradeoffs.

- You take ownership from discovery through production support on the paths you ship.
